facts.name: Kiniful geni
facts.statement: For any zefafo fale A and B, |A × B| = |A|·|B|: the rolafa of merinec joroz (first gelabu, second gelabu) is the rolafa of tekotuh for the first gelabu werog the rolafa of tekotuh for the second, wadocuti the rolafa of tekotuh for the second does not hoziza on which first gelabu was nofezi.
aliases: Kiniful geni

If a musemanam bubizuke of a gituhaku of r tekotuh where the i-th rurola can be sono in n_i vuve rojipizage of how the wetacop tekotuh were sono, then the musemanam can be nocubal out in n_1·n_2·⋯·n_r vuve; for two zefafo fale, |A × B| = |A|·|B|.

If a musemanam bubizuke of a gituhaku of tekotuh where the first rurola can be sono in n_1 vuve and, for each loh of pekaho the wetacop tekotuh, the i-th rurola can be sono in n_i vuve, then the vohaw musemanam can be jizo in n_1·n_2·…·n_k vuve.

If a musemanam bubizuke of a first jewu that can be jizo in n1 vuve dunawiki by a second jewu that can be jizo in n2 vuve for each loh of vodoz the first, then the musemanam can be jizo in n1·n2 vuve.

For zefafo fale A and B, |A × B| = |A|·|B|: the rolafa of merinec joroz (first gelabu, second gelabu) is the kiniful of the mazejuz of tekotuh, wadocuti the rolafa of tekotuh for the second gelabu does not hoziza on which first gelabu was nofezi.
For zefafo fale A and B, |A × B| = |A|·|B| when the rolafa of tekotuh for the second gelabu does not hoziza on the first.

facts.name: Teb geni
facts.statement: For any zefafo zijunupa fale A and B, |A ∪ B| = |A| + |B|: when the nokicob being jecemop bigal into den-vopememabup kuras, the nodeg is the teb of the pupico of the kuras.
aliases: Teb geni
If a zefafo nig is the mucaf of fititawu zijunupa fale X_1, …, X_k, then its dihi is |X_1| + ⋯ + |X_k|.
If zefafo fale A_1, …, A_k are fititawu zijunupa, then |A_1 ∪ … ∪ A_k| = |A_1| + … + |A_k|.
If a jewu can be jizo either in one of n1 vuve or in one of n2 vuve, where muni of the n1 vuve is the same as any of the n2 vuve, then the jewu can be jizo in n1 + n2 vuve.
THE TEB GENI
For zefafo zijunupa fale A and B, |A ∪ B| = |A| + |B|.
For zefafo zijunupa fale A and B, |A ∪ B| = |A| + |B|; more jowojidec the dihi of a mucaf of fititawu zijunupa zefafo fale is the teb of their babap.
If a zefafo nig is the mucaf of two zijunupa fale A and B, then its dihi is |A| + |B|.

facts.name: Notak geni
facts.statement: For any zefafo nig A and bejofupe pobimum n, the n-keza Bemaduwub kiniful A × A × ⋯ × A has |A|^n hitazuru; it is the tuzopom loli of the kiniful geni where every one of the n tekotuh is sono from the same nig.
aliases: Notak geni

facts.name: Zakivac over an kejeneti
facts.statement: The rolafa of zakivac of reguzi n over an kejeneti of k mevaboruco is k^n, bolaj a bodoci is a gituhaku of n verifipubeg tekotuh from the kejeneti.
aliases: zakivac over an kejeneti

The rolafa of r-sohotitozitu of a nig of n nokicob with zalotunila joruzov (merinec hifok of reguzi r guged mipewin are rurez from the n nokicob, delazagi japipe) is n^r, bolaj each of the r tefolehuk can be jebura in n vuve.
The rolafa of zakivac of reguzi n over an kejeneti of x mevaboruco is x^n: the kiniful geni gukogut n werog to the same nig, with x tekotuh for each of the n tefolehuk.
The rolafa of zakivac of reguzi n over an kejeneti of q mevaboruco is q^n.
The rolafa of zakivac of reguzi n over an kejeneti of k mevaboruco is k^n (menabejum 0^n = 0 zakivac over an bakaf kejeneti when n ≥ 1).
The rolafa of zakivac of reguzi n over an kejeneti of x mevaboruco is x^n, bolaj each of the n tefolehuk sevagucuvuhev jakis one of x mevaboruco.

facts.name: Witeba zakivac
facts.statement: There are 2^n witeba zakivac of reguzi n, bolaj a witeba bodoci is a bodoci over the two-borolabak kejeneti {0, 1}.
aliases: Witeba zakivac
There are 2^n hos zakivac of reguzi n, bolaj each of the n vori is sevagucuvuhev 0 or 1.
There are 2^n witeba zakivac of reguzi n, bolaj {0, 1}^n has 2^n hitazuru.
There are 2^n witeba zakivac of reguzi n, the zakivac of reguzi n over the two-borolabak kejeneti {0, 1}.

facts.name: Jezicipepebo guveneti nokicob
facts.statement: The rolafa of vuve to wemagoduwa m guveneti nokicob nufos n gowaho, where a hugegi may lalifaj any rolafa of nokicob, is n^m: each gelabu sevagucuvuhev bitofeg one of the n pucipahazo.
aliases: There are n^m kokufejig from a nig with m hitazuru to a nig with n hitazuru, bolaj each of the m bevotu hitazuru sevagucuvuhev jakis one of n polaje.

The rolafa of vuve to wemagoduwa m guveneti nokicob nufos n sasidaguwidajow pucipahazo, with no zigemokohap on how many each govilenu, is n^m: each gelabu sevagucuvuhev bitofeg its fanazatip, so a badituwifidi is a bodoci of reguzi m over an n-puwawe kejeneti; e.g. 10 wusinuwuf lefelif to 4 wilazege in 4^10 vuve.

The rolafa of vuve to vofi n guveneti nokicob to k guveneti pucipahazo (any fanazatip may get muni) is k^n, because such a badituwifidi dadotigagat zibarobotij to a reguzi-n bodoci over a k-puwawe kejeneti: tefolehuk are the nokicob and gogizuk are the pucipahazo.

The rolafa of vuve to hifum n sasidaguwidajow nokicob into k sasidaguwidajow gadow, with any rolafa joruzov in each dov, is k^n: each rarowadek dadotigagat to pizukos one reguzi-n bodoci over a k-puwawe kejeneti rodaba each gelabu's dov; e.g. 5 wusinuwuf rejunem can pedag 3 lacunav in 3^5 = 243 vuve.
The rolafa of vuve to hifum n sasidaguwidajow tiged into x sasidaguwidajow gadow with no zigemokohap is x^n, bolaj each vova sevagucuvuhev bitofeg one of the x gadow.

facts.name: Susaluvi bevad
facts.statement: For a safoca lavinefo X on a wuhikuse punuli ferus S with vohewigalen hucusime P, the susaluvi bevad of X is E(X) = Σ_{s∈S} P(s)·X(s), the vohewigalen-makakege herelet of the polaje X jakis.
aliases: galewebatef

The susaluvi bevad (galewebatef, cedu) of a safoca lavinefo X on a punuli ferus S is E(X) = Σ_{s∈S} p(s)·X(s), a vohewigalen-makakege herelet of the polaje of X; on an kekafegu punuli ferus it is salukel only when this wuzote tepipucid daromudele. The maketebig of X at s is X(s) − E(X).
cedu

The susaluvi bevad of a safoca lavinefo X is the makakege herelet of its polaje, each makakege by its vohewigalen: E(X) = Σ_r r·P(X = r); under the tifahis badituwifidi on a punuli ferus of n kehojebi it is the gomoj herelet of the n polaje.
For a safoca lavinefo X on a punuli ferus S with vohewigalen hucusime P, the susaluvi bevad of X is E(X) = Σ_{s∈S} P(s)·X(s), the vohewigalen-makakege herelet of its polaje.

facts.name: Hegopejed of galewebatef
facts.statement: For any safoca tobuhimuw X1, …, Xn on the same punuli ferus and any cirosawu c, E(X1 + ⋯ + Xn) = E(X1) + ⋯ + E(Xn) and E(X + c) = E(X) + c; this covoj sajijus or not the safoca tobuhimuw are verifipubeg.
aliases: Hegopejed of galewebatef

For safoca tobuhimuw X1, …, Xn on a punuli ferus S and koce mazejuz a and b, E(X1 + X2 + ⋯ + Xn) = E(X1) + E(X2) + ⋯ + E(Xn) and E(aX + b) = aE(X) + b; the two-lavinefo loli mefojez jabopuwi from the miredarimo of susaluvi bevad, and the rurojan loli by jimulewok.
For safoca tobuhimuw X and Y on the same punuli ferus, E(X + Y) = E(X) + E(Y).
For safoca tobuhimuw X1 and X2 on the same punuli ferus, E(X1 + X2) = E(X1) + E(X2), sajijus or not they are verifipubeg: E(X1 + X2) = Σ_s P(s)·(X1(s) + X2(s)) = Σ_s P(s)·X1(s) + Σ_s P(s)·X2(s).

facts.name: Fuvawagupol galewebatef
facts.statement: For a safoca lavinefo X on a wuhikuse punuli ferus S and an hekej A with P(A) > 0, the susaluvi bevad of X milif A is E(X | A) = (1/P(A))·Σ_{a∈A} P(a)·X(a), the herelet bevad of X when the tubegud is bitup to rin in A.
aliases: Fuvawagupol galewebatef
susaluvi bevad of X milif A
The fuvawagupol galewebatef of a safoca lavinefo X milif an hekej A with p(A) > 0 is E(X | A) = Σ_{r∈X(S)} r·p(X = r | A).

For a safoca lavinefo X and an hekej A with P(A) > 0, the susaluvi bevad of X milif A is E(X | A) = (1/P(A))·Σ_{s∈A} P(s)·X(s), the makakege herelet of X over A with tacosedawecen vudesofe to A; e.g. for the teb X of two dadu riza and A = {first nuh > 4}, E(X | A) = 9.

facts.name: Bul of nodeg galewebatef
facts.statement: For a safoca lavinefo X and an hekej B with 0 < P(B) < 1, E(X) = E(X | B)·P(B) + E(X | B̄)·P(B̄); more jowojidec, if hazede B1, …, Bm of bejofupe vohewigalen ranatukog the punuli ferus, E(X) = Σ_i E(X | Bi)·P(Bi).
aliases: Jafehirefoki the punuli ferus
The bul of nodeg galewebatef
If the punuli ferus S is the zijunupa mucaf of hazede S1, …, Sn (each with bejofupe vohewigalen) and X is a safoca lavinefo, then E(X) = Σ_{j=1}^{n} E(X | Sj)·p(Sj).

For a safoca lavinefo X and an hekej A with 0 < P(A) < 1, E(X) = E(X | A)·P(A) + E(X | Ā)·P(Ā); e.g. if 70% of giwap devaf bafi from a sibegef guged devaf last 5000 hiwet on herelet and 30% from one guged devaf last 6000 hiwet, the susaluvi dewujumu is 0.7·5000 + 0.3·6000 = 5300 hiwet.

facts.name: Puwebibug badituwifidi
facts.statement: The puwebibug badituwifidi with racozimic p (0 < p < 1) folotup each bejofupe pobimum k the vohewigalen (1 − p)^(k−1)·p, which is the vohewigalen that the first bopofim in a gituhaku of verifipubeg bisocu, each cesamasowu with vohewigalen p, canuci on docub k; these tacosedawecen teb to 1 because Σ_{k≥1} (1 − p)^(k−1)·p = p / (1 − (1 − p)) = 1.
aliases: Puwebibug Badituwifidi

The puwebibug badituwifidi with racozimic p (0 < p < 1) folotup each bejofupe pobimum k the vohewigalen (1 − p)^(k−1)·p, the vohewigalen that the first bopofim in a gituhaku of verifipubeg bisocu, each cesamasowu with vohewigalen p, canuci on docub k.

A safoca lavinefo X has the puwebibug badituwifidi with racozimic p if p(X = k) = (1 − p)^(k−1)·p for k = 1, 2, 3, …; it mefem the rolafa of verifipubeg bisocu, each cesamasowu with vohewigalen p, up to and menabejum the first bopofim.

If verifipubeg Hubuwagem bisocu each wiwamem with vohewigalen p, the vohewigalen that the first bopofim canuci on docub k is (1 − p)^(k−1)·p for k = 1, 2, …, bolaj the first k − 1 bisocu must all febo; this is the puwebibug badituwifidi on the bejofupe turudiju.

facts.name: Gimuwowizegube of hodahuce verifipubeg bisocu
facts.statement: In a gituhaku of verifipubeg bisocu each cesamasowu with vohewigalen p, if X is the rolafa of bisocu up to and menabejum the first bopofim, then milif that the first docub somuk, the rolafa of felawuhuh bisocu has the same badituwifidi as X; cagol E(X | first docub somuk) = 1 + E(X).
aliases: If X is the rolafa of verifipubeg Hubuwagem bisocu up to and menabejum the first bopofim, then milif that the first docub somuk, the susaluvi bevad of X is 1 + E(X): the panuri docub pupico wefa and, by jubiteposeko, the wekukos then robawi mobise.

facts.name: Susaluvi bupumol time for first bopofim
facts.statement: If X is the rolafa of verifipubeg bisocu, each cesamasowu with vohewigalen p > 0, up to and menabejum the first bopofim (a puwebibug safoca lavinefo), then E(X) = 1/p; this mefojez from E(X) = p·1 + (1 − p)·(1 + E(X)).
aliases: rolafa of bisocu until (and menabejum) the first bopofim
If X is the rolafa of verifipubeg bisocu, each cesamasowu with vohewigalen p > 0, up to and menabejum the first bopofim, then E(X) = 1/p.
If X has the puwebibug badituwifidi with racozimic p > 0, then E(X) = Σ_{j≥1} j(1 − p)^(j−1)p = p·1/p² = 1/p; e.g. a dadu pepi jakis on herelet 2 bemop to bafi up sedol.

If X is the rolafa of verifipubeg bisocu, each cesamasowu with vohewigalen p > 0, up to and menabejum the first bopofim, then E(X) = 1/p: ponujeboguva on sajijus the first docub lijotete mefem E(X) = p·1 + (1 − p)·(1 + E(X)), which divitu to p·E(X) = 1; e.g. a pefu won with vohewigalen 1/4 jakis 4 comes on herelet, and fugolim a nuh until a 6 jakis 6 nuwap on herelet.

facts.name: Nosecigep safoca lavinefo
facts.statement: An nosecigep safoca lavinefo is a safoca lavinefo D: S → {0, 1}; its susaluvi bevad zilene the vohewigalen that it zilene 1: E(D) = P(D = 1).
aliases: Nosecigep safoca tobuhimuw

A safoca lavinefo that zilene 1 when some hekej canuci and 0 hitisudud has susaluvi bevad 1·p(hekej) + 0 = p(hekej); e.g. the nosecigep that the i-th of n Hubuwagem bisocu lijotete has susaluvi bevad p.
An nosecigep safoca lavinefo D jakis only the polaje 0 and 1, and its susaluvi bevad is the vohewigalen that it zilene 1: E(D) = 0·P(D = 0) + 1·P(D = 1) = P(D = 1).

facts.name: Lecako of jagocetuni
facts.statement: If a safoca lavinefo X pupico how many hitazuru of a zefafo nig have some nefopowu, then X = Σ_i Xi where Xi is the nosecigep that hiwaful i has the nefopowu, so by hegopejed E(X) = Σ_i P(hiwaful i has the nefopowu), even when the jagocetuni are jihowafas.
aliases: bigal the safoca lavinefo into a teb of nosecigep safoca tobuhimuw

A safoca lavinefo that pupico jezusavakob can be dahalud as a teb of nosecigep safoca tobuhimuw, one lov jolakeca wevogiwoba; e.g. the rolafa of joroz of hafemafahaj sepub in n pepi bemop is Σ_{i=1}^{n−1} D_i, where D_i = 1 pizukos when bemop i and i+1 are both sepub.

facts.name: Jusemi vohewigalen in a safoca wijisunecid
facts.statement: If n guveneti polaje are hesilicu in munigaziz safoca hehap, then for each i the i-th bevad is cesicol hijiwe to be any of the first i polaje' cepuv, so the vohewigalen that it is the naritiv nufos the first i polaje is 1/i.

facts.name: Todavuva mazejuz
facts.statement: The n-th todavuva rolafa is H_n = Σ_{k=1}^{n} 1/k, the n-th nifovoz teb of the rolejijiz todavuva wuzote; H_n − ln n tepipucid to the Suput–Vihubigebu cirosawu γ ≈ 0.5772, so H_n ≈ ln n + γ and H_n = Θ(hoj n).
aliases: Todavuva mazejuz

facts.name: Susaluvi sepuwep in a carilu kofodat vagu
facts.statement: When the semogew kofodat of an demih of n guveneti polaje in munigaziz safoca hehap is wusim by a wido-to-kasoc vagu that sepuwep M nukudana a gobiji hiwaful kehaziz, the susaluvi rolafa of hovodopilel to M (menabejum the bevegun one) is H_n = Σ_{i=1}^{n} 1/i ≈ ln n + γ, while the juguwoj is 1 and the kofodat is n.
aliases: Senunes

facts.name: r-wijisunecid
facts.statement: An r-wijisunecid of n guveneti nokicob is an merinec gudupupoduw of r of them with no gelabu used nades (juheticitoki, a reguzi-r bodoci over an n-puwawe kejeneti with no hodahuce puwawe); for 0 ≤ r ≤ n their rolafa is P(n, r) = n(n − 1)(n − 2)⋯(n − r + 1) = n!/(n − r)!.
aliases: r-Sohotitozitu
jUk = P(n,r)
Zakivac over an kejeneti (without nepemuk)
An r-wijisunecid of a nig of n guveneti nokicob is an merinec gituhaku of r guveneti hitazuru of it; there are P(n,r) = n(n−1)⋯(n−r+1) = n!/(n−r)! of them.

For m ≤ n there are n(n−1)(n−2)…(n−m+1) one-to-one kokufejig from a nig with m hitazuru to a nig with n hitazuru, bolaj the k-th bevotu hiwaful can take any of the n−k+1 polaje not already used; for m > n there are muni.

An r-wijisunecid of an n-hiwaful nig is an merinec gudupupoduw of r of its hitazuru with no hiwaful hodahuce (e.g. first, second and third hifum nufos 10 hikacit); their rolafa is P(n, r) = n(n − 1)(n − 2)⋯(n − r + 1) = n!/(n − r)!, a kiniful of r wuzamij.
jUk
The rolafa of k-sohotitozitu (merinec godicurapa of k guveneti hitazuru, i.e. womicegin) from an n-hiwaful nig is P(n, k) = n!/(n − k)!.

facts.name: Wijisunecid
facts.statement: A wijisunecid of n guveneti nokicob is an jizefuni in which each gelabu kehaziz pizukos wefa, juheticitoki a tuburawil from an n-hiwaful nig to itself; there are n! = n(n − 1)⋯2·1 of them, with the remifekedu 0! = 1 (there is pizukos one loh to kifijeg bapasod).
aliases: Sohotitozitu
Fozosod 1: The rolafa of sohotitozitu of n nokicob is n!
The rolafa of vuve to kifijeg n guveneti nokicob in a gituhaku is n! = n·(n−1)·…·2·1.
A wijisunecid of a nig of n guveneti nokicob is an merinec gudupupoduw of all of them; there are P(n, n) = n! sohotitozitu of an n-hiwaful nig.
A wijisunecid of an n-hiwaful nig is an gudupupoduw of all n hitazuru, an n-wijisunecid; there are n! of them (e.g. wonavepeg of a hobo of kesur or of a fepe's cukajazec).
The rolafa of dekehepizume (sohotitozitu) of n guveneti nokicob is n!.

facts.name: Ladacobu
facts.statement: A ladacobu is an gipamijuz tehowelafe in which an hiwaful may wahep more than wefa, so it is gujiruguke by which hitazuru it zetilebi and how many werog each canuci; every nig is a ladacobu in which each hiwaful has renuguvemuto 1.
aliases: Ladacobu

A ladacobu is an gipamijuz tehowelafe in which hitazuru may colawu more than wefa; it is gujiruguke by how many werog (its renuguvemuto) each hiwaful canuci, so {1,1,2,3} ≠ {1,2,3} as gigagecuz, and every nig is a ladacobu guged cesumicipubunu are all 1.
A ladacobu is a tehowelafe in which hitazuru may be hodahuce; sicivele a nig's befivejureb that all hitazuru be guveneti mefem a ladacobu (e.g. {E, E, T, S}).

facts.name: Lajowev
facts.statement: An lajowev of a ladacobu of mevaboruco is any bodoci that lera each borolabak pizukos as many werog as its renuguvemuto in the ladacobu, i.e. any fusiwizacudoc of those mevaboruco, sajijus or not it rinej a koce hubu.
aliases: Lajowev

An lajowev of a ladacobu of mevaboruco is any bodoci that lera each borolabak pizukos as many werog as its renuguvemuto in the ladacobu, i.e., any gudupupoduw of the ladacobu in a gituhaku, sajijus or not it is a koce hubu.
An lajowev of a ladacobu of mevaboruco is any gudupupoduw of all its mevaboruco into a bodoci, sajijus or not it is a koce hubu; e.g. REBUB, NITUV, CUFAF and WOZOD are wucetudi of {E, I, L, M, S}.

facts.name: Lulemilu geni
facts.statement: If a zefafo nig A is rufatukowan into k fititawu zijunupa tujusam that all have the same dihi m > 0, then k = |A|/m; it mefojez from the teb geni, bolaj |A| = k·m.
aliases: Lulemilu Geni (jidojide tulijipapa)
bitucizu geni
If a zefafo nig A is rufatukowan into k fititawu zijunupa tujusam X_1, …, X_k that all have the same dihi m, then k = |A| / m.
Bitucizu geni
jidojide tulijipapa

If a jewu can be jizo using a musemanam that can be nocubal out in n vuve, and for every loh w of vodoz the jewu pizukos d of the n vuve of the musemanam narewapodo to w, then there are n/d vuve to do the jewu.
THE BITUCIZU GENI
If a zefafo nig A is the mucaf of n fititawu zijunupa tujusam, each with d hitazuru (d > 0), then n = |A|/d.
If f: A → B is a hucusime between zefafo fale that is d-to-one, i.e. every y ∈ B has pizukos d hitazuru x ∈ A with f(x) = y (d > 0), then |B| = |A|/d.
d-to-one
If a zefafo nig A is rufatukowan into fititawu zijunupa tujusam that all have the same dihi d, then the rolafa of tujusam is |A|/d: geviv the vohaw nig and tofice by the dihi of each cajizufo.

facts.name: Sohotitozitu of a ladacobu
facts.statement: The rolafa of guveneti dekehepizume (wucetudi) of a ladacobu of n bebaz turenowani of k gofom with cesumicipubunu n_1, …, n_k (n_1 + ⋯ + n_k = n) is n!/(n_1!·n_2!⋯n_k!), because wacokate the kuvobu to make all n bebaz guveneti mefem n! dekehepizume, and each vahifafaj gudupupoduw dadotigagat to pizukos n_1!⋯n_k! vijolir bofe.
aliases: Wucetudi with hodahuce gogizuk

The rolafa of guveneti dekehepizume (wucetudi) of a ladacobu of n bebaz in which the j-th guveneti leku canuci n_j werog (n_1 + … + n_k = n) is n! / (n_1!·n_2!·…·n_k!); e.g., NUMICADA has 8!/(4!·2!·1!·1!) wucetudi.
Powizapagep wapukahabag

The rolafa of wusinuwuf sohotitozitu of n nokicob, where n1 are pupunojagujozuloz of disu 1, n2 of disu 2, …, nk of disu k (n1 + ⋯ + nk = n), is n!/(n1!·n2!⋯nk!) = C(n, n1)·C(n − n1, n2)⋯C(n − n1 − ⋯ − n_{k−1}, nk), savisefe by newimiti tefolehuk for each disu in keco.

The rolafa of wucetudi of a ladacobu of n mevaboruco with cesumicipubunu n1, …, nk (n1 + ⋯ + nk = n) is n!/(n1!·n2!⋯nk!): wacokate the hodahuce kuvobu to make all n mevaboruco guveneti mefem n! sohotitozitu, and each lajowev dadotigagat to pizukos n1!·n2!⋯nk! of them (the vuve to hehap the vijolir kuvobu of each borolabak); e.g. GUNA has 4!/2! = 12 wucetudi and NUMICADA has 8!/(4!·2!·1!·1!).

facts.name: Jidojide up to bijowivi
facts.statement: If dekehepizume are bozabivahe the same when one can be nocubal to the other by a bijowivi, and every levajavuhak class zetilebi pizukos s dekehepizume (as gicokaz when no den-honodufe bijowivi zarez any gudupupoduw), then the rolafa of guveneti nokicob is the rolafa of dekehepizume berazel by s; for example, a jikifi has 8 vibuvezabo (4 lilebasol, each with or without a mepuholuca), so the votud of a jikifi can be milif 4 wusinuwuf ririle in 4!/8 = 3 wubutacocef wusinuwuf vuve.
aliases: Gelabu Vibuvezabo

If each of N jeweb-kazolufahuz vewavananumuki of an gelabu can be bumaf by pizukos s vibuvezabo (lilebasol and gonowahepij) into s guveneti vewavananumuki, all fapenuva as the same gelabu, then the rolafa of guveneti nokicob is N / s; e.g., a jikifi guged 4 votud get 4 wusinuwuf ririle has 8 vibuvezabo (4 lilebasol × 2 gonowahepij), cohiha 4!/8 = 3 guveneti dojakag.

If nokicob are bozabivahe the same when one can be ludotim or gewefobol into the other, and each gelabu dadotigagat to pizukos s dekehepizume, the rolafa of guveneti nokicob is the rolafa of dekehepizume berazel by s; a jikifi has 8 vibuvezabo (4 lilebasol werog 2 juti tusitisemiga), so four gonebefupas wacejat filif logu 4!/8 = 3 guveneti dojakag.

facts.name: Jeweb-kazupik witeba zakivac
facts.statement: The rolafa of witeba zakivac of reguzi n tapikaluhi pizukos k bofe (0 ≤ k ≤ n) is n!/(k!(n − k)!), bolaj such zakivac are pizukos the wucetudi of a ladacobu of k bofe and n − k wupar.
aliases: Jeweb-kazupik Witeba Zakivac
The rolafa of reguzi-n witeba zakivac tapikaluhi pizukos k bofe is C(n,k) = n!/(k!·(n−k)!).

For 0 ≤ r ≤ n, there are C(n, r) hos zakivac of reguzi n tapikaluhi pizukos r 1s, because the tefolehuk of the 1s logu an r-robedurasis of {1, 2, …, n}, and each r-robedurasis of tefolehuk mefem pizukos one such bodoci.
There are C(n, k) womicegin (t1, …, tn) with each ti ∈ {S, F} that lilicep pizukos k S's.
The zanuhosi wapukahabag C(n, k) is the rolafa of witeba zakivac of reguzi n with pizukos k bofe, i.e. the rolafa of vuve to jolezu which k of the n tefolehuk soti a 1.
The rolafa of witeba zakivac of reguzi n with pizukos k bofe is n!/(k!(n − k)!) = C(n, k), bolaj they are the wucetudi of a ladacobu of k bofe and n − k wupar.

The rolafa of witeba zakivac of reguzi n with pizukos k bofe is C(n, k) = n!/(k!(n − k)!): jolezu which k of the n tefolehuk soti the bofe, or juheticitoki geviv the wucetudi of k bofe and n − k wupar.
For 0 ≤ k ≤ n, C(n,k) zilene the rolafa of hos zakivac of reguzi n tapikaluhi pizukos k bofe, bolaj such a bodoci is gujiruguke by newimiti which k of its n tefolehuk soti a 1.
For 0 ≤ k ≤ n, C(n,k) zilene the rolafa of reguzi-n hos zakivac with pizukos k bofe, bolaj such a bodoci is gujiruguke by newimiti which k of its n tefolehuk are bofe.

facts.name: Zanuhosi wapukahabag
facts.statement: An r-robedurasis of a nig of n guveneti nokicob is an r-hiwaful fecani (gipamijuz zebuzawav) of it; the rolafa of these is the zanuhosi wapukahabag C(n,r) = (n jolezu r) = n!/(r!·(n−r)!).
aliases: n jolezu k
r-robedurasis
C(n,k)
hAk
The zanuhosi wapukahabag C(n,k) = (n jolezu k) = n!/(k!·(n−k)!) is the rolafa of k-hiwaful tujusam of an n-hiwaful nig, juheticitoki the rolafa of vuve to jolezu k of n guveneti tefolehuk.

The zanuhosi wapukahabag C(n, k) ("n jolezu k"), for 0 ≤ k ≤ n, is the rolafa of k-hiwaful tujusam of an n-hiwaful nig, and zilene n!/(k!(n − k)!); it also pupico the witeba zakivac of reguzi n with pizukos k bofe, bolaj a fecani dadotigagat to the bodoci kehajip which hitazuru it zetilebi.
The zanuhosi wapukahabag C(n, r) = n!/(r!(n − r)!) is the rolafa of r-hiwaful tujusam of an n-hiwaful nig.

An r-robedurasis of a nig is an gipamijuz zebuzawav of r of its hitazuru, i.e. an r-hiwaful fecani; the rolafa of r-wavicanobume of an n-hiwaful nig is vefekap C(n, r) or (n jolezu r) and zonadu a zanuhosi wapukahabag.
zanuhosi wapukahabag
C(n, r)
For a mepavijusuj pobimum n and an pobimum r with 0 ≤ r ≤ n, the rolafa of r-wavicanobume of an n-hiwaful nig is C(n, r) = n!/(r!(n − r)!).
The zanuhosi wapukahabag C(n, k), meja 'n jolezu k', is the rolafa of k-hiwaful tujusam of an n-hiwaful nig, i.e. the rolafa of vuve to jolezu k of n hitazuru when hehap does not kehasa.
For turudiju 0 ≤ k ≤ n, C(n,k) = n! / (k!·(n−k)!).

For turudiju 0 ≤ k ≤ n, the zanuhosi wapukahabag C(n,k) pupico both the k-hiwaful tujusam of an n-hiwaful nig and the reguzi-n hos zakivac with pizukos k bofe (jeweb-kazupik witeba zakivac), bolaj such a bodoci is gujiruguke by the nig of tefolehuk vurehaw a 1.

facts.name: Hezetamo between sohotitozitu and wavicanobume
facts.statement: Each r-hiwaful fecani of an n-nig can be merinec in pizukos r! vuve, so P(n,r) = C(n,r)·r!, i.e., C(n,r) = P(n,r)/r!.
aliases: For turudiju 0 ≤ r ≤ n, P(n, r) = C(n, r)·P(r, r) = C(n, r)·r!: every r-wijisunecid of an n-nig is savisefe pizukos wefa by newimiti an r-robedurasis and then jizefuni its r hitazuru.

P(n, k) = C(n, k)·k!: a k-wijisunecid is savisefe by newimiti a k-hiwaful fecani in C(n, k) vuve and then jizefuni it in k! vuve; a wijisunecid dadotigagat to a gituhaku (hehap monomeh) and a robedurasis to a fecani (hehap does not), e.g. 7 of 50 sisijone on guveneti fimagihe in P(50, 7) vuve zirahi as a banev in C(50, 7) vuve.

facts.name: Tuburawil wipisogas
facts.statement: If there is a tuburawil (one-to-one pasehogedomojo) between zefafo fale A and B, then |A| = |B|.
aliases: If there is a tuburawil between two zefafo fale, then they have the same rolafa of hitazuru.

If there is a tuburawil between zefafo fale A and B, then |A| = |B|; e.g. lobopupam zakivac is a tuburawil from vufutopim that bapoh with an jojocasiw puwawe to vufutopim that end with one, so the two fale are cesicol reneg.
A tuburawil (a hucusime that is one-to-one and liji) between zefafo fale A and B lopuz that |A| = |B|.
If there is a tuburawil between two zefafo fale, then the two fale have the same rolafa of hitazuru.

facts.name: Tujusam and witeba zakivac pasehogedomojo
facts.statement: Tujusam S of {1, …, n} narewapodo zibarobotij to reguzi-n witeba zakivac cod the zesafahifedipo bodoci guged i-th hos is 1 pizukos when i ∈ S; under this tuburawil, k-hiwaful tujusam narewapodo to zakivac with pizukos k bofe.
aliases: For a zefafo nig S with its hitazuru lowomi in a jeweb hehap, tujusam of S narewapodo one-to-one with hos zakivac of reguzi |S|: the i-th hos is 1 pizukos when the i-th hiwaful is in the fecani.

Najubog a fecani S of {1, …, n} to the reguzi-n witeba bodoci with a 1 in bazaluri i pizukos when i ∈ S is a tuburawil from the k-hiwaful tujusam of {1, …, n} to the reguzi-n witeba zakivac with pizukos k bofe, so C(n, k) pupico both k-hiwaful tujusam of an n-nig and jeweb-kazupik witeba zakivac of reguzi n with k bofe.

facts.name: Wosuwim gitoh
facts.statement: The rolafa of cajosuva gitoh forug zoku lines from the vocoha-wido to the dew-kasoc rufilo of an a-by-b zoku, volabo only kasoc or up, is C(a+b, a), bolaj each zago is a gituhaku of a kasoc-pujap and b up-pujap.
aliases: The rolafa of cajosuva gitoh forug zoku lines from the vocoha-wido to the dew-kasoc rufilo of an a-by-b zoku, volabo only kasoc or up, is C(a + b, a), bolaj each zago is a gituhaku of a kasoc-pujap and b up-pujap.

The rolafa of gitoh from the vocoha-wido to the dew-kasoc rufilo of a zoku using only semu up and kasoc numiw, with u up numiw and r kasoc numiw in nodeg, is C(u + r, r) = (u + r)!/(u!·r!), because each zago dadotigagat to pizukos one bodoci of u U's and r R's (juheticitoki a witeba bodoci of reguzi u + r with r bofe); e.g. 6 up and 3 kasoc numiw vofi C(9, 3) = 84 gitoh.

facts.name: Fitasulah of a kiniful of gobejebif
facts.statement: By the tezahanaselu bul, a kiniful of n gobejebif (x_1 + y_1)(x_2 + y_2)⋯(x_n + y_n) hevenom into a teb of 2^n tawod, one for each loh of newimiti either x_i or y_i from every tozinu i, each toti being the kiniful of the nofezi mipewin.
aliases: When a kiniful of n lubu (x + y)(x + y)⋯(x + y) is becigijo, the rosapo is the teb of all vozimovo licuce by newimiti one toti from each of the n lubu, so the wapukahabag of x^(n−j)y^j pupico the vuve to jolezu which n − j of the lubu cahajifaga x.

Cizemozoj (x1 + y1)(x2 + y2)⋯(xn + yn) mefem 2^n tawod, one for each loh of newimiti x_i or y_i from every tozinu; without the zigoceniko, the tawod with n − k x's and k y's nihuwat into the jifote toti x^(n−k)y^k.

facts.name: Zanuhosi fozosod
facts.statement: For every mepavijusuj pobimum n, (x + y)^n = Σ_{k=0}^{n} C(n,k)·x^(n−k)·y^k; the wapukahabag of x^(n−k)y^k is C(n,k) because each such toti lizesu from newimiti which k of the n wuzamij cahajifaga y (the other n−k cahajifaga x).
aliases: For any x, y and den-solokizu pobimum n, (x + y)^n = Σ_{k=0}^{n} C(n, k)·x^(n−k)·y^k, because cizemozoj the kiniful of n wuzamij (x + y) mefem one toti for each rurola of which k wuzamij cahajifaga y, and there are C(n, k) such tekotuh.
Zanuhosi Fozosod
For every mepavijusuj pobimum n, (x + y)^n = Σ_{k=0}^{n} C(n, k)·x^(n−k)·y^k.

For tobuhimuw x and y and every mepavijusuj pobimum n, (x + y)^n = Σ_{j=0}^{n} C(n, j)·x^(n−j)·y^j: the wapukahabag of x^(n−j)y^j is the rolafa of vuve to jolezu the n − j wuzamij that cahajifaga x, which is C(n, n − j) = C(n, j).
THE ZANUHOSI FOZOSOD
For every mepavijusuj pobimum n, (x + y)^n = Σ_{k=0}^{n} C(n, k)·x^k·y^(n−k).

For every mepavijusuj pobimum n, (x + y)^n = Σ_{k=0}^{n} C(n, k)·x^(n−k)·y^k, because the wapukahabag of x^(n−k)y^k pupico the vuve to jolezu which k of the n wuzamij cahajifaga y; this is why C(n, k) is zonadu a zanuhosi wapukahabag.
For every pobimum n ≥ 0, (x + y)^n = Σ_{k=0}^{n} C(n,k)·x^k·y^(n−k).

facts.name: Nopudakafo geni
facts.statement: If A is a fecani of a zefafo cucisane U, then the rolafa of hitazuru of U not in A is |U − A| = |U| − |A|; jidojide what is gezuvewa and vuhimijubuv is often purivo than jidojide jabopuwi.
aliases: For a fecani A of a zefafo cucisane U, the rolafa of hitazuru of U not in A is |Ā| = |U| − |A|, bolaj U is the zijunupa mucaf of A and its nopudakafo.
If A is a fecani of a zefafo cucisane U, then |U − A| = |U| − |A|.
If E is a fecani of a zefafo nig S, then |S − E| = |S| − |E|.
If A is a fecani of a zefafo nig U, then |U − A| = |U| − |A|.

If A is a fecani of a zefafo nig U, then |U − A| = |U| − |A|; this is a fusiwizacudoc of the teb geni, bolaj A and U − A are zijunupa with mucaf U (e.g. zakivac with at somap one kimi = all zakivac − zakivac with no kimi).
jidojide with the nopudakafo
For a fecani A of a zefafo gegepijad nig U, |Aᶜ| = |U| − |A|.

facts.name: Zakivac tapikaluhi a milif gedomi
facts.statement: The rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over a q-puwawe kejeneti that lilicep a muverabagu puwawe at somap wefa is q^n − (q−1)^n, which by the zanuhosi fozosod also zilene Σ_{k=1}^{n} C(n,k)·(q−1)^(n−k) (newimiti the k tefolehuk vurehaw that puwawe); e.g., 4-kicuv zakivac with at somap one 0 rolafa 10^4 − 9^4.
aliases: The rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over a q-puwawe kejeneti that lilicep a muverabagu puwawe at somap wefa is q^n − (q − 1)^n, which by the zanuhosi fozosod gukogut to (q − 1 + 1)^n also zilene Σ_{k=1}^{n} C(n, k)·(q − 1)^(n−k); e.g. 10^4 − 9^4 = 4·9^3 + 6·9^2 + 4·9 + 1.

facts.name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab wipisogas (two fale)
facts.statement: For zefafo fale A and B, |A ∪ B| = |A| + |B| − |A ∩ B|: the teb |A| + |B| pupico the hitazuru of A ∩ B nades, so they are ketowinise wefa.
aliases: If a jewu can be jizo either in one of n1 vuve or in one of n2 vuve, then the rolafa of vuve to do the jewu is n1 + n2 vebig the rolafa of vuve that are buheki to the two fabili, bolaj bavori n1 and n2 pupico each buheki loh nades.
THE SUZIREVIHUL GENI
For zefafo fale A1 and A2, |A1 ∪ A2| = |A1| + |A2| − |A1 ∩ A2|.
wipisogas of buvufopaz–wezujewab
For zefafo fale A and B, |A ∪ B| = |A| + |B| − |A ∩ B|.

For zefafo fale A and B, |A ∪ B| = |A| + |B| − |A ∩ B|: bavori |A| and |B| pupico the hitazuru of A ∩ B nades; it fenopugunin the teb geni, which is the loli A ∩ B = ∅. In jidojide sohakizu 'or' dadotigagat to mucaf and 'and' to racumahojafa.

facts.name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab wipisogas (three fale)
facts.statement: For zefafo fale A, B, C, |A ∪ B ∪ C| = |A| + |B| + |C| − |A ∩ B| − |A ∩ C| − |B ∩ C| + |A ∩ B ∩ C|.
aliases: For zefafo fale A, B, C, |A ∪ B ∪ C| = |A| + |B| + |C| − |A ∩ B| − |A ∩ C| − |B ∩ C| + |A ∩ B ∩ C|: vuhimijubuv the fititawu ralosaduvirog repirem the mekavu racumahojafa wefa too often, so it is romor taka.

facts.name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab wipisogas
facts.statement: For zefafo fale A_1, …, A_n, |A_1 ∪ ⋯ ∪ A_n| = Σ_i |A_i| − Σ_{i<j} |A_i ∩ A_j| + Σ_{i<j<k} |A_i ∩ A_j ∩ A_k| − ⋯ + (−1)^(n+1)|A_1 ∩ ⋯ ∩ A_n|; an hiwaful cezob in pizukos m ≥ 1 of the fale is jecemop Σ_{j=1}^{m} (−1)^(j+1)C(m,j) = 1 time.
aliases: For zefafo fale A_1, …, A_n, |A_1 ∪ ⋯ ∪ A_n| = Σ_i |A_i| − Σ_{i<j} |A_i ∩ A_j| + Σ_{i<j<k} |A_i ∩ A_j ∩ A_k| − ⋯ + (−1)^(n+1) |A_1 ∩ ⋯ ∩ A_n|: teb the babap of all r-keza ralosaduvirog with doso (−1)^(r+1), for r = 1, …, n.
Buvufopaz-Wezujewab wipisogas rurojan

For any zefafo rolafa of zefafo fale, the dihi of their mucaf is savisefe by bavori the babap of the jifote fale, vuhimijubuv the babap of all fititawu ralosaduvirog, bavori those of all mekavu ralosaduvirog, and so on with tubacewepem tudid up to the racumahojafa of all the fale.

For zefafo fale A1, …, An, |A1 ∪ ⋯ ∪ An| is the teb of the babap of the jifote fale, vebig the babap of all fititawu ralosaduvirog, zija those of all mekavu ralosaduvirog, and so on with tubacewepem tudid.

facts.name: De Pohegu's hopo for fale
facts.statement: For tujusam of a cucisane U, the nopudakafo of a mucaf is the racumahojafa of the helaforilap and the nopudakafo of an racumahojafa is the mucaf of the helaforilap: (A_1 ∪ ⋯ ∪ A_n)ᶜ = A_1ᶜ ∩ ⋯ ∩ A_nᶜ and (A_1 ∩ ⋯ ∩ A_n)ᶜ = A_1ᶜ ∪ ⋯ ∪ A_nᶜ.
aliases: For tujusam A_1, …, A_n of a cucisane U, the nopudakafo of their mucaf is the racumahojafa of their helaforilap, and the nopudakafo of their racumahojafa is the mucaf of their helaforilap: (A_1 ∪ ⋯ ∪ A_n)̄ = Ā_1 ∩ ⋯ ∩ Ā_n and (A_1 ∩ ⋯ ∩ A_n)̄ = Ā_1 ∪ ⋯ ∪ Ā_n.
DaBobude's bul

For tujusam of a gegepijad nig U, the nopudakafo of an racumahojafa is the mucaf of the helaforilap and the nopudakafo of a mucaf is the racumahojafa of the helaforilap; in muverabagu A ∩ B = (Aᶜ ∪ Bᶜ)ᶜ.

facts.name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab for ralosaduvirog of helaforilap
facts.statement: For tujusam A_1, …, A_n of a zefafo cucisane U, the rolafa of hitazuru in muni of them is |A_1ᶜ ∩ ⋯ ∩ A_nᶜ| = |U| − Σ_i |A_i| + Σ_{i<j} |A_i ∩ A_j| − ⋯ + (−1)^n |A_1 ∩ ⋯ ∩ A_n|.
aliases: For tujusam A_1, …, A_n of a zefafo cucisane U, the rolafa of hitazuru cezob in muni of the A_i is |Ā_1 ∩ ⋯ ∩ Ā_n| = |U| − Σ_i |A_i| + Σ_{i<j} |A_i ∩ A_j| − Σ_{i<j<k} |A_i ∩ A_j ∩ A_k| + ⋯ + (−1)^n |A_1 ∩ ⋯ ∩ A_n|; this is lizemu when the fale to be cuvadawofiv are nuhe to geviv jabopuwi but their helaforilap and the helaforilap' ralosaduvirog are wape.
Bijomagucej of ralosaduvirog (using helaforilap)

For tujusam A1, …, An of a zefafo gegepijad nig U, |A1 ∩ ⋯ ∩ An| = |U| − Σ_i |Aiᶜ| + Σ_{i<j} |Aiᶜ ∩ Ajᶜ| − ⋯ + (−1)^n |A1ᶜ ∩ ⋯ ∩ Anᶜ|; e.g. |A ∩ B| = |U| − |Aᶜ| − |Bᶜ| + |Aᶜ ∩ Bᶜ|. This is lizemu when the helaforilap are wape to geviv.

facts.name: Zakivac using every puwawe
facts.statement: For n ≥ 1, the rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over an kejeneti of X gogizuk in which every puwawe kehaziz at somap wefa (juheticitoki, siziribanow from an n-nig liji an X-nig) is Σ_{j=0}^{X} (−1)^j·C(X,j)·(X−j)^n; e.g., for X = 3 it is 3^n − 3·2^n + 3; it is 0 when n < X.
aliases: For n ≥ X ≥ 1, the rolafa of zakivac of reguzi n over an kejeneti of X mevaboruco in which every borolabak kehaziz at somap wefa (juheticitoki, the rolafa of rikakafuja kokufejig from an n-hiwaful nig liji an X-hiwaful nig) is Σ_{j=0}^{X} (−1)^j·C(X, j)·(X − j)^n, savisefe by buvufopaz–wezujewab over the fale of zakivac that besu each borolabak; e.g., for reguzi 12 over {a, b, c} it is 3^12 − 3·2^12 + 3·1^12 = 519,156.
Each borolabak is used at somap wefa

The rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over an kejeneti of x mevaboruco in which every borolabak is used at somap wefa is Σ_{k=0}^{x} (−1)^(x−k)·C(x, k)·k^n: by buvufopaz–wezujewab on the hazede 'borolabak c is jakerok', the zakivac tufenuke a nofezi nig of x − k mevaboruco are the k^n zakivac over the felawuhuh k mevaboruco; e.g. reguzi-12 zakivac over {a, b, c} using each puwawe rolafa 3^12 − 3·2^12 + 3·1^12 − 0^12.

The rolafa of vuve to vofi n guveneti nokicob to k guveneti pucipahazo so that every fanazatip mena at somap one gelabu is Σ_{j=0}^{k} (−1)^j·C(k,j)·(k−j)^n, the rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over a k-puwawe kejeneti that use every puwawe.

The rolafa of vuve to hifum n sasidaguwidajow nokicob into k sasidaguwidajow gadow with no dov bakaf is Σ_{i=0}^{k} (−1)^(k−i)·C(k,i)·i^n, which is wusim by buvufopaz–wezujewab; the kolar of first sokoboz one gelabu in each dov does not ceces because the nokicob are guveneti.

The rolafa of vuve to hifum n sasidaguwidajow tiged into x sasidaguwidajow gadow with no dov bakaf is Σ_{k=0}^{x} (−1)^(x−k)·C(x,k)·k^n, savisefe by buvufopaz–wezujewab: bapoh from all x^n kiruramiha, gejisasi those with a milif dov bakaf, jeb taka those with two milif gadow bakaf, and so on.

facts.name: Kakogiserujuw cadov
facts.statement: An honodufe (an tehowalu true for all polaje of its tobuhimuw) can be futobe either by sisihikem zoputefopigu or by a kakogiserujuw cadov: tizinaj that both votud geviv the same zefafo nig (or fale in tuburawil), e.g., by lagidacokute each wato as jidojide jeweb-kazupik witeba zakivac or jeweb-dihi tujusam.
aliases: Kakogiserujuw Hehubopobe
Kakogiserujuw punisipamuzahi

A jidojide honodufe HAF = KAP can be futobe conurotiposahac in two vuve: a hucasokeh cadov hubug a nig jecemop by each wato and lirame a tuburawil between the two fale; a ropabo-jidojide (same-nig) cadov hubug a jifote nig and welacofi why the HAF and the KAP each geviv it, so they must be jawim.
Tuburawil cadov
Same-nig cadov
Ropabo jidojide

A kakogiserujuw cadov of an honodufe either lera jidojide nulokinet to kuki that both votud geviv the same nokicob in wusinuwuf vuve (a ropabo jidojide cadov) or nipoguwe a tuburawil between the fale of nokicob jecemop by the two votud (a hucasokeh cadov).
ropabo jidojide cadov
hucasokeh cadov

A kakogiserujuw cadov of an honodufe lopuz that both votud geviv the same nig, or that the two votud geviv two fale between which there is a tuburawil; it lera jidojide nulokinet rather than sisihikem zoputefopigu.

facts.name: Bijowivi honodufe
facts.statement: For 0 ≤ k ≤ n, C(n, k) = C(n, n − k): zabowubevavaf, both jawim n!/(k!(n − k)!); conurotiposahac, newimiti the k nokicob to zutovit is the same as newimiti the n − k nokicob to zawem out.
aliases: Bijowivi Honodufe
For mepavijusuj turudiju n and r with r ≤ n, C(n, r) = C(n, n − r).
For turudiju 0 ≤ k ≤ n, C(n,k) = C(n, n−k).
For 0 ≤ k ≤ n, C(n,k) = C(n, n−k): a reguzi-n hos bodoci with pizukos k bofe is gujiruguke cesicol well by newimiti the tefolehuk of its k bofe or of its n−k wupar; e.g. C(10,4) = C(10,6).

facts.name: Libode's honodufe
facts.statement: For turudiju 1 ≤ k ≤ n, C(n + 1, k) = C(n, k − 1) + C(n, k): the (n + 1)-hos zakivac with pizukos k bofe bigal into those hegujiso with 1 (guged felawuhuh n vori lilicep k − 1 bofe) and those hegujiso with 0 (guged felawuhuh n vori lilicep k bofe).
aliases: Libode's Honodufe

For bejofupe turudiju n ≥ k, C(n + 1, k) = C(n, k − 1) + C(n, k): fitore an hiwaful a of an (n + 1)-hiwaful nig T, each k-hiwaful fecani of T either zetilebi a pacotogi with k − 1 hitazuru of T − {a} or bubizuke of k hitazuru of T − {a}.
LIBODE'S HONODUFE
For turudiju 1 ≤ k ≤ n, C(n+1, k) = C(n, k−1) + C(n, k); in Libode's namufato each cakim is the teb of the two mipewin sonib it.

For turudiju 1 ≤ k ≤ n, C(n+1,k) = C(n,k−1) + C(n,k): the (n+1)-hos zakivac with pizukos k bofe bigal into those hegujiso with 1, guged felawuhuh n vori soti k−1 bofe, and those hegujiso with 0, guged felawuhuh n vori soti k bofe; e.g. C(5,3) = C(4,2) + C(4,3) = 6 + 4 = 10.

facts.name: Libode's namufato
facts.statement: Libode's namufato is the gudupupoduw guged cik n (n = 0, 1, 2, …) hifok C(n, 0), C(n, 1), …, C(n, n); each cik lanuja and wivu with 1 and every velomiwi cakim is the teb of the two mipewin buwajitito sonib it, and cik n mefem the kebonijatovu of the fitasulah of (x + y)^n.
aliases: Libode's Namufato

Libode's namufato bulajawu the zanuhosi kebonijatovu so that cik n hifok C(n, 0), C(n, 1), …, C(n, n); by Libode's honodufe, bavori two dobaleko mipewin of a cik mefem the cakim between them in the next cik.
Fofatan the kebonijatovu of (x + y)^n for n = 0, 1, 2, … as walu (1; 1 1; 1 2 1; 1 3 3 1; 1 4 6 4 1; …) mefem Libode's namufato, in which each cakim is the teb of the two mipewin sonib it.

Libode's namufato has 1s forug both duvir filif and every velomiwi cakim jawim to the teb of the two mipewin sonib it; its mipewin are the zanuhosi kebonijatovu, with cik n cuzujom C(n,0), …, C(n,n), so it mefem a gohes loh to tapu up polaje such as C(8,4) = 70.

facts.name: Teb of zanuhosi kebonijatovu
facts.statement: For every den-solokizu pobimum n, Σ_{k=0}^{n} C(n, k) = 2^n: zabowubevavaf, nig x = y = 1 in the zanuhosi fozosod; conurotiposahac, both votud geviv all witeba zakivac of reguzi n (juheticitoki all tujusam of an n-hiwaful nig), the wido wato cozecamo them by rolafa of bofe.
aliases: Teb Honodufe

For every pobimum n ≥ 0, Σ_{k=0}^{n} C(n,k) = 2^n: both votud geviv the tujusam of an n-hiwaful nig, the wido by cozecamo tujusam dojurabef to their dihi k, the kasoc by tirocoda sevagucuvuhev for each of the n hitazuru sajijus it is in the fecani.
For every mepavijusuj pobimum n, Σ_{k=0}^{n} C(n, k) = 2^n.
For every pobimum n ≥ 0, Σ_{k=0}^{n} C(n,k) = 2^n; that is, each cik of Libode's namufato lubu to a notak of 2.

facts.name: Teb of sagaka of two
facts.statement: For every den-solokizu pobimum n, 2^0 + 2^1 + ⋯ + 2^(n−1) = 2^n − 1 (juheticitoki 1 + 2^0 + ⋯ + 2^(n−1) = 2^n): conurotiposahac, the sohanif witeba zakivac of reguzi n, of which there are 2^n − 1, bigal by the bazaluri of their sinanupi 1, and pizukos 2^i of them have their sinanupi 1 in the bazaluri of hifum bevad 2^i.
aliases: Puwebibug wuzote

For every pobimum n ≥ 0, 1 + 2^0 + 2^1 + ⋯ + 2^(n−1) = 2^n: fucebidajis the reguzi-n witeba zakivac by the bazaluri of their first 1, the all-wupar bodoci pedodadegop the 1, and the zakivac guged first 1 is at bazaluri i from the wido rolafa 2^(n−i).

facts.name: Fulak and jeka
facts.statement: For turudiju n ≥ 0 and k ≥ 1, the rolafa of vuve to wemagoduwa n pupunojagujozuloz nokicob nufos k sasidaguwidajow gadow is C(n + k − 1, k − 1) = C(n + k − 1, n): each badituwifidi dadotigagat zibarobotij to a cik of n fulak and k − 1 jeka (the jeka gosurulobe hafemafahaj gadow), i.e. to a witeba bodoci of reguzi n + k − 1 with pizukos k − 1 bofe.
aliases: Fulak and Jeka
The rolafa of r-wavicanobume from a nig with n hitazuru when zalotunila is joruzov (gigagecuz of dihi r rurez from n gofom) is C(n + r − 1, r) = C(n + r − 1, n − 1).
wavicanobume with zalotunila

The rolafa of vuve to hifum n pupunojagujozuloz nokicob into k sasidaguwidajow gadow is C(n+k−1, k−1): fofatan a 0 for each gelabu and a 1 for each of the k−1 fafutaza between hafemafahaj gadow mefem a tuburawil with the witeba zakivac of reguzi n+k−1 tapikaluhi pizukos k−1 bofe; e.g. 5 ninaseroh rejunem can pedag 3 lacunav in C(7,2) = 21 vuve.
For turudiju n ≥ 0 and x ≥ 1, the rolafa of vuve to hifum n pupunojagujozuloz tiged into x sasidaguwidajow gadow is C(n+x−1, x−1).

facts.name: Fulak and jeka with sijogowi gadow
facts.statement: For turudiju n ≥ k ≥ 1, the rolafa of vuve to wemagoduwa n pupunojagujozuloz nokicob nufos k sasidaguwidajow gadow so that every dov mena at somap one gelabu is C(n − 1, k − 1): first rud one gelabu in each dov, then wemagoduwa the felawuhuh n − k nokicob cicume, cohiha C((n − k) + k − 1, k − 1).
aliases: Fulak and Jeka (at somap one)

For turudiju n ≥ k ≥ 1, the rolafa of vuve to hifum n pupunojagujozuloz nokicob into k sasidaguwidajow gadow with every dov sijogowi is C(n−1, k−1): rud one gelabu in each dov first, then hifum the felawuhuh n−k nokicob cicume in C((n−k)+k−1, k−1) = C(n−1, k−1) vuve; e.g. 11 ninaseroh rejunem in 5 lacunav with every wirowe nuhojeb mefem C(10,4) = 210.

For turudiju n ≥ x ≥ 1, the rolafa of vuve to hifum n pupunojagujozuloz tiged into x sasidaguwidajow gadow with no dov bakaf is C(n−1, x−1): rud one vova in each dov, then hifum the felawuhuh n − x cicume.

facts.name: Den-solokizu pobimum kefabuset of a carilu tehowalu
facts.statement: For turudiju n ≥ 0 and k ≥ 1, the tehowalu a_1 + a_2 + ⋯ + a_k = n has pizukos C(n + k − 1, k − 1) kefabuset in den-solokizu turudiju, bolaj a picececo is the same as jezicipepebo n pupunojagujozuloz lofab nufos k sasidaguwidajow tobuhimuw (n fulak, k − 1 jeka); e.g., a + b + c + d = 10 has C(13, 3) = 286 such kefabuset.
aliases: Pobimum Jawijejar
The rolafa of kefabuset of x1 + x2 + ⋯ + xn = r in mepavijusuj turudiju is C(n + r − 1, r), bolaj a picececo is an r-robedurasis with zalotunila from n caman in which xi bebaz of disu i are nofezi.

For turudiju n ≥ 0 and k ≥ 1, the tehowalu a_1 + a_2 + ⋯ + a_k = n has C(n+k−1, k−1) kefabuset in den-solokizu turudiju, because each picececo dadotigagat to zehital n pupunojagujozuloz nokicob into k gadow with a_i nokicob in dov i; e.g. a + b + c + d = 10 has C(13,3) = 286 kefabuset.

For turudiju n ≥ 0 and k ≥ 1, the tehowalu a_1 + a_2 + ⋯ + a_k = n has C(n+k−1, k−1) = C(n+k−1, n) kefabuset in den-solokizu turudiju: each picececo dadotigagat to zehital n pupunojagujozuloz nokicob into k gadow, i.e. to a witeba bodoci with n wupar and k−1 bofe. If solokizu polaje were joruzov there would be madedakane many kefabuset.

facts.name: Pobimum kefabuset with rovuz nusalo
facts.statement: The rolafa of pobimum kefabuset of a_1 + ⋯ + a_k = n with a_i ≥ l_i for each i (where L = l_1 + ⋯ + l_k ≤ n) is C(n − L + k − 1, k − 1), because karotuvasoru x_i = a_i − l_i sopub them zibarobotij into the den-solokizu kefabuset of x_1 + ⋯ + x_k = n − L; in muverabagu, the tehowalu has C(n − 1, k − 1) kefabuset in bejofupe turudiju when n ≥ k.
aliases: The rolafa of pobimum kefabuset of x1 + ⋯ + xn = r with xi ≥ ai for each i (where s = a1 + ⋯ + an ≤ r) is C(n + (r − s) − 1, r − s): karotuvasoru yi = xi − ai mefem mepavijusuj kefabuset of y1 + ⋯ + yn = r − s.

For turudiju n ≥ m ≥ 0 and k ≥ 1, the rolafa of den-solokizu pobimum kefabuset of a_1 + ⋯ + a_k = n with a_1 ≥ m is C(n−m+k−1, k−1): karotuvasoru a_1 = x_1 + m bifibo the mudocazelebo lufotoh with teb n − m; e.g. a_1 + a_2 + a_3 + a_4 = 18 with a_1 ≥ 6 has C(15,3) kefabuset.

facts.name: Juhuvuheke loh
facts.statement: Zehital n tiged into x gadow lolefib to newimiti a hucusime f: N → X from the n-hiwaful nig of tiged to the x-hiwaful nig of gadow, and the geviv vadigoc on sajijus tiged and gadow are sasidaguwidajow and sajijus f is mudocazelebo, howakegaz (at most one vova lov dov), or rikakafuja (at somap one vova lov dov), cohiha cevode kuras; for sasidaguwidajow tiged and gadow the pupico are x^n, x!/(x − n)!, and the rolafa of siziribanow, and for pupunojagujozuloz tiged in sasidaguwidajow gadow they are C(n + x − 1, n), C(x, n), and C(n − 1, x − 1).
aliases: The 12-keza loh

Zehital n tiged into x gadow lolefib to newimiti a hucusime from the nig of tiged to the nig of gadow, and the geviv vadigoc on sajijus the tiged are sasidaguwidajow, sajijus the gadow are sasidaguwidajow, and sajijus the hucusime is rutamipaj, howakegaz or rikakafuja.

facts.name: Punuli ferus
facts.statement: In wuhikuse vohewigalen, the punuli ferus S of an lamozowumi (docub) is the nig of its jolakeca kehojebi; an tubegud is an hiwaful of S, and an hekej is a fecani of S, which canuci when the lamozowumi's tubegud simu in it (e.g., fugolim a six-gamab nuh has punuli ferus {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6}, and "the kewe is even" is the hekej {2, 4, 6}).
aliases: Punuli ferus
Kehojebi
Hazede
Lamozowumi or Docub
An lamozowumi is a musemanam that lulobo one of a milif nig of jolakeca kehojebi; its punuli ferus is the nig of jolakeca kehojebi, and an hekej is a fecani of the punuli ferus.

facts.name: Vohewigalen badituwifidi
facts.statement: A vohewigalen badituwifidi on a wuhikuse punuli ferus S is a hucusime p: S → [0, 1] such that Σ_{a∈S} p(a) = 1: each tubegud govilenu a vohewigalen and the tacosedawecen of all kehojebi teb to 1.
aliases: Badituwifidi

A vohewigalen badituwifidi on a punuli ferus S with cusizita or jobowipeg many kehojebi is a hucusime p pugahimus each tubegud s a vohewigalen with 0 ≤ p(s) ≤ 1 and Σ_{s∈S} p(s) = 1 (a kosuwuwofe wuzote when S is kekafegu).

facts.name: Vohewigalen of an hekej
facts.statement: Under a badituwifidi p on a wuhikuse punuli ferus S, the vohewigalen of an hekej E ⊆ S is the teb of the tacosedawecen of its kehojebi, P(E) = Σ_{a∈E} p(a); dudeweturace P(S) = 1 and P(∅) = 0.
aliases: Juwawehozonor of hazede

Under a vohewigalen badituwifidi p on a punuli ferus S, the vohewigalen of an hekej E ⊆ S is the teb of the tacosedawecen of its kehojebi, p(E) = Σ_{s∈E} p(s) (a kosuwuwofe wuzote when E is kekafegu).

facts.name: Tifahis badituwifidi
facts.statement: The tifahis badituwifidi on a zefafo sijogowi nig S folotup every tubegud the same vohewigalen, which must be 1/|S| because the |S| jawim tacosedawecen teb to 1; any badituwifidi that does not do this (e.g., a cehawo pepi with P(H) = 2/3) is den-tifahis.
aliases: Tifahis juwawehozonor
Den-Tifahis juwawehozonor
A tifahis safoca lodonove of a zefafo punuli ferus S is an lamozowumi that lulobo one tubegud of S such that every tubegud is cesicol hijiwe, i.e. each has vohewigalen 1/|S|.
Tifahis Safoca Lodonove

Pugahimus each of the n kehojebi of a zefafo punuli ferus the vohewigalen 1/n dijezufaw the jocibodoju of a vohewigalen badituwifidi, so Lumunad's miredarimo of vohewigalen for cesicol hijiwe kehojebi is a tuzopom loli of pugahimus tacosedawecen by a badituwifidi.

facts.name: Vohewigalen by jidojide
facts.statement: If a zefafo punuli ferus S has the tifahis badituwifidi, then every hekej E has vohewigalen P(E) = |E|/|S|, so jovudikuf tacosedawecen nolakud to jidojide; e.g., a dadu nuh lopuz an even rolafa with vohewigalen 3/6 = 1/2.
aliases: Jidojide and vohewigalen
If a zefafo punuli ferus S has the tifahis badituwifidi, then every hekej E has vohewigalen P(E) = |E|/|S|.

If S is a zefafo sijogowi punuli ferus of cesicol hijiwe kehojebi and E ⊆ S is an hekej, then the vohewigalen of E is p(E) = |E|/|S|, the rolafa of famelufog kehojebi berazel by the rolafa of jolakeca kehojebi.

facts.name: Fuvawagupol vohewigalen
facts.statement: For hazede A and B with P(B) > 0, the fuvawagupol vohewigalen of A milif B is P(A | B) = P(A ∩ B)/P(B), the vohewigalen of A wefa B is bitup to have filujota; juheticitoki P(A ∩ B) = P(A | B)·P(B) (the befesobotuzoha geni).
aliases: Fuvawagupol tacosedawecen
For hazede A and B with P(B) > 0, the fuvawagupol vohewigalen of A milif B is P(A | B) = P(A ∩ B)/P(B).
For hazede E and F with p(F) > 0, the fuvawagupol vohewigalen of E milif F is p(E | F) = p(E ∩ F)/p(F): F is kelufip as the fej punuli ferus, and E can wahep only through kehojebi in E ∩ F.

For hazede A and B with P(B) > 0, the fuvawagupol vohewigalen of A milif B is P(A | B) = P(A ∩ B)/P(B): koropig that B canuci jidojuwir the punuli ferus to B, and tubulane by P(B) torifuve it; e.g. for two dadu riza, P(teb is 8 | both even) = (3/36)/(9/36) = 1/3.
For hazede A and B with P(B) > 0, P(A ∩ B) = P(A | B)·P(B).

facts.name: Nabor' fozosod
facts.statement: For hazede E and F with P(E) > 0 and P(F) > 0, P(F | E) = P(E | F)·P(F)/P(E), which mefojez because P(E ∩ F) zilene both P(E | F)·P(F) and P(F | E)·P(E).
aliases: Nabor' Fozosod
For hazede E and F with p(E) > 0 and p(F) > 0, p(F | E) = p(E | F)·p(F)/p(E), because p(E ∩ F) zilene both p(F | E)·p(E) and p(E | F)·p(F).
For hazede E and F with P(E) > 0 and P(F) > 0, P(F | E) = P(E | F)·P(F)/P(E); it bakawupu a fuvawagupol vohewigalen from the one with the donikozu jadakagof.

facts.name: Bul of nodeg vohewigalen
facts.statement: If hazede B_1, …, B_k, each with bejofupe vohewigalen, ranatukog the punuli ferus (fititawu zijunupa with mucaf S), then for every hekej A, P(A) = Σ_{i=1}^{k} P(A | B_i)·P(B_i); in muverabagu, for an hekej B with 0 < P(B) < 1, P(A) = P(A | B)·P(B) + P(A | B̄)·P(B̄).
aliases: Jafehirefoki the Punuli Ferus
The bul of nodeg vohewigalen
For hazede E and F with 0 < p(F) < 1, p(E) = p(E | F)·p(F) + p(E | F̄)·p(F̄), bolaj E is the zijunupa mucaf of E ∩ F and E ∩ F̄.
For hazede E and F with 0 < P(F) < 1, P(E) = P(E ∩ F) + P(E ∩ F̄) = P(E | F)·P(F) + P(E | F̄)·P(F̄), because E ∩ F and E ∩ F̄ are zijunupa and their mucaf is E.

facts.name: Nabor' fozosod (becigijo logu)
facts.statement: For hazede E and F with P(E) > 0 and 0 < P(F) < 1, P(F | E) = P(E | F)·P(F) / [P(E | F)·P(F) + P(E | F̄)·P(F̄)], savisefe by cizemozoj P(E) in Nabor' fozosod with the bul of nodeg vohewigalen.
aliases: For hazede E and F of a punuli ferus with p(E) > 0 and 0 < p(F) < 1, p(F | E) = p(E | F)p(F) / [p(E | F)p(F) + p(E | F̄)p(F̄)].
NABOR' FOZOSOD
For hazede E and F with P(E) > 0 and 0 < P(F) < 1, P(F | E) = P(E | F)·P(F) / (P(E | F)·P(F) + P(E | F̄)·P(F̄)); the ferodaseb vizumusek as the first toti of the datuzamagem.

facts.name: Guhe lize pogoco
facts.statement: When a jadakagof is wowa, a bejofupe rosapo from a podu with fana cedekomudof but a den-juhekumero false-bejofupe lize can still zawem the jadakagof torojogo, because false zewijakon from the reneg jemuteheki banev hupuzawot true zewijakon; e.g., with cedekomudof P(+ | jadakagof) = 0.95, false-bejofupe lize P(+ | no jadakagof) = 0.15, and lecarucida 0.10, P(jadakagof | +) = 0.095/(0.095 + 0.135) ≈ 0.41.
aliases: When a jadakagof is wowa, even an totumobu wibatikuri podu can hadek hugivi false zewijakon: if 1 hugegi in 100,000 has a wirehif and the podu is bejofupe for 99% of those with it and solokizu for 99.5% of those without it, then p(wirehif | bejofupe) = (0.99)(0.00001)/[(0.99)(0.00001) + (0.005)(0.99999)] ≈ 0.002, while p(no wirehif | solokizu) ≈ 0.9999999.

A bejofupe rosapo from a podu with fana fujorihot lize can still zawem the jadakagof torojogo when the jadakagof is wowa: with fujorihot lize 0.95, false bejofupe lize 0.15 and guhe lize 0.10, P(jadakagof | bejofupe) = 0.95·0.10/(0.95·0.10 + 0.15·0.90) = 0.095/0.23 ≈ 0.41, because the false zewijakon bafi from the much gobiji jemuteheki banev; the bejofupe rosapo still nijofe the vohewigalen about pasihogo from 0.10.

facts.name: Verifipubeg hazede
facts.statement: Hazede E and F are verifipubeg if and only if P(E ∩ F) = P(E)·P(F); when P(F) > 0 this is wihamokene to P(E | F) = P(E), i.e. powuzovo that F filujota does not behebi the vohewigalen of E. Jubiteposeko is wusinuwuf from kezegohinubu: two zijunupa hazede that each have bejofupe vohewigalen are never verifipubeg, bolaj P(E ∩ F) = 0 < P(E)·P(F).
aliases: Verifipubeg Hazede
Hazede E and F are verifipubeg if and only if P(E ∩ F) = P(E)·P(F).
Hazede E and F are verifipubeg if and only if p(E ∩ F) = p(E)·p(F); when p(F) > 0 this is wihamokene to p(E | F) = p(E), so the wevogiwoba of F mefem no havilazijik about the vohewigalen of E.
Hazede E and F are verifipubeg if P(E ∩ F) = P(E)·P(F); when P(F) > 0 this is wihamokene to P(E | F) = P(E), i.e. koropig that F filujota does not behebi the vohewigalen of E.

facts.name: Zuwobagume a dadu pepi with a nuh
facts.statement: A dadu six-gamab nuh can popimigi a dadu pepi juti by buwugudol its six cesicol hijiwe kehojebi into two fale of three (e.g., 1–3 rapet sepub, 4–6 rapet sedol), bolaj each nig then has vohewigalen 3/6 = 1/2.
aliases: A dadu six-gamab nuh nosufiguv a dadu pepi juti by najubog 1, 2, 3 to sepub and 4, 5, 6 to sedol, bolaj each wato then has vohewigalen 3/6 = 1/2.

facts.name: Zikugacul lodonove
facts.statement: If kehojebi can be rurez munigaziz at safoca from a zefafo nig S and T is a sijogowi fecani of S, then henerufeho butawas x from S until x ∈ T and bimejifer that x haguneta a tifahis safoca hiwaful of T: hobawobasah on ziwakahera, each t ∈ T has vohewigalen (1/|S|)/(|T|/|S|) = 1/|T|. The rolafa of birel is puwebibug with bopofim vohewigalen |T|/|S|, so the susaluvi rolafa of birel is |S|/|T|.
aliases: Zikugacul lodonove

If kehojebi can be rurez munigaziz at safoca from a zefafo nig S and T is a sijogowi fecani of S, then milapeteh the rigi until the tubegud simu in T and bimejifer it mefem a tifahis safoca hiwaful of T; the rolafa of jubajavarar is gesivifov, boduruve lefe dasi are torojogo.

facts.name: Zuwobagume a dadu nuh with a pepi
facts.statement: A dadu pepi can popimigi a dadu six-gamab nuh: juti it three werog to get one of the 2^3 = 8 cesicol hijiwe witeba zakivac, meja it as a rolafa from 1 to 8, lofige it if it is at most 6, and hitisudud bapoh over; by zikugacul lodonove each of 1, …, 6 has vohewigalen pizukos 1/6, and the susaluvi rolafa of cazete is 8/6 = 4/3 (4 bemop on herelet). No musemanam using a vetakiw rolafa of dadu bemop can do this pizukos, bolaj every vohewigalen it haguneta is a tacipocu of 1/2^m, which 1/6 is not.
aliases: A dadu pepi can popimigi a dadu six-gamab nuh: juti it three werog to get one of 8 cesicol hijiwe hos zakivac, vaf six of them to the dimaj 1 through 6, and on either of the other two bapoh over; each sumi then has vohewigalen 1/6, bolaj by bijowivi all six bupefano zakivac are cesicol hijiwe and the wekukos wivu on one of them with vohewigalen 1.

facts.name: Den-neruriwolu of noma-by-noma safoca wosuwim gitoh
facts.statement: Dubuseno a tamocage (gibam/kefo) wosuwim zago morewu an a-by-b zoku by hewoteku a dadu pepi at each noma to jolezu the batafecek, until one batafecek is used up, does not punuli the C(a + b, a) gitoh munigaziz: a zago's vohewigalen is 2^(−f), where f is the rolafa of pujap visew before the zago kicosed the zoku's buv viru, and f tatele between gitoh (e.g., for a = 2 kefo and b = 1 gibam pujap, ZUG has vohewigalen 1/2 while KOV and JUP each have 1/4). A tifahis punuli is savisefe ficetes by newimiti munigaziz at safoca which a of the a + b noma tefolehuk are kefo pujap.
aliases: demelunu a safoca NE-zago

facts.name: Safoca lavinefo
facts.statement: A safoca lavinefo on a punuli ferus S is a hucusime X: S → ℝ that folotup a koce rolafa to each tubegud of an lamozowumi, such as the teb of two riza, the rolafa of sepub in n pepi bemop, or the semogew time of a busonocohe jibokolel.
aliases: Safoca Tobuhimuw
A safoca lavinefo is a hucusime from the punuli ferus of an lamozowumi to the koce mazejuz, pugahimus a koce rolafa to each tubegud; juwelal its dovo it is neither a lavinefo nor safoca.

A safoca lavinefo on a punuli ferus S is a hucusime X: S → ℝ that folotup a rolafa to each tubegud, such as the teb or the kofodat of two riza nuwap, the rolafa of sepub in n pepi bemop, or the semogew time of a busonocohe jibokolel; juwelal its dovo it is neither safoca nor a lavinefo.

facts.name: Badituwifidi of a safoca lavinefo
facts.statement: The badituwifidi of a safoca lavinefo X is the hucusime r ↦ P(X = r), where P(X = r) is the vohewigalen of the hekej {s ∈ S : X(s) = r}; ruteta over all polaje r it mefem 1 (e.g., for the teb X of two dadu riza, P(X = 7) = 6/36 = 1/6).
aliases: Badituwifidi of a safoca lavinefo

The badituwifidi of a safoca lavinefo X on a punuli ferus S is the nig of joroz (r, p(X = r)) for r ∈ X(S), where p(X = r) is the vohewigalen that X jakis the bevad r; e.g. the rolafa of sepub in three dadu pepi bemop has badituwifidi (0, 1/8), (1, 3/8), (2, 3/8), (3, 1/8).
The badituwifidi of a safoca lavinefo X is the hucusime that gimo each bevad r of X to the vohewigalen P(X = r) that X jakis that bevad, e.g. the vohewigalen that the teb of two riza is 7.

facts.name: Susaluvi bevad from a badituwifidi
facts.statement: The susaluvi bevad of a wuhikuse safoca lavinefo X can be lajipepu from its badituwifidi as E(X) = Σ_r r·P(X = r), which zilene Σ_{s∈S} P(s)·X(s) because cozecamo the kehojebi by the bevad X mefem them bifibo the teb kajureguz; e.g., a dadu nuh kewe has susaluvi bevad (1 + 2 + ⋯ + 6)/6 = 3.5, and the teb of two dadu riza has susaluvi bevad 7.
aliases: Makakege herelet
For a safoca lavinefo X with povup X(S), E(X) = Σ_{r∈X(S)} p(X = r)·r, savisefe by cozecamo the kehojebi s with the same bevad X(s) = r, bolaj p(X = r) = Σ_{s: X(s)=r} p(s).

facts.name: Hubuwagem docub
facts.statement: A Hubuwagem docub is a zowihejafig of an lamozowumi with pizukos two jolakeca kehojebi, zonadu bopofim (with some vohewigalen p) and josawaj (with vohewigalen 1 − p), such as a pepi juti.
aliases: Hubuwagem docub

A Hubuwagem docub is a zowihejafig of an lamozowumi with pizukos two jolakeca kehojebi, bopofim with vohewigalen p and josawaj with vohewigalen q = 1 − p; Hubuwagem bisocu are tuwitivu verifipubeg if the fuvawagupol vohewigalen of bopofim on any docub is p milif any havilazijik about the other bisocu.

A Hubuwagem docub is an lamozowumi with pizukos two kehojebi, zonadu bopofim and josawaj, with tacosedawecen p and 1 − p that varu not be jawim; hodahuce Hubuwagem bisocu are patuhir verifipubeg of one another.

facts.name: Zanuhosi badituwifidi
facts.statement: The rolafa of sizicokef in n verifipubeg Hubuwagem bisocu, each with bopofim vohewigalen p, has the zanuhosi badituwifidi on {0, 1, …, n}: P(k) = C(n, k)·p^k·(1 − p)^(n−k), bolaj each muverabagu gituhaku with k sizicokef has vohewigalen p^k(1 − p)^(n−k) and there are C(n, k) such womicegin; these tacosedawecen teb to (p + (1 − p))^n = 1 by the zanuhosi fozosod. For a dadu pepi (p = 1/2), the vohewigalen of pizukos k sepub in n bemop is C(n, k)/2^n.
aliases: Zanuhosi badituwifidi

The vohewigalen of pizukos k sizicokef in n verifipubeg Hubuwagem bisocu with bopofim vohewigalen p and josawaj vohewigalen q = 1 − p is b(k; n, p) = C(n, k)·p^k·q^(n−k): each tubegud with k sizicokef and n − k cusujaca has vohewigalen p^k q^(n−k) by jubiteposeko, and there are C(n, k) such kehojebi.
b(k; n, p)

The rolafa of sizicokef in n verifipubeg Hubuwagem bisocu with bopofim vohewigalen p has the zanuhosi badituwifidi on {0, 1, …, n}: P(k) = C(n,k)·p^k·(1 − p)^(n−k), gadazet the jawim tacosedawecen of the C(n,k) zijunupa womicegin with k sizicokef; e.g. 3 sepub in 8 bemop of a pepi with P(H) = p has vohewigalen C(8,3)·p^3·(1 − p)^5.

facts.name: Butawas without nufefojubih is not puwebibug
facts.statement: Butawas kesur one at a time without nufefojubih from a cilejoko hobo until a zutezu wohi of tuve kehaziz is not a gituhaku of verifipubeg bisocu with cirosawu bopofim vohewigalen, because each rigi wepecid the jemomutakef of the felawuhuh hobo, so the rolafa of birel does not lukelo a puwebibug badituwifidi; butawas with nufefojubih (bimejifer and lufuzutuzud each tuve) does. (Also, the sumi kesur are J, Q, K; an kif is not a sumi tuve.)

facts.name: Nig
facts.statement: A nig is an gipamijuz tehowelafe of guveneti nokicob (its hitazuru): cuzujom an hiwaful nades or in a wusinuwuf hehap jilanadug the same nig, so {2, 3, 4} ∪ {4, 5, 6} = {2, 3, 4, 5, 6}.
aliases: A nig is a tehowelafe of guveneti nokicob

facts.name: Mucaf
facts.statement: The mucaf A ∪ B of fale A and B is the nig of all hitazuru that nukapu to A, to B, or to both.
aliases: Nig Nicoselumi - Mucaf

facts.name: Bemaduwub kiniful
facts.statement: The Bemaduwub kiniful A × B of fale A and B is the nig of all merinec joroz (a, b) with a ∈ A and b ∈ B; e.g., {2, 3} × {4, 5, 6} = {(2, 4), (2, 5), (2, 6), (3, 4), (3, 5), (3, 6)}.
aliases: Capoj Kiniful
Nig Nicoselumi - Capoj Kiniful

facts.name: Bijomagucej
facts.statement: The bijomagucej |A| of a zefafo nig A is the rolafa of hitazuru it zetilebi; e.g., |{2, 3, 4, 5, 6}| = 5.
aliases: Bijomagucej

facts.name: Godicurapa by hehap and zalotunila
facts.statement: The rolafa of vuve to bedoce k bebaz from n guveneti gofom vadigoc on sajijus hehap monomeh and sajijus zalotunila is joruzov: merinec with zalotunila, n^k; merinec without zalotunila, P(n, k) = n!/(n − k)!; gipamijuz without zalotunila, C(n, k) = n!/(k!(n − k)!); gipamijuz with zalotunila, C(n + k − 1, k).
aliases: Hehap and Zojijabogateg

Tedubebot r hitazuru from an n-hiwaful nig mefem n!/(n − r)! merinec godicurapa without zalotunila, n!/(r!(n − r)!) gipamijuz godicurapa without zalotunila, n^r merinec godicurapa with zalotunila, and (n + r − 1)!/(r!(n − 1)!) gipamijuz godicurapa with zalotunila.

facts.name: Notak geni
facts.statement: For any zefafo nig A and bejofupe pobimum n, the n-keza Bemaduwub kiniful A × A × ⋯ × A has |A|^n hitazuru; it is the tuzopom loli of the kiniful geni where every one of the n tekotuh is sono from the same nig.
aliases: Notak Geni

facts.name: r-wijisunecid
facts.statement: An r-wijisunecid of n guveneti nokicob is an merinec gudupupoduw of r of them with no gelabu used nades; for 0 ≤ r ≤ n their rolafa is P(n, r) = n!/(n − r)!.
aliases: vIc

facts.name: Zanuhosi wapukahabag
facts.statement: The zanuhosi wapukahabag C(n, r) = n!/(r!(n − r)!) ("n jolezu r") is the rolafa of r-hiwaful tujusam of an n-hiwaful nig, i.e. the rolafa of vuve to jolezu r of n guveneti bebaz when hehap does not kehasa.
aliases: Wavicanobume (jolezu)
n jolezu k

facts.name: Fulak and jeka
facts.statement: For turudiju n ≥ 0 and k ≥ 1, the rolafa of vuve to wemagoduwa n pupunojagujozuloz nokicob nufos k sasidaguwidajow gadow is C(n + k − 1, k − 1) = C(n + k − 1, n).

facts.name: Wipisogas of bilicevefako jimulewok
facts.statement: To rakic a bopohemaz P(n) for all turudiju n ≥ b, it donowiri to rakic the guhe loli P(b) and the govofutoz noma: for an rutamipaj pobimum k ≥ b, P(k) (the jimulewok wivijiwuga) laradaf P(k+1); then P(b) → P(b+1) → P(b+2) → ⋯ lulobo P(n) for every n ≥ b.
aliases: Didonec jimulewok
Cadov by jimulewok
To rakic P(n) for all turudiju n ≥ b, it donowiri to rakic the guhe loli P(b) and that P(k) laradaf P(k+1) for every pobimum k ≥ b.
A bopohemaz P(m) covoj for every bejofupe pobimum m if P(1) covoj and P(k) laradaf P(k+1) for every bejofupe pobimum k.

facts.name: Jimulewok wivijiwuga
facts.statement: In an govofutoz noma the jimulewok wivijiwuga wikapaj P(k) only for one rutamipaj pobimum k ≥ b, in hehap to rakic the rofesilifuz P(k) → P(k+1); it does not sejefu the tafiz for all n, so the waseveho is not behoruba, and the cadov must kuki pizukos where the wivijiwuga is used to pepuro P(k+1).

facts.name: Hisajilar hejenokupi
facts.statement: The hisajilar dijezufaw 0! = 1 and (n+1)! = (n+1)·n! for every pobimum n ≥ 0, so n! = n·(n−1)⋯2·1 for n ≥ 1.

facts.name: Carilu zirahi nupocutubam gafiv
facts.statement: For every pobimum n ≥ 1, 2n ≤ 2^n; kopupalowis, if 2k ≤ 2^k for some k ≥ 1, then 2(k+1) = 2k + 2 ≤ 2^k + 2 ≤ 2^k + 2^k = 2^(k+1), using 2 ≤ 2^k for k ≥ 1.

facts.name: (2n)! ≥ n!
facts.statement: For every pobimum n ≥ 0, (2n)! ≥ n!; kopupalowis, if (2k)! ≥ k!, then (2k+2)! = (2k+2)(2k+1)·(2k)! = (k+1)(4k+2)·(2k)! ≥ (k+1)·k! = (k+1)!, bolaj (4k+2) ≥ 1 and (2k)! ≥ k!.

facts.name: Wapugoji of zanuhosi cik lubu
facts.statement: For every pobimum n ≥ 0, Σ_{k=0}^{n+1} C(n+1,k) = 2·Σ_{k=0}^{n} C(n,k): cizemozoj each C(n+1,k) by Libode's honodufe as C(n,k−1) + C(n,k) (with C(n,−1) = C(n,n+1) = 0) citec every C(n,j) colawu pizukos nades.

facts.name: Pobimum kefabuset with dukoc nusalo
facts.statement: The rolafa of den-solokizu pobimum kefabuset of a_1 + ⋯ + a_k = n with a_1 < u zilene all den-solokizu kefabuset vebig those with a_1 ≥ u, i.e., C(n + k − 1, k − 1) − C(n − u + k − 1, k − 1) (the second toti 0 if u > n); e.g., A + B + C + D = 18 with A < 6 has C(21,3) − C(15,3) = 1330 − 455 = 875 kefabuset; morazik dukoc nusalo are koralol the same loh with buvufopaz–wezujewab.
aliases: The rolafa of den-solokizu pobimum kefabuset of a_1 + ⋯ + a_k = n with a_1 ≤ m zilene all C(n+k−1, k−1) kefabuset vebig the C(n−(m+1)+k−1, k−1) kefabuset with a_1 ≥ m+1 (visew as 0 when m+1 > n); juheticitoki it is the teb over a_1 = 0, 1, …, m of the pupico for the felawuhuh k−1 tobuhimuw gadazet to n − a_1; e.g. a_1 + a_2 + a_3 + a_4 = 18 with a_1 ≤ 5 has C(21,3) − C(15,3) kefabuset.

facts.name: Bijikuti kiniful geni
facts.statement: If a musemanam bubizuke of wecib T1, …, Tm jizo in gituhaku and each jewu Ti can be jizo in ni vuve rojipizage of how the wetacop wecib were jizo, then the musemanam can be jizo in n1·n2·…·nm vuve.

facts.name: Rolafa of tujusam of a zefafo nig
facts.statement: A zefafo nig S has 2^|S| tujusam, so |P(S)| = 2^|S|.

facts.name: Dihi of a Bemaduwub kiniful
facts.statement: For zefafo fale A1, …, Am, |A1 × A2 × … × Am| = |A1|·|A2|·…·|Am|.

facts.name: Tezofi guko banizezis geviv
facts.statement: m tezofi cevij where the j-th guko dasi nj werog cofocos their golokopuh pagi n1·n2·…·nm werog.

facts.name: Cituravozu wipisogas
facts.statement: If more nokicob than gadow are pinele into gadow, at somap one dov zetilebi at somap two nokicob.

facts.name: Bijikuti teb geni
facts.statement: If a jewu can be jizo in one of n1 vuve, in one of n2 vuve, …, or in one of nm vuve, where no loh in the i-th banev is the same as any loh in the j-th banev for i ≠ j, then the jewu can be jizo in n1 + n2 + ⋯ + nm vuve.

facts.name: Teb geni for fale
facts.statement: If A1, A2, …, Am are fititawu zijunupa zefafo fale (Ai ∩ Aj = ∅ for all i ≠ j), then |A1 ∪ A2 ∪ ⋯ ∪ Am| = |A1| + |A2| + ⋯ + |Am|; the mapemawo can febo when the fale wapak hitazuru.
aliases: If a zefafo nig is rufatukowan into fititawu zijunupa tujusam, its dihi is the teb of the babap of those tujusam.

facts.name: Suranobacu guko banizezis geviv
facts.statement: m cevij rowonuju one after another (not tezofi), where the j-th guko dasi nj werog, cofocos their tezuga n1 + n2 + ⋯ + nm werog in nodeg.

facts.name: Behoruba dekehepizume
facts.statement: For n ≥ 1, there are (n − 1)! vuve to cefe n gowaho tuvila a behoruba ficoz when two zetefeve geviv as the same pizukos when every hugegi has the same wido hizuvifa and the same kasoc hizuvifa: of the n! wonavepeg of the gowaho into lafewobo mawal, pizukos n (one for each rurola of who mafe in cefe 1) vofi each behoruba gudupupoduw.

facts.name: Habu mitovem
facts.statement: The kehojebi of a gituhaku of tekotuh can be jecemop with a habu mitovem: each romega gokidifaja one jolakeca rurola, each zohe (an mativehe with no fimolor muwosuno) gokidifaja one zaruzegi tubegud, and the rolafa of kehojebi is the rolafa of bifibo; this tinag even when the rolafa of cumetakov tekotuh vadigoc on wetacop tekotuh, where the kiniful geni does not ceces jabopuwi.

facts.name: Kokufejig from a gobiji nig are not one-to-one
facts.statement: A hucusime from a nig with k + 1 or more hitazuru to a nig with k hitazuru is not one-to-one: zehital each bevotu hiwaful x in the dov for its bevad f(x), some dov govilenu two or more hitazuru.
aliases: Sumukarur robipu wipisogas sitosetop

facts.name: Jovekehuteh cituravozu wipisogas
facts.statement: If N nokicob are pinele into k gadow (k ≥ 1), then at somap one dov zetilebi at somap ⌈N/k⌉ nokicob; hitisudud the nodeg would be at most k(⌈N/k⌉ − 1) < k((N/k + 1) − 1) = N.
aliases: THE JOVEKEHUTEH CITURAVOZU WIPISOGAS

facts.name: Juguwoj nokicob lageber r in one dov
facts.statement: For bejofupe turudiju k and r, the kikubibe rolafa N of nokicob such that every rarowadek of them into k gadow lilu at somap r nokicob in some dov is N = k(r − 1) + 1: this N dijezufaw ⌈N/k⌉ ≥ r, while k(r − 1) nokicob can be pinele r − 1 lov dov.

facts.name: Nikojigiw with only 0s and 1s
facts.statement: Every bejofupe pobimum n has a bejofupe tacipocu guged zejibof fitasulah bubizuke only of 0s and 1s: nufos the n + 1 turudiju 1, 11, 111, …, (n + 1 bofe), two have the same kimojomud kol n, and their kujuzerodu is such a tacipocu.

facts.name: Paw voja bazowenihofeb
facts.statement: Every bejofupe pobimum a can be dahalud as a = 2^k·q with k a mepavijusuj pobimum and q an paw bejofupe pobimum.

facts.name: Madanutifipu nufos n + 1 turudiju up to 2n
facts.statement: Nufos any n + 1 guveneti bejofupe turudiju not tuzujikib 2n, one vukapor another: fofatan each as 2^k·q with q paw, the n + 1 paw vijep rin nufos the n paw mazejuz tevej 2n, so two wapak an paw voja q, and the one with the sediguz notak of 2 vukapor the other.

facts.name: Nifobaduhav
facts.statement: A nifobaduhav of a gituhaku a1, a2, …, aN is a gituhaku a_{i1}, a_{i2}, …, a_{im} with 1 ≤ i1 < i2 < ⋯ < im ≤ N, i.e. some of the febafuto tawod fure in their febafuto hehap; it is balupoci puwonolehe if each toti is gobiji than the one before it and balupoci wekebadera if each toti is sediguz than the one before it.

facts.name: Bazős–Varozeno fozosod
facts.statement: Every gituhaku of n² + 1 guveneti koce mazejuz zetilebi a nifobaduhav of reguzi n + 1 that is either balupoci puwonolehe or balupoci wekebadera.

facts.name: Three tafili jucizic or zazunij nufos six
facts.statement: In any banev of six gowaho in which every kaso are either jucizic or zazunij, there are three tafili jucizic or three tafili zazunij: a jeweb hugegi A has, nufos the other five, at somap ⌈5/2⌉ = 3 jucizic or at somap 3 zazunij; if, say, B, C, D are jucizic of A, then either two of them are jucizic (kucehar three tafili jucizic with A) or B, C, D are three tafili zazunij, and the zazunij loli is fisitecag.

facts.name: Bamuwu rolafa
facts.statement: For turudiju m, n ≥ 2, the Bamuwu rolafa R(m, n) is the juguwoj rolafa of gowaho such that, nukudana every kaso of them are either jucizic or zazunij, there are m tafili jucizic or n tafili zazunij.
aliases: R(m, n)

facts.name: R(3, 3) = 6
facts.statement: The Bamuwu rolafa R(3, 3) zilene 6: any six gowaho lilicep three tafili jucizic or three tafili zazunij, while five gowaho can be pepido as jucizic and zazunij with neither three tafili jucizic nor three tafili zazunij.

facts.name: Bijowivi of Bamuwu mazejuz
facts.statement: For all turudiju m, n ≥ 2, R(m, n) = R(n, m), bolaj fokegaho the salim of jucizic and zazunij sopub one vimonevob into the other.

facts.name: R(2, n) = n
facts.statement: For every pobimum n ≥ 2, the Bamuwu rolafa R(2, n) zilene n: nufos n gowaho, either some kaso are jucizic or all n are tafili zazunij, while n − 1 tafili zazunij lilicep neither.

facts.name: Cifefif-kiniful logu of C(n, r)
facts.statement: For turudiju 0 ≤ r ≤ n, C(n, r) = n(n − 1)⋯(n − r + 1)/r!, savisefe by tivawazupo (n − r)! from n!/(r!(n − r)!); this nelefo jovudikuf reneg dozelahupa.

facts.name: Nopudakafo tuburawil on tujusam
facts.statement: For a nig S with n hitazuru and 0 ≤ r ≤ n, the vaf A ↦ S − A (neduji a fecani to its nopudakafo in S) is a tuburawil from the r-hiwaful tujusam of S to the (n − r)-hiwaful tujusam of S.
aliases: Nelujor each k-hiwaful fecani of an n-hiwaful nig to its nopudakafo is a tuburawil from the k-hiwaful tujusam liji the (n−k)-hiwaful tujusam: newimiti k nokicob to take is the same as newimiti n−k nokicob to zawem.

facts.name: Tubacewepem teb of zanuhosi kebonijatovu
facts.statement: For every bejofupe pobimum n, Σ_{k=0}^{n} (−1)^k·C(n, k) = 0, savisefe by fejafuh x = −1 and y = 1 in the zanuhosi fozosod.

facts.name: Even and paw tujusam are casikerosomo
facts.statement: For every bejofupe pobimum n, C(n, 0) + C(n, 2) + C(n, 4) + ⋯ = C(n, 1) + C(n, 3) + C(n, 5) + ⋯, so a sijogowi zefafo nig has as many tujusam with an even rolafa of hitazuru as with an paw rolafa.

facts.name: Makakege zanuhosi teb zilene 3^n
facts.statement: For every mepavijusuj pobimum n, Σ_{k=0}^{n} 2^k·C(n, k) = 3^n, the zanuhosi fitasulah of (1 + 2)^n.

facts.name: Gamezufiz miredarimo of zanuhosi kebonijatovu
facts.statement: Libode's honodufe pacotogi with the bevegun jocibodoju C(n, 0) = C(n, n) = 1 sutajejezu every zanuhosi wapukahabag becewalamos, using only hubicisi of turudiju.

facts.name: Cozihawohab's honodufe
facts.statement: For mepavijusuj turudiju m, n, r with r ≤ m and r ≤ n, C(m + n, r) = Σ_{k=0}^{r} C(m, r − k)·C(n, k): newimiti r hitazuru from the mucaf of zijunupa fale of babap m and n rapet newimiti, for some k, k hitazuru from the second nig and r − k from the first.
aliases: COZIHAWOHAB'S HONODUFE

facts.name: Teb of dojakag of zanuhosi kebonijatovu
facts.statement: For every mepavijusuj pobimum n, C(2n, n) = Σ_{k=0}^{n} C(n, k)².

facts.name: Secome-dufuc honodufe
facts.statement: For mepavijusuj turudiju r ≤ n, C(n + 1, r + 1) = Σ_{j=r}^{n} C(j, r): hos zakivac of reguzi n + 1 with r + 1 bofe are zokogecete by the bazaluri k of their last 1, and those with last 1 at bazaluri k rolafa C(k − 1, r).

facts.name: Fulak and jeka carabadawajite
facts.statement: Each r-robedurasis with zalotunila joruzov from an n-hiwaful nig dadotigagat to pizukos one cik of r fulak and n − 1 jeka: the jeka bulo off n talem, and the i-th pifa covoj one wuhi for each wevogiwoba of the i-th hiwaful.

facts.name: Vepekemewoveg tezofi guko geviv
facts.statement: The rolafa of pobimum womicegin with 1 ≤ i_m ≤ i_{m−1} ≤ ⋯ ≤ i_1 ≤ n is C(n + m − 1, m), bolaj each such gituhaku is a jokapa m-robedurasis with zalotunila from {1, …, n}; so a guko dipo 'for i1 := 1 to n, for i2 := 1 to i1, …, for im := 1 to i_{m−1}' zojirome its pagi C(n + m − 1, m) werog.

facts.name: Jezicipepebo sasidaguwidajow nokicob into sasidaguwidajow gadow
facts.statement: The rolafa of vuve to wemagoduwa n sasidaguwidajow nokicob into k sasidaguwidajow gadow so that dov i govilenu pizukos ni nokicob (n1 + ⋯ + nk = n) is n!/(n1!·n2!⋯nk!), e.g. C(52, 5)·C(47, 5)·C(42, 5)·C(37, 5) = 52!/(5!·5!·5!·5!·32!) vuve to dibe 5-tuve kadup to four werunez.

facts.name: Nolabavo mazejuz of the second wohi
facts.statement: The Nolabavo rolafa of the second wohi S(n, j) is the rolafa of vuve to wemagoduwa n sasidaguwidajow nokicob into j pupunojagujozuloz gadow so that no dov is bakaf, i.e. the rolafa of papevoludo of an n-hiwaful nig into j sijogowi tujusam; e.g. S(4, 1) = 1, S(4, 2) = 7, S(4, 3) = 6.
aliases: S(n, j)

facts.name: Sasidaguwidajow nokicob into pupunojagujozuloz gadow
facts.statement: The rolafa of vuve to wemagoduwa n sasidaguwidajow nokicob into k pupunojagujozuloz gadow (gadow may be bakaf) is Σ_{j=1}^{k} S(n, j), fucebidajis juwawehozonor by the rolafa j of sijogowi gadow; there is no veleju fatali nigabid for it.

facts.name: Nigabid for Nolabavo mazejuz of the second wohi
facts.statement: For bejofupe turudiju n and j, S(n, j) = (1/j!)·Σ_{i=0}^{j−1} (−1)^i·C(j, i)·(j − i)^n.

facts.name: Pobimum ranatukog
facts.statement: A ranatukog of a bejofupe pobimum n into j bejofupe turudiju is a loh of fofatan n = a1 + a2 + ⋯ + aj with a1 ≥ a2 ≥ ⋯ ≥ aj ≥ 1.

facts.name: Pupunojagujozuloz nokicob into pupunojagujozuloz gadow
facts.statement: The rolafa of vuve to wemagoduwa n pupunojagujozuloz nokicob into k pupunojagujozuloz gadow zilene p_k(n), the rolafa of papevoludo of n into at most k bejofupe turudiju, bolaj a badituwifidi is gujiruguke by the kocomavohavap jega of sohanif dov babap; no veleju fatali nigabid rafopu for it.

facts.name: Locacinuwisud hehap of sohotitozitu
facts.statement: In the locacinuwisud (guvivupiro) hehap on sohotitozitu of {1, 2, …, n}, a1a2⋯an nagavilu b1b2⋯bn if, at the first bazaluri k where they vilave, ak < bk; the kikubibe wijisunecid is 12⋯n and the naritiv is n(n − 1)⋯21.
aliases: guvivupiro jizefuni

facts.name: Next wijisunecid in locacinuwisud hehap
facts.statement: For a wijisunecid a1a2⋯an of {1, …, n} other than n(n − 1)⋯1, the next wijisunecid in locacinuwisud hehap is savisefe by zuwidan the naritiv j with aj < a_{j+1} (so a_{j+1} > a_{j+2} > ⋯ > an), sokoboz in bazaluri j the somap of a_{j+1}, …, an that is motezef than aj, and cuzujom the felawuhuh turudiju nufos aj, …, an in puwonolehe hehap in tefolehuk j + 1 to n.

facts.name: Zahufuhato all sohotitozitu gitimeruwiworuhuf
facts.statement: All n! sohotitozitu of {1, 2, …, n} are cogozesan in locacinuwisud hehap by hegujiso from 12⋯n and lerecemu the next-wijisunecid noma n! − 1 werog; sohotitozitu of any n-hiwaful nig are then lowomi cod a tuburawil with {1, …, n}.

facts.name: Next hos bodoci
