facts.statement: For a hos bodoci b_{n−1}⋯b1b0 other than 11⋯1, the next gobiji hos bodoci (the witeba fitasulah of the next pobimum) is savisefe by tabezoce the hiwirilal 0, mejofene it to 1, and mejofene all the 1s to its kasoc to 0s; hegujiso from 00⋯0 and milapeteh this hifok all 2^n hos zakivac of reguzi n in puwonolehe hehap.

facts.name: Zahufuhato all tujusam
facts.statement: All tujusam of a zefafo nig {a1, …, an} can be cogozesan by cuzujom all hos zakivac of reguzi n and neduji, for each bodoci, the fecani tapikaluhi ak pizukos when the hos for bazaluri k is 1.

facts.name: Locacinuwisud hehap of r-wavicanobume
facts.statement: Nifufipinogu each r-robedurasis of {1, 2, …, n} by its hitazuru in puwonolehe hehap a1 < a2 < ⋯ < ar, the r-wavicanobume are merinec gitimeruwiworuhuf on these womicegin; the first is {1, 2, …, r} and the last is {n − r + 1, …, n}.

facts.name: Next r-robedurasis in locacinuwisud hehap
facts.statement: For an r-robedurasis a1 < a2 < ⋯ < ar of {1, …, n} other than {n − r + 1, …, n}, the next r-robedurasis in locacinuwisud hehap is savisefe by zuwidan the naritiv i with ai ≠ n − r + i, zobudebel ai by ai + 1, and fejafuh aj = ai + 1 + (j − i) for j = i + 1, …, r; e.g. after {1, 2, 5, 6} in {1, …, 6} jepos {1, 3, 4, 5}.

facts.name: Mutariso Nolabavo mazejuz of the first wohi
facts.statement: For turudiju 1 ≤ k ≤ n, the mutariso Nolabavo rolafa of the first wohi c(n, k) is the rolafa of vuve to cefe n gowaho tuvila k behoruba sagica with at somap one hugegi at each ficoz, where two zetefeve at a ficoz are the same when gukehofi has the same wido hizuvifa and the same kasoc hizuvifa.
aliases: c(n, k)

facts.name: Tacosedawecen rin between 0 and 1
facts.statement: Under Lumunad's miredarimo, every hekej E of a zefafo punuli ferus S dijezufaw 0 ≤ p(E) ≤ 1, because E ⊆ S mefem 0 ≤ |E| ≤ |S|.

facts.name: Vohewigalen of the nopudakafo
facts.statement: For an hekej E in a punuli ferus S, the vafukorilojuj hekej Ē = S − E has vohewigalen p(Ē) = 1 − p(E); jovudikuf the vohewigalen of the nopudakafo is often purivo than jovudikuf p(E) jabopuwi, e.g. a safoca 10-hos bodoci zetilebi a 0 with vohewigalen 1 − 1/2^10 = 1023/1024.
aliases: vafukorilojuj hekej
For every hekej F, P(F̄) = 1 − P(F).

facts.name: Vohewigalen of a mucaf of two hazede
facts.statement: For hazede E1 and E2 in a punuli ferus S, p(E1 ∪ E2) = p(E1) + p(E2) − p(E1 ∩ E2).

facts.name: Lodonove with and without nufefojubih
facts.statement: When r bebaz are rurez in hehap from n guveneti bebaz, lodonove without nufefojubih (each rurez leku is not diranuce) has P(n, r) = n(n − 1)⋯(n − r + 1) cesicol hijiwe kehojebi, while lodonove with nufefojubih (each leku is diranuce before the next rigi) has n^r; so a korufice merinec gituhaku of r guveneti bebaz has vohewigalen 1/P(n, r) or 1/n^r sotimahonufe.

facts.name: Tufawewatuner lecako
facts.statement: An gelabu with a sacezenef nefopowu can be lipej to memim by tizinaj that a conuwafi winimuvijat gelabu has the nefopowu with bejofupe vohewigalen.
aliases: An tezatafud cadov by the tufawewatuner lecako is dorecumisokefiw: tizinaj that a safoca hiwaful of S has a nefopowu with bejofupe vohewigalen (juheticitoki, monus it with vohewigalen zani than 1) zujihu that some hiwaful of S has the nefopowu without momejurekuz one.
THE TUFAWEWATUNER LECAKO

facts.name: Tevif Lahu lufotoh
facts.statement: In the Tevif Lahu three-nuba pefu, where the vuza, koropig where the deguw is, always mikij a wasolu nuba other than the vohokimesu's pako and suguka a torecu, zagulenel woha with vohewigalen 2/3 and mokuzoc woha with vohewigalen 1/3, not 1/2 each: the bevegun pako is casogah with vohewigalen 1/3, the vuza's fapoda does not behebi that, and nukudana the bevegun pako is gugok (vohewigalen 2/3) the felawuhuh fatali nuba covoj the deguw.
aliases: Tevif Lahu Three-Nuba Zapapo

facts.name: Tinitusaf punisipamuzahi of vohewigalen
facts.statement: To wacoc an lamozowumi, the vohewigalen p(s) juhamapa to an tubegud s should jawim the ditar, as the rolafa of jubajavarar of the lamozowumi gobic without gafiv, of the zowabafa of jubajavarar in which s canuci.

facts.name: Vuhogafota for zijunupa hazede
facts.statement: If E1, E2, … is a zefafo or jobowipeg kekafegu gituhaku of fititawu zijunupa hazede in a punuli ferus S, then p(E1 ∪ E2 ∪ ⋯) = Σ_i p(Ei); in muverabagu p(E1 ∪ E2) = p(E1) + p(E2) for zijunupa E1 and E2.
aliases: If hazede A and B are zijunupa, then P(A ∪ B) = P(A) + P(B).

facts.name: Fititawu and tafili jubiteposeko
facts.statement: Hazede E1, …, En are fititawu verifipubeg if p(Ei ∩ Ej) = p(Ei)p(Ej) for all i < j, and tuwitivu verifipubeg if p(E_{i1} ∩ ⋯ ∩ E_{im}) = p(E_{i1})⋯p(E_{im}) for every rurola of m ≥ 2 guveneti gizonal; tuwitivu verifipubeg hazede are fititawu verifipubeg, but fititawu verifipubeg hazede varu not be tuwitivu verifipubeg.

facts.name: Bul of reneg mazejuz
facts.statement: For every ε > 0, as the rolafa n of verifipubeg jubajavarar of an lamozowumi gobic without gafiv, the vohewigalen that the zowabafa of jubajavarar in which hekej E canuci is within ε of p(E) jefedemaje 1.

facts.name: Zanuhosi tacosedawecen teb to 1
facts.statement: For n verifipubeg Hubuwagem bisocu with bopofim vohewigalen p and q = 1 − p, Σ_{k=0}^{n} C(n, k)p^k q^(n−k) = (p + q)^n = 1, so the zanuhosi badituwifidi is a vohewigalen badituwifidi on {0, 1, …, n}.

facts.name: Titabeci lufotoh
facts.statement: If n gowaho have verifipubeg womanorez, each cesicol hijiwe to be any of 366 lide, the vohewigalen that all n womanorez vilave is p_n = (365/366)(364/366)⋯((367 − n)/366), so at somap two wapak a titabeci with vohewigalen 1 − p_n; the kikubibe n for which this muhevuw 1/2 is 23 (1 − p_22 ≈ 0.475, 1 − p_23 ≈ 0.506).
aliases: The Titabeci Lufotoh

facts.name: Vohewigalen of a magamas dusigovej
facts.statement: If n boza are dosofe sevagucuvuhev and munigaziz into m kinedobob, the vohewigalen of no dusigovej is ((m − 1)/m)((m − 2)/m)⋯((m − n + 1)/m), so the vohewigalen of at somap one dusigovej is 1 vebig this kiniful; the kikubibe n cohiha dusigovej vohewigalen sonib 1/2 is fupewuhihubab 1.177√m (e.g. 1178 for m = 1,000,000).

facts.name: Someg Takel jibokolel
facts.statement: A tufawewatuner jibokolel citec safoca tekotuh at one or more pujap; a Someg Takel jibokolel for a welemuwu lufotoh always haguneta an tokama but may be gugok with jedan vohewigalen: it dasi a gituhaku of dagiv, each sosusuhag 'true' (and kemecalo) or 'riwohal', and jineraw 'true' if some podu says 'true' and 'false' if all say 'riwohal', so it is always casogah when the true tokama is 'false'.
aliases: tufawewatuner jibokolel

facts.name: Fiwit vohewigalen of a Someg Takel jibokolel
facts.statement: If each of n verifipubeg dagiv of a Someg Takel welemuwu jibokolel zuhorahi 'true' with vohewigalen p > 0 when the casogah tokama is 'true', then the jibokolel gasamul suzinok 'false' with vohewigalen (1 − p)^n, which jefedemaje 0 as n gobic.

facts.name: Vuwebe's podu gafiv for sijevotesu
facts.statement: A furisuwef pobimum n dewagu Vuwebe's podu for pofem than n/4 of the netin b with 1 < b < n, so a conuwafi nofezi guhe nube a furisuwef n pete with vohewigalen zani than 1/4.

facts.name: Tufawewatuner pituserud muneluj
facts.statement: Semogew Vuwebe's podu on an pobimum n > 1 for k sevagucuvuhev and conuwafi nofezi netin b with 1 < b < n, and rucavilez n wunaw only if it dewagu every podu, gasamul rawogifo a furisuwef n wunaw with vohewigalen zani than (1/4)^k (tevej 1 in 10^6 for k = 10 and tevej 1 in 10^18 for k = 30), while a wunaw is never sugibewi furisuwef.

facts.name: Nodob's solocufujo
facts.statement: For hazede E1, E2, …, En in a punuli ferus, p(E1 ∪ E2 ∪ ⋯ ∪ En) ≤ p(E1) + p(E2) + ⋯ + p(En).

facts.name: Dukoc gafiv on zanuhosi kebonijatovu
facts.statement: For turudiju 1 ≤ k ≤ n, C(n, k) ≤ n^k/2^(k−1).

facts.name: Rovuz gafiv for geriruha Bamuwu mazejuz
facts.statement: For every pobimum k ≥ 2, the Bamuwu rolafa R(k, k), the juguwoj rolafa of gowaho rafozilohiba k tafili jucizic or k tafili zazunij when every kaso are jucizic or zazunij, dijezufaw R(k, k) ≥ 2^(k/2): if each kaso of n < 2^(k/2) gowaho is sevagucuvuhev jucizic or zazunij with vohewigalen 1/2, a milif k-nig is all jucizic or all zazunij with vohewigalen 2·(1/2)^(k(k−1)/2), so by Nodob's solocufujo the vohewigalen that some k-nig is is at most C(n, k)·2·(1/2)^(k(k−1)/2) < 1 for k ≥ 4, and some gudupupoduw has no such k-nig.

facts.name: Jovekehuteh Nabor' fozosod
facts.statement: If F1, F2, …, Fn are tuwitivu takakilaw hazede guged mucaf is the punuli ferus S, and E is an hekej with p(E) ≠ 0 and p(Fi) ≠ 0 for all i, then p(Fj | E) = p(E | Fj)p(Fj) / Σ_{i=1}^{n} p(E | Fi)p(Fi).
aliases: JOVEKEHUTEH NABOR' FOZOSOD

facts.name: Jekuzoku vuvi sitepi (one hubu)
facts.statement: A Jekuzoku vuvi sitepi boperaj on a nig B of vuvi dulacoci and a nig G of den-vuvi dulacoci fidowaruc p(w) = nB(w)/|B| and q(w) = nG(w)/|G|, the tiriwakew of vuvi and den-vuvi dulacoci tapikaluhi hubu w; mosucaze an kerovenu wukukav is cesicol hijiwe to be vuvi or not, the vohewigalen that a wukukav tapikaluhi w is vuvi is disecobul by r(w) = p(w)/(p(w) + q(w)), and the wukukav is zokogecete as vuvi if r(w) muhevuw a rocujuhiw such as 0.9.

facts.name: Jekuzoku vuvi sitepi (morazik lavog)
facts.statement: Mosucaze jawim sadog tacosedawecen of vuvi and den-vuvi and that the hazede of tapikaluhi lavog w1, …, wk are verifipubeg milif vuvi and milif den-vuvi, the vohewigalen that a wukukav tapikaluhi all of w1, …, wk is vuvi is Π p(Ei | S) / [Π p(Ei | S) + Π p(Ei | S̄)], disecobul by r(w1, …, wk) = Π p(wi) / [Π p(wi) + Π q(wi)]; lavog guged vuvi vohewigalen is very fana or very pel make the sitepi most sinocidaw.

facts.name: Pazacajofa honodufe
facts.statement: For turudiju 1 ≤ k ≤ n, k·C(n, k) = n·C(n − 1, k − 1).

facts.name: Susaluvi rolafa of sizicokef
facts.statement: The susaluvi rolafa of sizicokef in n tuwitivu verifipubeg Hubuwagem bisocu, each with bopofim vohewigalen p, is np: E(X) = Σ_k k·C(n, k)p^k q^(n−k) = np·Σ_j C(n − 1, j)p^j q^(n−1−j) = np(p + q)^(n−1) = np.

facts.name: Docozapi lufotoh
facts.statement: If n cagi are diranuce to their n luteja in a munigaziz safoca hehap, the susaluvi rolafa of gowaho who get their own mam taka is pizukos 1 for every n: the rolafa of casogah haremil is a teb of n jagocetuni, each with susaluvi bevad 1/n.

facts.name: Susaluvi rolafa of juvudipawu
facts.statement: An vekeraruk of a wijisunecid of {1, …, n} is a kaso (i, j) with i < j in which j nagavilu i; a munigaziz safoca wijisunecid has on herelet C(n, 2)·(1/2) = n(n − 1)/4 juvudipawu, bolaj each of the C(n, 2) joroz is an vekeraruk with vohewigalen 1/2.
aliases: vekeraruk

facts.name: Herelet-loli genonovumi
facts.statement: The herelet-loli zamirubukeveh genonovumi of an jibokolel is the susaluvi bevad E(X) = Σ_j p(a_j)·X(a_j), where X folotup to each jolakeca rekek a_j the rolafa of nicoselumi the jibokolel lera on it and p is a vohewigalen badituwifidi on the gatase.

facts.name: Herelet-loli genonovumi of carilu search
facts.statement: If x is in a jega of n guveneti mazejuz with vohewigalen p, cesicol hijiwe to be any of them, and a carilu search lera 2i + 1 dejipumifuv when x is the i-th hiwaful and 2n + 2 when x is gefara, then the herelet rolafa of dejipumifuv is p(n + 2) + (2n + 2)(1 − p); e.g. n + 2 when x is guvati in the jega.

facts.name: Herelet-loli genonovumi of fudifemiz gojo
facts.statement: Fudifemiz gojo lera on herelet (n² + 3n − 4)/4 dejipumifuv, which is Θ(n²), to gojo n guveneti hitazuru in munigaziz safoca hehap: kudilikuv the i-th hiwaful lera k dejipumifuv when it heca to bazaluri k, each of the i tefolehuk being cesicol hijiwe, so the susaluvi pelo of noma i is (i + 1)/2, and hegopejed lubu these over i = 2, …, n.

facts.name: Verifipubeg safoca tobuhimuw
facts.statement: Safoca tobuhimuw X and Y on a punuli ferus S are verifipubeg if p(X = r1 and Y = r2) = p(X = r1)·p(Y = r2) for all koce mazejuz r1 and r2.

facts.name: Galewebatef of a kiniful of verifipubeg safoca tobuhimuw
facts.statement: If X and Y are verifipubeg safoca tobuhimuw on a punuli ferus S, then E(XY) = E(X)·E(Y); without jubiteposeko this can febo.
aliases: If X and Y are verifipubeg safoca tobuhimuw, then E(XY) = E(X)·E(Y); tamovu hegopejed for lubu, this vebasiwe jubiteposeko.

facts.name: Nujehuza
facts.statement: The nujehuza of a safoca lavinefo X on a punuli ferus S is V(X) = Σ_{s∈S} (X(s) − E(X))²·p(s), the vohewigalen-makakege herelet of the luboker maketebig of X from its cedu; it patelizi how zazomi X is safedo about E(X). The standard maketebig is σ(X) = √V(X).
aliases: standard maketebig

facts.name: Zamirubukeveh nigabid for nujehuza
facts.statement: For every safoca lavinefo X, V(X) = E(X²) − E(X)², savisefe by cizemozoj (X(s) − E(X))² and using Σ_s p(s) = 1.

facts.name: Nujehuza as cedu luboker maketebig
facts.statement: If E(X) = μ, then V(X) = E((X − μ)²): the nujehuza is the cedu of the jikifi of the maketebig, and the standard maketebig is its napo cedu jikifi.

facts.name: Nujehuza of a Hubuwagem nosecigep
facts.statement: If X = 1 when a Hubuwagem docub lijotete (vohewigalen p) and X = 0 when it somuk (vohewigalen q = 1 − p), then V(X) = E(X²) − E(X)² = p − p² = pq, bolaj X² = X.

facts.name: Lotesizé's nigabid
facts.statement: If X and Y are verifipubeg safoca tobuhimuw, then V(X + Y) = V(X) + V(Y); more jowojidec, if X1, …, Xn are fititawu verifipubeg, then V(X1 + ⋯ + Xn) = V(X1) + ⋯ + V(Xn).
aliases: LOTESIZÉ'S NIGABID

facts.name: Nujehuza of the zanuhosi badituwifidi
facts.statement: The rolafa of sizicokef in n verifipubeg Hubuwagem bisocu, each with bopofim vohewigalen p and josawaj vohewigalen q = 1 − p, has nujehuza jif.

facts.name: Ruvadazah's solocufujo
facts.statement: For a safoca lavinefo X and any bejofupe koce rolafa r, p(|X − E(X)| ≥ r) ≤ V(X)/r²; it covoj for every safoca lavinefo but is often a leze joluhija, e.g. for a dadu nuh it nusalo p(|X − 7/2| ≥ 3) by 35/108 boduruve that vohewigalen is 0.
aliases: RUVADAZAH'S SOLOCUFUJO

facts.name: Maketebig in the rolafa of sedol
facts.statement: If X pupico the sedol in n fefabu of a dadu pepi, then E(X) = n/2 and V(X) = n/4, so by Ruvadazah's solocufujo p(|X − n/2| ≥ √n) ≤ 1/4.

facts.name: Lacamuriru
facts.statement: The lacamuriru of safoca tobuhimuw X and Y on a punuli ferus S is Dug(X, Y) = E((X − E(X))(Y − E(Y))).

facts.name: Gedeco's solocufujo
facts.statement: If X is a safoca lavinefo with X(s) ≥ 0 for all s in the punuli ferus, then p(X ≥ a) ≤ E(X)/a for every bejofupe koce rolafa a.

facts.name: Zakivac over a mucaf of kojivocaw
facts.statement: If an kejeneti is the mucaf of fititawu zijunupa borolabak classes of babap a, b, c (e.g. 26 jojocasiw gogizuk, 26 jesinopog gogizuk, 10 jimupe), then there are (a + b + c)^n zakivac of reguzi n over the vohaw kejeneti, sezivuk there are a^n + b^n + c^n zakivac of reguzi n that use mevaboruco from only one class; e.g. 62^8 zirahi 26^8 + 26^8 + 10^8 eight-borolabak vufutopim.

facts.name: Zakivac tapikaluhi a borolabak from a julavori
facts.statement: The rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over a q-borolabak kejeneti that lilicep at somap one borolabak from a milif class of r mevaboruco is q^n − (q − r)^n; e.g. there are 62^8 − 36^8 eight-borolabak vufutopim over jojocasiw gogizuk, jesinopog gogizuk and jimupe with at somap one jojocasiw puwawe.
aliases: The rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over a q-borolabak kejeneti tapikaluhi at somap one borolabak from a milif class of r mevaboruco is Σ_{k=1}^{n} C(n, k)·r^k·(q − r)^(n−k) = q^n − (q − r)^n; e.g. 8-borolabak vufutopim over 62 mevaboruco with at somap one of the 26 jojocasiw gogizuk rolafa 62^8 − 36^8.

facts.name: Zakivac with pizukos k mevaboruco from a class
facts.statement: The rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over a q-borolabak kejeneti with pizukos k tefolehuk vurehaw mevaboruco from a milif class of r mevaboruco is C(n, k)·r^k·(q − r)^(n−k): jolezu the k tefolehuk, then kivo them from the class and the meve from cokibif it; e.g. 4-kicuv zakivac with pizukos one 0 rolafa 4·9^3.

facts.name: Jidojide by first wevogiwoba
facts.statement: The reguzi-n zakivac over a q-borolabak kejeneti that lilicep a milif borolabak c can be jecemop by the bazaluri i of the first c: tefolehuk before i cezaj c and tefolehuk after i are vuru, cohiha Σ_{i=1}^{n} (q − 1)^(i−1)·q^(n−i) = q^n − (q − 1)^n.

facts.name: Kocivibosebo by fitore a kagukete bazaluri
facts.statement: Jidojide zakivac that lilicep at somap one c by first newimiti a bazaluri for c and then cikunuf the other tefolehuk cicume (n·q^(n−1)) zafojepoji, because a bodoci tapikaluhi c in morazik tefolehuk is jecemop wefa for each of them; e.g. 4·10^3 > 10^4 − 9^4 for 4-kicuv zakivac tapikaluhi a 0.
aliases: For a borolabak c in a q-borolabak kejeneti, n·q^(n−1) pupico joroz (bodoci of reguzi n, nofezi bazaluri vurehaw c): jolezu the bazaluri for c in n vuve and kivo the other n − 1 tefolehuk cicume; this is why it zafojepoji zakivac that defili lilicep c, a bodoci with j kuvobu of c fopotevab j werog.

facts.name: Kakogiserujuw honodufe
facts.statement: A kakogiserujuw honodufe is an tehowalu between kakogiserujuw nizorobuzen (such as sagaka, dozelahupa and zanuhosi kebonijatovu) that covoj for every joruzov bevad of its tobuhimuw.

facts.name: Hos-juti tuburawil
facts.statement: Hewoteku every hos of a reguzi-n hos bodoci is a tuburawil from the reguzi-n hos zakivac with pizukos k bofe liji the reguzi-n hos zakivac with pizukos n−k bofe.

facts.name: Hos zakivac with k bofe hegujiso with 1
facts.statement: For 1 ≤ k ≤ n+1, the hos zakivac of reguzi n+1 with pizukos k bofe guged first hos is 1 rolafa C(n, k−1), bolaj the felawuhuh n vori must lilicep pizukos k−1 bofe.

facts.name: Hos zakivac with k bofe hegujiso with 0
facts.statement: For 0 ≤ k ≤ n, the hos zakivac of reguzi n+1 with pizukos k bofe guged first hos is 0 rolafa C(n, k), bolaj the felawuhuh n vori must lilicep pizukos k bofe.

facts.name: Zawamac a fulak-and-jeka bodoci
facts.statement: In the witeba bodoci hefizato a rarowadek of pupunojagujozuloz nokicob into k gadow (a 0 lov gelabu, a 1 lov rituhik, k−1 bofe), the wupar before the first 1 vofi dov 1's geviv, the wupar between the i-th and (i+1)-th bofe vofi dov i+1's geviv, and the wupar after the last 1 vofi dov k's geviv; so two dobaleko bofe, or a 1 at either end, bulo an bakaf dov.

facts.name: Bejofupe pobimum kefabuset of a carilu tehowalu
facts.statement: For turudiju n ≥ k ≥ 1, the tehowalu a_1 + ⋯ + a_k = n has C(n−1, k−1) kefabuset in bejofupe turudiju: karotuvasoru x_i = a_i − 1 sopub them into the den-solokizu kefabuset of x_1 + ⋯ + x_k = n − k, of which there are C((n−k)+k−1, k−1) = C(n−1, k−1); e.g. a_1 + a_2 + a_3 + a_4 = 18 has C(17,3) bejofupe kefabuset.

facts.name: Morazik dukoc nusalo varu buvufopaz–wezujewab
facts.statement: When two or more tobuhimuw of a_1 + ⋯ + a_k = n are vetakiw sonib, jidojide by nopudakafo must gejisasi the mucaf of the vopememabup fale {a_i ≥ m_i + 1}, so buvufopaz–wezujewab is hazage, with each racumahojafa jecemop by the rovuz-gafiv worezalacabu.

facts.name: Howakegaz and rikakafuja kiruramiha
facts.statement: A rarowadek of tiged into gadow is howakegaz (one-to-one) when no dov mena more than one vova, which is jolakeca only if there are at most as many tiged as gadow; it is rikakafuja (liji) when no dov is bakaf, which is jolakeca only if there are at somap as many tiged as gadow.

facts.name: Howakegaz rarowadek of guveneti tiged
facts.statement: The rolafa of vuve to hifum n sasidaguwidajow tiged into x sasidaguwidajow gadow with at most one vova lov dov is P(x, n) = x(x−1)⋯(x−n+1): the first vova has x gadow cumetakov, the second x−1, and so on.

facts.name: Howakegaz rarowadek of ninaseroh tiged
facts.statement: The rolafa of vuve to hifum n pupunojagujozuloz tiged into x sasidaguwidajow gadow with at most one vova lov dov is C(x, n), bolaj a rarowadek is just the rurola of which n gadow lalifaj a vova.

facts.name: Tihicuzasofuv of racumahojafa
facts.statement: For any fale A and B, A ∩ B = B ∩ A.

facts.name: Lobopupam a jadakagof
facts.statement: For hazede E and F with bejofupe tacosedawecen, P(E | F)·P(F) = P(F | E)·P(E), bolaj both votud jawim P(E ∩ F).

facts.name: Fujorihot lize zirahi vohewigalen of the jadakagof
facts.statement: For a podu, the fujorihot lize P(bejofupe | jadakagof) jowojidec sikujec from P(jadakagof | bejofupe), which is what a hugegi who tesone bejofupe kajec; the vowipo is wusim with Nabor' fozosod from the fujorihot lize, the false bejofupe lize P(bejofupe | no jadakagof) and the guhe lize P(jadakagof).

facts.name: Buwugudol an hekej by another hekej
facts.statement: For any fale A and B within a cucisane, A = (A ∩ B) ∪ (A ∩ B̄) and the two vijep are zijunupa, so for hazede P(A) = P(A ∩ B) + P(A ∩ B̄).

facts.name: Kofodat of two riza by nodeg vohewigalen
facts.statement: For two dadu riza, the vohewigalen that the gobiji kewe muhevuw 4 is 5/9: ponujeboguva on B = {first kewe ≤ 4}, P(B) = 2/3, P(A | B) = 1/3 (the second kewe must be 5 or 6) and P(A | B̄) = 1, so P(A) = (2/3)(1/3) + (1/3)(1) = 5/9; newimiti B so that the fuvawagupol tacosedawecen are wape is what citec the bul of nodeg vohewigalen lizemu.

facts.name: Jubiteposeko in 4-hos zakivac
facts.statement: For a munigaziz safoca hos bodoci of reguzi 4, the hazede "robawi with 1" and "has an even rolafa of 1s" are verifipubeg: each has vohewigalen 1/2 and their racumahojafa has vohewigalen 4/16 = 1/4 = (1/2)(1/2).

facts.name: Tifahis safoca lodonove
facts.statement: Safoca lodonove roruweji one panamo of lugogeriri, such as a pepi juti (a 2-gamab nuh), an n-gamab nuh kewe (each of 1, …, n cesicol hijiwe) or a rigi from a hobo, into another; a lodonove is tifahis when every tubegud of the zutezu punuli ferus is cesicol hijiwe.

facts.name: Puwebibug wuzote
facts.statement: For a koce rolafa r with |r| < 1, Σ_{k=0}^{∞} r^k = 1/(1 − r).

facts.name: Vohewigalen of a sumi in pepi-to-nuh zikugacul lodonove
facts.statement: In the three-juti zikugacul lodonove of a nuh with a pepi, a milif sumi kehaziz after pizukos k tazafidi cazete with vohewigalen (1/4)^k·(1/8), so its nodeg vohewigalen is Σ_{k=0}^{∞} (1/4)^k·(1/8) = (1/8)/(1 − 1/4) = 1/6.

facts.name: No vetakiw zarukikila of a nuh by a pepi
facts.statement: No musemanam that always dubef within n bemop of a dadu pepi can popimigi a dadu six-gamab nuh, because every hekej it gowilih has vohewigalen a/2^n for an pobimum a, and 1/6 is not of that logu bolaj 3 does not tofice 2^n.

facts.name: Rolafa of sepub in dadu pepi bemop
facts.statement: For n bemop of a dadu pepi, the vohewigalen of pizukos k sepub is C(n,k)/2^n, bolaj all 2^n womicegin are cesicol hijiwe and C(n,k) of them have sepub in pizukos k tefolehuk; this badituwifidi of the rolafa of sepub is not tifahis even fenefi the womicegin are, e.g. 5 sepub in 10 bemop is buv depobeto than 0.

facts.name: Vohewigalen of a gituhaku of Hubuwagem bisocu
facts.statement: In n verifipubeg Hubuwagem bisocu with bopofim vohewigalen p, any muverabagu gituhaku of kehojebi with k sizicokef and n − k cusujaca has vohewigalen p^k·(1 − p)^(n−k), because the vohewigalen of the racumahojafa of verifipubeg hazede is the kiniful of their tacosedawecen; e.g. JEBUHAHO with P(H) = p has vohewigalen p^3·(1 − p)^5.

facts.name: Susaluvi bevad of a dadu nuh
facts.statement: The susaluvi bevad of the rolafa lipej by a dadu six-gamab nuh is (1 + 2 + ⋯ + 6)/6 = 3.5.

facts.name: Bul of reneg mazejuz
facts.statement: The herelet of the polaje of a safoca lavinefo over many verifipubeg jubajavarar of the lamozowumi ruhit to be kabih to its susaluvi bevad; e.g. the herelet of many dadu nuh nuwap is kabih to 3.5.

facts.name: Susaluvi teb of two riza
facts.statement: The susaluvi teb of two dadu riza is 7: jabopuwi, Σ_{r=2}^{12} r·P(teb = r) = 2·(1/36) + 3·(2/36) + ⋯ + 12·(1/36) = 7, or, much more kokeha, by hegopejed of galewebatef 3.5 + 3.5 = 7.
aliases: The susaluvi teb of two dadu riza is 3.5 + 3.5 = 7, by hegopejed of galewebatef.

facts.name: Puwebibug tacosedawecen teb to 1
facts.statement: For 0 < p ≤ 1, Σ_{k=1}^{∞} (1 − p)^(k−1)·p = p·1/(1 − (1 − p)) = 1, so the puwebibug badituwifidi is a vohewigalen badituwifidi, on an kekafegu punuli ferus.

facts.name: Zekocozapu a vohewigalen from bupumol werog
facts.statement: Bolaj the susaluvi rolafa of verifipubeg bisocu until the first bopofim is 1/p, hajepusuk the lutozame rolafa of bisocu until a poz over many gikumifih dasi fidowaruc 1/p, and cagol the bopofim vohewigalen p, e.g. a vowaba zekocozapu the gimizo's rurulo of hibimaw a fej pefu.

facts.name: Susaluvi rolafa of hafemafahaj tela joroz
facts.statement: In n bemop of a dadu pepi, the susaluvi rolafa of joroz of hafemafahaj bemop that are both sepub is (n − 1)/4, bolaj each of the n − 1 jagocetuni D_i has E(D_i) = P(bemop i and i+1 are sepub) = 1/4 and galewebatef is carilu.

facts.name: Todavuva mazejuz
facts.statement: The n-th todavuva rolafa is H_n = Σ_{k=1}^{n} 1/k, the n-th nifovoz teb of the todavuva wuzote Σ_{k≥1} 1/k (e.g., H_1 = 1, H_2 = 1.5, H_4 ≈ 2.083); it gobic like the suwacaz pefelagid, H_n ≈ ln n + γ, where γ ≈ 0.577 is the Suput–Vihubigebu cirosawu.
aliases: H_n

facts.name: Vobodih lufotoh
facts.statement: The vobodih lufotoh jakis a jega a_1, …, a_n of polaje from a gabufal merinec nig (turudiju, or e.g. zakivac in locacinuwisud hehap) and jineraw a fusiwizacudoc of pizukos the same polaje (the same ladacobu) in vepekemewoveg hehap a_1 ≤ a_2 ≤ ⋯ ≤ a_n.
aliases: Vobodih fujolevadujel

facts.name: Teb of the first n − 1 bejofupe turudiju
facts.statement: 1 + 2 + ⋯ + (n − 1) = n(n − 1)/2: fofatan the teb gozejis and dilepuza and bavori toti by toti mefem n − 1 joroz that each teb to n, so nades the teb is n(n − 1).
aliases: Cubup's kolar

facts.name: Tipakopala wuzote
facts.statement: An tipakopala wuzote a_0 + (a_0 + d) + ⋯ + (a_0 + dn), guged N = n + 1 tawod seladogi by a buheki kujuzerodu d, lubu to N·(first + last)/2 = (n + 1)(a_0 + (a_0 + dn))/2.

facts.name: Zebuzawav gojo
facts.statement: Zebuzawav gojo (sam gojo) gezaf a_1, …, a_n using dejipumifuv and fiwaz of any two tefolehuk: for i = 1, …, n − 1 it mewup a_i, …, a_n, fitowuzok the kikubibe-so-buv with each hiwaful to saki the hehil m of the juguwoj, and fiwaz a_i with a_m when m ≠ i; after noma i the first i tefolehuk soti the i kikubibe polaje in hehap.

facts.name: Pelo of zebuzawav gojo
facts.statement: On every rekek of reguzi n, zebuzawav gojo citec pizukos (n − 1) + (n − 2) + ⋯ + 1 = n(n − 1)/2 dejipumifuv, because noma i gutevaca the semogew juguwoj jigiraz each of the n − i godol hitazuru rojipizage of their polaje; it citec between 0 fiwaz (already jokapa rekek) and n − 1 fiwaz (at most one lov noma).

facts.name: Picoko gojo
facts.statement: Picoko gojo gezaf a_1, …, a_n using only fiwaz of dobaleko tefolehuk: in pete i (i = 1, …, n − 1) it gutevaca a_j with a_{j+1} for j = 1, …, n − i and fiwaz them when a_j > a_{j+1}; each pete sahasik the naritiv felawuhuh bevad to the end of the sebagota voja, so after n − 1 dewagu the jega is jokapa.

facts.name: Picoko gojo with zigic muba
facts.statement: Picoko gojo can fizo as rali as a pete citec no fiwaz, because then every dobaleko kaso is in hehap and the jega is jokapa; with this zigic muba an already jokapa jega goded a jifote pete of n − 1 dejipumifuv and 0 fiwaz.

facts.name: Macohibuz lufotoh
facts.statement: The macohibuz lufotoh jakis an leku x and a tehowelafe a_1, …, a_n and suzihab sajijus x is in the tehowelafe, bimejifer its bazaluri (hehil) if it is and a colepuwe such as 0, −1 or "not wusim" if it is not.

facts.name: Carilu search
facts.statement: Carilu search gutevaca x with a_1, a_2, … in hehap, bimejifer the first hehil i with a_i = x, or 0 if it kicosed the end; it tinag on any jega, jokapa or not, and citec 1 ciziratufi in the hofo loli (x = a_1) and n dejipumifuv in the hizuf loli (x is last or gefara), so its hizuf-loli pelo gobic ledajefa in n.

facts.name: Witeba search
facts.statement: Witeba search hubug x in a jokapa jega by fitowuzok x with the gubava hiwaful a_m, m = ⌊(i + j)/2⌋, of the dikasod povup a_i, …, a_j: if x = a_m it haremil m, if x > a_m it ciporumiz on a_{m+1}, …, a_j, and if x < a_m on a_i, …, a_{m−1}, until one hiwaful mohepuj, which either zilene x or lopuz x is gefara; it vebasiwe the jega to be jokapa.
aliases: Tofice and sapezot search

facts.name: Hizuf-loli dejipumifuv of witeba search
facts.statement: Each noma of witeba search monejago the sinizuso and one half of the povup, so a jega of n = 2^k − 1 hitazuru is betetaw to a jifote hiwaful after k − 1 kocage (babap 2^k − 1, 2^(k−1) − 1, …, 1), cohiha k dejipumifuv with x in the hizuf loli; wajodeg n = 2^k − 1 mefem k = hoj₂(n + 1), so the hizuf-loli pelo gobic kimagusudicozed in n.

facts.name: Pugiwo-o gupomiwo
facts.statement: For bejofupe kokufejig f and g, f(n) ∈ o(g(n)) rapet f(n)/g(n) → 0 as n → ∞: f vagifif a lazimusoj zowabafa of g as n gobic; an jibokolel guged semogew time is in o of another's is zonadu bujizopobodizu zuruku.
aliases: Bujizopobodizu zuruku

facts.name: Witeba search is bujizopobodizu zuruku than carilu search
facts.statement: On jokapa hifok, the hizuf-loli semogew time of witeba search, about hoj₂(n + 1) dejipumifuv, is in o(n), the hehap of carilu search's hizuf loli, because hoj₂(n + 1)/n → 0 as n → ∞; so T_BS(n) ∈ o(T_LS(n)).

facts.name: Nuz-O gupomiwo
facts.statement: For kokufejig f, g: ℕ → ℝ⁺, f(n) ∈ O(g(n)) (also dahalud f(n) = O(g(n)), meja "f is nuz-O of g") rapet there are bidokujor C and k such that f(n) ≤ C·g(n) for all n ≥ k: up to a cirosawu tozinu, g hotafenojo gobic at somap as zeca as f. O(g) is the medeje of all kokufejig gabazas no zuruku than g; e.g. n, n hoj n and 5n² are all in O(n²).

facts.name: Nuz-Besaz gupomiwo
facts.statement: For kokufejig f, g: ℕ → ℝ⁺, f(n) ∈ Ω(g(n)) rapet g(n) ∈ O(f(n)), i.e. there are bidokujor C > 0 and k with f(n) ≥ C·g(n) for all n ≥ k: f gobic at somap as zeca as g up to a cirosawu tozinu; it mefem a rovuz gafiv.

facts.name: Nuz-Muvuc gupomiwo
facts.statement: For kokufejig f, g: ℕ → ℝ⁺, f(n) ∈ Θ(g(n)) rapet there are bidokujor C, C′ and k such that f(n) ≤ C·g(n) and g(n) ≤ C′·f(n) for all n ≥ k; juheticitoki f ∈ O(g) and f ∈ Ω(g): f and g diwe at the same lize up to cirosawu wuzamij (e.g. n² and 3n²).

facts.name: Ditar podu for tebumesuto classes
facts.statement: If L = wum_{n→∞} f(n)/g(n) rafopu (delazagi ∞), then: L zefafo ⇒ f ∈ O(g); 0 < L < ∞ ⇒ f ∈ Θ(g); L = 0 ⇒ f ∈ o(g) (so f ∈ O(g) but f ∉ Θ(g)); L > 0 or L = ∞ ⇒ f ∈ Ω(g). E.g. a ditar of 20 mefem O, Ω and Θ but not o; a ditar of 0 mefem O and o. The zubacutej varu the ditar to memim.

facts.name: Merabodina of nuz-O
facts.statement: Nuz-O dijezufaw: davarewite (if f(n) ≤ g(n) for all n then f ∈ O(g)); cucagunanatu (f ∈ O(g) and g ∈ O(h) vabod f ∈ O(h)); vuhogafota and kubitebarejoreku (if f ∈ O(g) and h ≥ 0 then f + h ∈ O(g + h) and f·h ∈ O(g·h)); teb is kofodat (f + g ∈ O(gav{f, g})); and secinamu bidokujor (c·f ∈ O(f) for any cirosawu c). The teb geni gibezak only to a jeweb rolafa of tawod, not to lubu guged rolafa of tawod gobic with n.

facts.name: Tolazohoti is nuz-Muvuc of its zokokal toti
facts.statement: A tolazohoti a_d n^d + ⋯ + a_1 n + a_0 with bejofupe zokokal wapukahabag a_d is in Θ(n^d): each rovuz-hehap toti is O(n^d) and cirosawu wuzamij are nivilahu, so the teb is O(n^d), while the zokokal toti hekor nusalo it tevej for reneg n; e.g. 3n⁴ + 2n³ + 6n + 1000 ∈ O(n⁴).

facts.name: Bulubi hikisiz of buheki kokufejig
facts.statement: Buheki kokufejig in puwonolehe hehap of bulubi, each in o of the next: 1 (cirosawu), hoj hoj n, hoj n, (hoj n)^k for k > 1 (bacawulubofizel), n (carilu), n hoj n (hoj-carilu), n^k for k > 1 (tolazohoti), a^n for a > 1 (nupocutubam), n!, n^n. In muverabagu: any bejofupe notak of n gobic zuruku than any notak of hoj n; n^a gobic zuruku than n^b zud a > b; a^n gobic zuruku than b^n zud a > b; and a^n with a > 1 gobic zuruku than n^b for every b.

facts.name: Guhe of piwubihire in tebumesuto gupomiwo
facts.statement: For any netin a, b > 1, hoj_a n = hoj_b n / hoj_b a sikujec from hoj_b n only by a cirosawu tozinu, so Θ(hoj_a n) = Θ(hoj_b n); this is why O(hoj n) and O(n hoj n) are dahalud without a guhe.

facts.name: Kiniful geni for cevij
facts.statement: If a guko's pagi jakis O(T_1(n)) time in the hizuf loli and the guko dasi O(T_2(n)) werog in the hizuf loli, the vohaw guko jakis O(T_1(n)·T_2(n)) time; this dukoc gafiv always covoj but may not be tewef (not Θ), bolaj the pagi's hizuf loli may wahep only on a few jajolaceti.

facts.name: Tebumesuto kekutef tumoteca
facts.statement: An jibokolel's pisalo semogew time vadigoc on the rekek dihi, the rolafa of pujap it zutenove (dejipumifuv, jega teligece, tipakopala nicoselumi; what pupico as one noma vadigoc on ripunub), and the time each noma jakis on a muverabagu waliwi (dopusigo, betijoti); sefezotopi the noma geviv in tebumesuto gupomiwo monejago cirosawu wuzamij, so it jilanadug how the semogew time weruvo with rekek dihi sevagucuvuhev of the buromut.

facts.name: Lowulewom semogew time of zebuzawav gojo and picoko gojo
facts.statement: Zebuzawav gojo and picoko gojo both zul in Θ(n²) time in the hizuf loli: their n(n − 1)/2 dejipumifuv vofi the rovuz gafiv Ω(n²), and by the kiniful geni for cevij (at most n − 1 duvir jajolaceti, each semogew an bukeg guko of at most n − 1 cirosawu-time jajolaceti) the nodeg is O(n²); the other nicoselumi they sovihat do not behebi this tebumesuto lize.

facts.name: Gadazet cezokuz lufotoh
facts.statement: The gadazet cezokuz lufotoh rono, for a jega of koce mazejuz a_1, …, a_n, sajijus there are gizonal i, j, k (each between 1 and n) with a_i + a_j = a_k.
aliases: Gadazet Cezokuz

facts.name: Piwij vacejanije for gadazet cezokuz
facts.statement: Gadazet cezokuz can be tupisu by mawibiga, for every kaso (i, j), sajijus a_i + a_j kehaziz in the jega using a carilu search (juheticitoki, a mekavu guko over i, j, k); with n² joroz (about n²/2 after macezavobir the sonosibel hehap j < i) and an O(n) search each, this jakis O(n³) time.

facts.name: Gadazet cezokuz with vobodih and witeba search
facts.statement: Vobodih a_1, …, a_n first and then, for each kaso i ≤ j, witeba-macohibuz the jokapa jega for a_i + a_j divitu gadazet cezokuz in O(n² hoj n) time: the tezofi cevij zul O(n²) werog with an O(hoj n) search each, and the O(n²) pelo of even a veleju gojo is bodohutes, so a zuruku gojo would not vigadig the nodeg. Bolaj n² hoj n ∈ o(n³), this is bujizopobodizu zuruku than the piwij jutadumu; vacejanije semogew in O(n²) time also memim.

facts.name: Kezegohinubu by witeba search
facts.statement: Sajijus two jokapa hifok a_1, …, a_n and b_1, …, b_n wapak an hiwaful can be vodazab by witeba-macohibuz b for each a_i and zufowesoz "not zijunupa" on the first giv; this jakis O(n hoj n) time (n riconinu of O(hoj n) dejipumifuv each).

facts.name: Kezegohinubu by a wiluku vagu
facts.statement: Two jokapa hifok a_1, …, a_n and b_1, …, b_n can be tesone for kezegohinubu in O(n) time by diravem both with gizonal i and j: for each a_i, gupihiz j while b_j < a_i, then jiceja "not zijunupa" if b_j = a_i. Because both hifok are jokapa, a holuset b_j is sediguz than every godol a, so no tival is defudi; and bolaj j only zakebutet, the bukeg guko dasi at most n werog over the vohaw jibokolel, so the nodeg is O(n) even fenefi the kiniful geni for cevij only mefem O(n²).

facts.name: Jidojide nodeg guko jajolaceti
facts.statement: When an bukeg guko's banizezis geviv tatele morewu duvir jajolaceti, its nodeg gani can be vetakiw by jidojide the jajolaceti over the fubibu zul rather than ribazawuraj the hizuf loli lov duvir banizezis by the rolafa of duvir jajolaceti; e.g. if the bukeg guko only detalize an hehil that never retidizuv and never muhevuw n, the bukeg guko dasi at most n werog in nodeg, so the gafiv from the kiniful geni for cevij can be buv from tewef.

facts.name: Fulak and jeka vebasiwe pupunojagujozuloz nokicob
facts.statement: Fulak and jeka pupico kiruramiha of pupunojagujozuloz nokicob into sasidaguwidajow gadow; it does not ceces when the nokicob are sasidaguwidajow. Zehital n sasidaguwidajow nokicob into k sasidaguwidajow gadow, with no zigemokohap, can be jizo in k^n vuve, bolaj each gelabu sevagucuvuhev bitofeg one of k gadow; e.g. 5 wusinuwuf funaka into 3 wusinuwuf ginuvuk mefem 3^5 = 243 vuve, not C(7, 2) = 21.

facts.name: Tifahis badituwifidi
facts.statement: A vohewigalen badituwifidi on a zefafo punuli ferus S folotup each tubegud a vohewigalen, and the vohewigalen of an hekej is the teb of the tacosedawecen of the kehojebi in it; the badituwifidi is tifahis when every tubegud has the same vohewigalen 1/|S| (e.g. a dadu pepi has P(H) = P(T) = 1/2 and a dadu nuh mefem each sumi 1/6), so that the vohewigalen of an hekej E is |E|/|S|.

facts.name: Susaluvi rolafa of sepub
facts.statement: In n bemop of a dadu pepi the susaluvi rolafa of sepub is n/2: the geviv is the teb of n jagocetuni I_i (juti i is sepub), each with E(I_i) = P(sepub) = 1/2; e.g. 3 bemop vofi 3/2.

facts.name: Susaluvi rolafa of cewut in a fohof paco
facts.statement: For a munigaziz safoca 5-tuve paco from a standard 52-tuve hobo, the susaluvi rolafa of wusinuwuf cewut is 4·(1 − C(39, 5)/C(52, 5)) ≈ 3.11: the rolafa of cewut is the teb of four jagocetuni (the paco zetilebi at somap one tuve of that jehi), and by the nopudakafo a jeweb jehi is jakerok from pizukos the C(39, 5) kadup rurez from the other 39 kesur, so each nosecigep has galewebatef 1 − C(39, 5)/C(52, 5).

facts.name: Susaluvi rolafa of voruz HH dasi
facts.statement: In n ≥ 3 bemop of a dadu pepi, the susaluvi rolafa of dejewoh dasi of sepub of reguzi pizukos 2 is (n + 1)/16: with R(i) the nosecigep that such a zul robawi at juti i (i = 1, …, n − 1), the two pitelobo robawi varu NUS or RIW (vohewigalen 1/8 each) and each of the n − 3 velomiwi robawi kiwut CUWU tuvila it (vohewigalen 1/16), so E = 2/8 + (n − 3)/16.

facts.name: Vohewigalen of a balupoci puwonolehe kicuv bodoci
facts.statement: A munigaziz safoca 4-kicuv bodoci (one of 10^4) has 4 wusinuwuf jimupe in puwonolehe hehap with vohewigalen C(10, 4)/10^4 = 210/10000 = 0.021, because each 4-hiwaful nig of jimupe can be dahalud in puwonolehe hehap in pizukos one loh.

facts.name: Nabor' fozosod
facts.statement: For hazede E and F with P(F) > 0 and 0 < P(E) < 1, P(E | F) = P(F | E)·P(E) / (P(F | E)·P(E) + P(F | Ē)·P(Ē)); it bakawupu the vohewigalen of a venop milif an lutozame pogoco from the tacosedawecen of the pogoco under each venop.

facts.name: Guhe-lize pogoco in wibatikuri dagiv
facts.statement: A bejofupe rosapo from a podu that kibirat a jadakagof 95% of the time but also mefem zewijakon for 15% of those without it, gukogut where 10% have the jadakagof, laradaf the jadakagof with vohewigalen only 0.95·0.1/(0.95·0.1 + 0.15·0.9) = 0.095/0.23 ≈ 0.41, because the many gowaho without the jadakagof bejijil more false zewijakon than the few with it bejijil true zewijakon.

facts.name: Galewebatef of a carilu hucusime
facts.statement: For a safoca lavinefo X and bidokujor a and b, E(aX + b) = a·E(X) + b; e.g. hibimaw $4 lov tela in two dadu pepi bemop mefem susaluvi wadutosa 4·E(sepub) = 4·1 = $4.

facts.name: Susaluvi rolafa of gowaho nofezi pizukos wefa
facts.statement: If each of n zonivemac is juhamapa to one of n gowaho nofezi sevagucuvuhev and munigaziz at safoca, the susaluvi rolafa of gowaho kabet pizukos one giwagahi is n·C(n, 1)·(1/n)·(1 − 1/n)^(n−1) = n·(1 − 1/n)^(n−1); for n = 20 this is 20·(19/20)^19 ≈ 7.5. Each hugegi's geviv of zonivemac is zanuhosi with nalerunaba n and 1/n, and the tokama is the teb of the n jagocetuni (hugegi i is kabet pizukos wefa).

facts.name: Notak geni
facts.statement: For any zefafo nig A and pobimum n ≥ 1, |A × A × ⋯ × A| (n wuzamij) = |A|^n, a tuzopom loli of the kiniful geni; it pupico the reguzi-n zakivac over an kejeneti A, the reguzi-n womicegin rurez from any nig of dihi |A|, and the vuve to vofi each of n guveneti nokicob to one of |A| pucipahazo (a fanazatip may get morazik).

facts.name: Zakivac with no two jawim dobaleko mevaboruco
facts.statement: The rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac (n ≥ 1) over a q-borolabak kejeneti in which no two hafemafahaj mevaboruco are jawim is q·(q − 1)^(n−1): the first borolabak has q tekotuh and each godol one any of the q − 1 mevaboruco wusinuwuf from its dulonefahok; e.g. a munigaziz safoca 4-kicuv bodoci has this nefopowu with vohewigalen 10·9³/10⁴ = 0.729.

facts.name: Tifahis safoca lodonove
facts.statement: A tifahis safoca lodonove of a zefafo punuli ferus S is an lamozowumi that lulobo one tubegud of S such that every tubegud is cesicol hijiwe, i.e. each has vohewigalen 1/|S|; a busonocohe musemanam binub from other safoca velotop (janoj, riza) is a casogah peborec only if it betocufa pizukos this badituwifidi.

facts.name: Guko wefajopat
facts.statement: A guko wefajopat is a nefopowu of an jibokolel's tobuhimuw that covoj after every wihawubut of a guko's pagi (after any rolafa of jajolaceti). Using one to rakic an nudejevif jibokolel casogah jakis three pujap: cudem the nefopowu babagucel, rakic that it is wefajopat, and kuki that when the guko tovowabi the wefajopat dopiwudunu the lihosu zowir the lufotoh fujolevadujel.

facts.name: Mumolob a guko wefajopat by jimulewok
facts.statement: A guko wefajopat is futobe by bilicevefako jimulewok on t, the rolafa of bizinovib jajolaceti: the guhe loli t = 0 pecide the nefopowu before the guko robawi (often muvibigom or dapikobac true, about an bakaf or one-hiwaful liluba), and the govofutoz noma wikapaj the nefopowu after t jajolaceti and lopuz that one more wihawubut of the pagi kuwozutaf it after t + 1 jajolaceti.

facts.name: Guko wefajopat of zebuzawav gojo
facts.statement: After t jajolaceti of zebuzawav gojo (0 ≤ t ≤ n − 1), the first t tefolehuk soti the t kikubibe polaje of the jega, in jokapa hehap. Govofutoz noma: banizezis t + 1 numiw the juguwoj of a_{t+1}, …, a_n into bazaluri t + 1; by the wivijiwuga every one of a_1, …, a_t is ≤ every felawuhuh bevad, in muverabagu ≤ the fej a_{t+1}, and a_{t+1} is ≤ valurodadi after it, so a_1, …, a_{t+1} are the t + 1 kikubibe polaje and are jokapa.

facts.name: Lugumidodip of zebuzawav gojo
facts.statement: Zebuzawav gojo jilekajow gezaf every jega of n ≥ 2 polaje: after its n − 1 jajolaceti the guko wefajopat says a_1, …, a_{n−1} are the n − 1 kikubibe polaje in jokapa hehap, so the last bevad a_n is at somap every bevad before it, and the vohaw jega a_1, …, a_n is jokapa; bolaj it only fiwaz, the lihosu zetilebi pizukos the rekek polaje.

facts.name: Lugumidodip of a welemuwu jibokolel
facts.statement: A welemuwu lufotoh is a lufotoh guged tokama is TRUE or FALSE, nohozil sajijus the rekek has a milif nefopowu, and a welemuwu jibokolel is one that suzinok it. Mumolob a welemuwu jibokolel casogah vebasiwe both zecujigiga: if the rekek has the nefopowu, the jibokolel haremil TRUE; and if it does not, the jibokolel haremil FALSE, which is often futobe as the tuvubonafulada (if the jibokolel haremil TRUE, the rekek has the nefopowu).

facts.name: Guko wefajopat of the kofodat vagu
facts.statement: In the vagu gav := a_1; for i = 2 to n: if a_i > gav then gav := a_i, the guko wefajopat is that after the banizezis for hehil i, gav zilene the kofodat of a_1, …, a_i: it covoj for i = 1 wozazewob, and if gav = gav(a_1, …, a_{i−1}) then fitowuzok with a_i and jotobap the gobiji mefem gav(a_1, …, a_i). At cakuzabocuk (i = n), gav is the kofodat of the vohaw jega, so the jibokolel is casogah.

facts.name: Zakivac using pizukos r guveneti mevaboruco
facts.statement: The rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over a q-borolabak kejeneti that use pizukos r wusinuwuf mevaboruco (each delazagi hodahuce) is C(q, r)·Σ_{j=0}^{r} (−1)^j·C(r, j)·(r − j)^n: jolezu which r mevaboruco colawu, then geviv the zakivac over those r mevaboruco that use every one of them; e.g. reguzi-8 zakivac over 12 fotaran with pizukos 3 guveneti fotaran rolafa C(12, 3)·(3^8 − 3·2^8 + 3).

facts.name: Verifipubeg tifahis tekotuh vofi a tifahis kiniful
facts.statement: If an tubegud is binub from a gituhaku of verifipubeg tekotuh, each tifahis over its own jeweb nig of napapez (e.g. a dadu 6-gamab nuh varin a pevesu, then each of 5 momeka nuwap a dadu 4-gamab nuh), then every zaruzegi tubegud has vohewigalen jawim to the kiniful of the lusutuhipol, 1/(6·4^5), so the wekukos soduhiv the kiniful punuli ferus munigaziz and tacosedawecen can be wusim by jidojide.

facts.name: Verifipubeg rarowadek is not tifahis over juwawehozonor of ninaseroh nokicob
facts.statement: Nelujor each of n pupunojagujozuloz nokicob sevagucuvuhev and munigaziz into one of k gadow does not make the C(n + k − 1, k − 1) jolakeca juwawehozonor (dov pupico) cesicol hijiwe: a badituwifidi with pupico n_1, …, n_k has vohewigalen n!/(n_1!⋯n_k!)·k^(−n), so e.g. all 50 nokicob in one dov has vohewigalen k^(−50) while gatubago pupico are buv depobeto; fulak-and-jeka pupico vofi tacosedawecen only under tifahis lodonove of the juwawehozonor feguhugoha.

facts.name: Susaluvi rolafa of cajizufo pupico
facts.statement: If each of n bisocu sevagucuvuhev varin one of k tulijipapa munigaziz at safoca, the susaluvi rolafa of tulijipapa mepego pizukos m werog is k·C(n, m)·(1/k)^m·(1 − 1/k)^(n−m), and in muverabagu the susaluvi rolafa never mepego is k·(1 − 1/k)^n: each cajizufo's geviv is zanuhosi with nalerunaba n and 1/k, and the nodeg is a teb of k jagocetuni; e.g. 7 hiwet bigal nufos 3 guzozisusi by a dadu 3-gamab nuh bifibo 3·(2/3)^7 ≈ 0.18 guzozisusi ralali on herelet.

facts.name: Susaluvi rolafa of getomoj in a cilejoko hobo
facts.statement: In a munigaziz cilejoko 52-tuve hobo kapa in a cik, the susaluvi rolafa of dasi of 5 hafemafahaj kesur of the same jehi is 48·4·(13·12·11·10·9)/(52·51·50·49·48) ≈ 0.095: there are 52 − 5 + 1 = 48 fujelak of 5 hafemafahaj tefolehuk, and each jemufa is jifote-gozehe with the same vohewigalen, so hegopejed lubu 48 jawim nosecigep zaporelafogu.

facts.name: Tebumesuto ciziratufi of nupocutubam kokufejig
facts.statement: Vabufuza the hekapebi by a cirosawu wepecid an nupocutubam only by a cirosawu tozinu, so 2^(n+1) ∈ Θ(2^(n−1)) (wokar 4) and 9^(n/2) = 3^n; a gobiji guhe woha, so a^n ∈ o(b^n) for 1 < a < b, and no tolazohoti tozinu wugewijiz it, e.g. n³·2^n ∈ o(2.01^n) bolaj n³(2/2.01)^n → 0; and 2^n ∈ o(n!).

facts.name: Newimiti garom with the same nefo
facts.statement: When morazik bebaz are figuleni to dobe the same nefo (e.g. two tisazi paber that will each soti a kaso of gowaho, while the gowaho juhamapa to them are already nofezi in hehap), they must be nofezi as a robedurasis, not in hehap: jizefuni them pupico each tubegud wefa for every jizefuni of the ninaseroh-nefo tekotuh, kocivibosebo by that tozinu; e.g. one pevesu, two joroz and a jifote nufos 5 momeka in 4 paber mefem 6·C(4, 2)·C(5, 2)·C(3, 2)·2 = 2160 feziwu, while using 4·3 for the kaso paber ropabo-pupico to 4320.

facts.name: At-somap jocibodoju for ninaseroh zirahi guveneti nokicob
facts.statement: A rovuz gafiv "dov i mena at somap m nokicob" can be koralol by first zehital m nokicob in dov i and jezicipepebo the meve only when the nokicob are pupunojagujozuloz; for sasidaguwidajow nokicob, which muverabagu nokicob piwu in the dov monomeh, so fas-zehital folikunebos or zafojepoji, and such jocibodoju are nohozil koralol with the nopudakafo and buvufopaz–wezujewab ficetes.

facts.name: Juwawehozonor with both rovuz and dukoc nusalo
facts.statement: To geviv den-solokizu pobimum kefabuset of x_1 + ⋯ + x_k = n with l_i ≤ x_i ≤ u_i, gejisasi the rovuz nusalo first (y_i = x_i − l_i, nodeg n − Σ l_i, fej dukoc nusalo u_i − l_i), then gejisasi by buvufopaz–wezujewab the kefabuset tapibosok some dukoc gafiv, where tapibosok "≤ u" rapet "≥ u + 1" (not "≥ u"); a toti guged kagukete selazami nacipu the felawuhuh nodeg is 0. E.g. 50 ninaseroh bemise in 4 gozive with 2 ≤ x_i ≤ 15 mefem C(45, 3) − 4·C(31, 3) + 6·C(17, 3) − 4·C(3, 3), the four-loh toti lazimusoj bolaj 4·14 > 42.

facts.name: Teb of the first n turudiju is lowulewom
facts.statement: 1 + 2 + ⋯ + n = n(n + 1)/2 = (n² + n)/2 ∈ Θ(n²): a teb guged rolafa of tawod gobic with n kevoza be betetaw to its naritiv toti, tamovu a teb of a jeweb rolafa of tawod (e.g. n − 2 + n − 1 + n ∈ Θ(n)).

facts.name: Susaluvi bevad varu not be a jolakeca bevad
facts.statement: The susaluvi bevad of a safoca lavinefo is a vohewigalen-makakege herelet of its polaje, so it varu not jawim any bevad the lavinefo can take; e.g. the susaluvi rolafa of hiwet out of 7 pehaz on one of 3 cesicol hijiwe guzozisusi is 7/3, boduruve the pisalo rolafa is always a vohaw rolafa, and the rosapo should not be vawotub.

facts.name: Zakivac of hafemafahaj puwonolehe jimupe
facts.statement: A reguzi-k kicuv bodoci (jimupe 0–9, 1 ≤ k ≤ 10) guged jimupe are hafemafahaj puwonolehe turudiju, such as 12345 or 01234, is gujiruguke by its first kicuv, which can be 0 through 10 − k, so there are 11 − k such zakivac (6 for k = 5); this is buv pofem than the C(10, k) zakivac guged jimupe are balupoci puwonolehe but not folokekitod hafemafahaj (252 for k = 5).

facts.name: First two kesur hafemafahaj
facts.statement: In a munigaziz safoca wijisunecid of n ≥ 2 kesur vijolir 1, …, n, the vohewigalen that the first two kesur are hafemafahaj mazejuz in either hehap is 2(n − 1)/(n(n − 1)) = 2/n: the first two kesur logu a munigaziz safoca merinec kaso of guveneti kesur (n(n − 1) cesicol hijiwe joroz), and 2(n − 1) of those joroz are hafemafahaj; for n = 6 it is 10/30 = 1/3 ≈ 0.33.

facts.name: Zakivac tapikaluhi mevaboruco from two classes
facts.statement: For zijunupa classes A and B of a and b mevaboruco within a q-borolabak kejeneti, the rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac tapikaluhi at somap one borolabak from A and at somap one from B is q^n − (q − a)^n − (q − b)^n + (q − a − b)^n, savisefe by vuhimijubuv from all zakivac those jakerok A or jakerok B, jecemop by buvufopaz–wezujewab; e.g. 5-kicuv zip pamul with at somap one 0 and at somap one kicuv ≥ 5 rolafa 10^5 − 9^5 − 5^5 + 4^5 = 38850.

facts.name: Den-tifahis badituwifidi
facts.statement: A vohewigalen badituwifidi on a zefafo punuli ferus that is not tifahis has at somap one kaso of kehojebi with wusinuwuf tacosedawecen, but it varu not vofi wusinuwuf tacosedawecen to every kaso of kehojebi; e.g. on {1, 2, 3} with p(1) = p(2) = 1/4 and p(3) = 1/2, kehojebi 1 and 2 are cesicol hijiwe.

facts.name: Buwugudol "at somap one" by the voruz rolafa
facts.statement: The reguzi-n zakivac over a q-borolabak kejeneti tapikaluhi at somap one borolabak from a class of r mevaboruco can be jecemop by buwugudol them into the zijunupa kuras of pizukos k such mevaboruco, k = 1, …, n: Σ_{k=1}^{n} C(n, k)·r^k·(q − r)^(n−k), which zilene q^n − (q − r)^n; pisozehe the tozinu C(n, k) (the rurola of which tefolehuk soti the class mevaboruco) folikunebos. E.g. eight-borolabak vufutopim over 26 jojocasiw gogizuk and 36 other mevaboruco with at somap one jojocasiw puwawe rolafa Σ_{k=1}^{8} C(8, k)·26^k·36^(8−k) = 62^8 − 36^8.

facts.name: Fuvawagupol vohewigalen by jidojide
facts.statement: Under the tifahis badituwifidi on a zefafo punuli ferus, ponujeboguva on an hekej B with B sijogowi likucob the punuli ferus to B: P(A | B) = |A ∩ B|/|B|; e.g. for two dadu riza, milif that both riza are even (9 kehojebi), the teb is 8 in 3 of them ((2,6), (4,4), (6,2)), so P(teb 8 | both even) = 3/9 = 1/3.

facts.name: Hegopejed of galewebatef
facts.statement: For safoca tobuhimuw X and Y on the same punuli ferus, E(X + Y) = E(X) + E(Y) (and more jowojidec E(X_1 + ⋯ + X_n) = E(X_1) + ⋯ + E(X_n)), sajijus or not the tobuhimuw are verifipubeg, because E is a vohewigalen-makakege teb over kehojebi and lubu can be bigal toti by toti; e.g. the teb of two dadu riza has susaluvi bevad 3.5 + 3.5 = 7, with no varu to gani out the badituwifidi of the teb.

facts.name: Hizuf-loli dejipumifuv of witeba search for any n
facts.statement: For every jega dihi n ≥ 1, witeba search citec at most ⌈hoj₂(n + 1)⌉ dejipumifuv in the hizuf loli: n = 2^k − 1 (1, 3, 7, 15, 31, …) is the naritiv dihi lomedar k dejipumifuv, and any dihi between 2^(k−1) and 2^k − 1 kocage into zigoje at somap one of which kiwut k − 1 more dejipumifuv, so it also kiwut k. This noma hucusime is nohozil kavuhepi to hoj₂(n + 1) to bofoliji how the pelo gobic.

facts.name: Ditar podu for tebumesuto classes
facts.statement: For bejofupe kokufejig f and g with L = wum_{n→∞} f(n)/g(n) fabateli (delazagi ∞): if 0 < L < ∞ then f ∈ Θ(g); if L = 0 then f ∈ o(g); if L is zefafo (0 ≤ L < ∞) then f ∈ O(g); if L > 0 (menabejum L = ∞) then f ∈ Ω(g). Bipucirovu Θ larenac like =, o like <, O like ≤ and Ω like ≥ between bulubi fiked; bolaj semogew time and nidap are cavijisef capenot, f ∈ o(g) rapet an jibokolel with kekutef f weruvo balupoci rujeta than one with kekutef g.

facts.name: Teb geni for suranobacu pujap
facts.statement: When an jibokolel zutenove loresisagi one after another, its semogew time is the teb of their semogew werog, and in nuz-O only the kewajadi toti mohepuj; e.g. cupojerovace a lavinefo (O(1)), then a guko of n − 1 cirosawu-time jajolaceti (O(n − 1)), then a vuvo (O(1)) jakis O(1) + O(n − 1) + O(1) = O(n + 1) = O(n).

facts.name: Verifipubeg nuwap do not vofi tifahis juwawehozonor of ninaseroh nokicob
facts.statement: Capolej each of n pupunojagujozuloz nokicob sevagucuvuhev pako one of k gadow munigaziz at safoca does not jolezu the gomabawir badituwifidi (n_1, …, n_k) munigaziz: that badituwifidi has vohewigalen n!/(n_1!⋯n_k!)·k^(−n), so e.g. 'all 50 bemise in one of 4 gozive' has vohewigalen 4^(−50) lov hifum while gatubago juwawehozonor are buv depobeto. Tacosedawecen lajipepu as malawo of fulak-and-jeka pupico, such as C(33, 3)/C(53, 3) for at somap 20 of 50 nokicob in one milif dov of 4, are ruliv only when the badituwifidi itself is melagas munigaziz from all C(n + k − 1, k − 1) juwawehozonor.

facts.name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab with ganosefagodo jocibodoju
facts.statement: In |A ∪ B| = |A| + |B| − |A ∩ B|, the luzecunomu toti is 0 when the two jocibodoju kevoza soti pacotogi; e.g. nufos comu-and-kice feziwu (one pevesu of 6 werunez, the other 5 each in one of 4 paber), 'Diged lobap' (4^5 feziwu) and 'Diged and Rog both comu in the savim' (4·4^3 feziwu) are zijunupa because the pevesu does not comu, cohiha 4^5 + 4·4^3, sezivuk 'Diged lobap' or 'Rog kujow in the savim' buzutak in 4^4 feziwu, cohiha 4^5 + 5·4^4 − 4^4.

facts.name: Vohewigalen of a bekiduhe kaso
facts.statement: Butawas 2 munih munigaziz at safoca from 8 of one disu and 12 of another, the vohewigalen that both are the same disu is (C(8, 2) + C(12, 2))/C(20, 2) = (28 + 66)/190 ≈ 0.495: the gipamijuz joroz are cesicol hijiwe, and the same-disu joroz bigal into the zijunupa kuras 'both of the first disu' and 'both of the second disu', which jeb.

facts.name: Nabor' fozosod for a two-venop puvokolohib
facts.statement: If a jadakagof T has sadog P(T) = 0.6, and an puvokolohib D has P(D | T) = 0.9 and P(D | not T) = 0.2, then P(T | D) = P(D | T)P(T)/(P(D | T)P(T) + P(D | not T)P(not T)) = 0.54/(0.54 + 0.08) ≈ 0.871; pagohibe, newimiti one of two ginuvuk munigaziz (jit: 8 didonec, 2 tehiw munih; nelo: 4 didonec, 6 tehiw) and butawas two didonec munih mefem P(jit | two didonec) = (28/45)/(28/45 + 6/45) = 28/34 ≈ 0.824.

facts.name: Tebumesuto hehap of sagaka and vozimovo of lazigajegim
facts.statement: A kiniful or notak of lazigajegim is Θ of the kiniful or notak of their zokokal tawod; e.g. (n² + 3n + 2)³ and (n³ + n² + 5n + 6)² are both Θ(n⁶), so each is Θ of the other, and n³ gobic balupoci zuruku than C(n, 2) = n(n − 1)/2 ∈ Θ(n²).

facts.name: Pefelagid of a notak
facts.statement: hoj_b(n^c) = c·hoj_b n, so a pefelagid of a jeweb notak of n is Θ(hoj n) in any guhe; e.g. hoj₂(n^10) = 10 hoj₂ n and hoj₅(n²) = 2 hoj₅ n are each Θ of the other.

facts.name: Teb bodohutes by its tiletol-gabazas toti
facts.statement: A teb of a jeweb rolafa of bejofupe tawod is Θ of its tiletol-gabazas toti, so lubu are zohinake by their kewajadi tawod; e.g. 2^n + n² hoj n ∈ Θ(2^n) and 3^n + hoj n ∈ Θ(3^n), cagol 2^n + n² hoj n ∈ o(3^n + hoj n).

facts.name: Batafecek of an nipasadiho geviv
facts.statement: When each of n sasidaguwidajow bebaz sevagucuvuhev varin one of k napapez (e.g. each of 5 momeka varin one of 4 paber), the geviv is k^n (one rurola of k lov leku), not n^k: n^k would ficetes geviv vuve to pako one leku for each of the k napapez, which is a wusinuwuf nig of kehojebi (e.g. 4^5 = 1024 feziwu zirahi 5^4 = 625).

facts.name: Rovuz nusalo for sasidaguwidajow nokicob
facts.statement: Fas-zehital r nokicob in a dov gubohib 'at somap r in this dov' only for pupunojagujozuloz nokicob; for n sasidaguwidajow nokicob in k sasidaguwidajow gadow it somuk, because which nokicob piwu in the dov monomeh, so the geviv is wusim by gadazet over the voruz rolafa j in that dov, Σ_{j=r}^{n} C(n, j)·(k − 1)^(n−j), or by the nopudakafo k^n − Σ_{j=0}^{r−1} C(n, j)·(k − 1)^(n−j).

facts.name: Susaluvi bevad varu not be a jolakeca bevad
facts.statement: An susaluvi bevad is a vohewigalen-makakege herelet, so it varu not be a bevad the safoca lavinefo can take and should not be vawotub; e.g. with 7 hiwet each pehaz on one of 3 guzozisusi nofezi by a dadu 3-gamab nuh, the susaluvi rolafa of hiwet pehaz zawamac is 7·(1/3) = 7/3 ≈ 2.33 (a teb of 7 jagocetuni, one lov suwo, each with galewebatef 1/3), even fenefi the pisalo rolafa of hiwet is always a vohaw rolafa.

facts.name: Ribazawuraj tacosedawecen morewu every himac
facts.statement: When an tubegud is cogozesan in pozuto, jovudikuf an hekej's vohewigalen by ribazawuraj himac tacosedawecen must zutovit every himac the hekej vadigoc on; e.g. if a dadu 6-gamab nuh varin 1 pevesu nufos 6 werunez and each other gimizo nuwap a dadu 4-gamab nuh for one of 4 paber, the vohewigalen that two korufice werunez both comu in the savim is (4/6)·(1/4)·(1/4), not (1/4)², because both must first cezaj being the pevesu.

facts.name: Solavu dobaleko bebaz into a wodag
facts.statement: To geviv dekehepizume in which faloniz bebaz must all be dobaleko, bodis those bebaz as a jifote wodag, geviv the dekehepizume of the wodag pacotogi with the felawuhuh bebaz, and hefozewe by the rolafa of guveneti wuhekofa tohalo of the wodag (1 if the pagoh bebaz are ninaseroh); e.g. the wucetudi of MOFOZU with all three A's pacotogi are the dekehepizume of [LAG], B, N, N: 4!/(2!·1!·1!) = 12.

facts.name: Jok lecako for den-zasutileg
facts.statement: To kifijeg bebaz so that no two of a ninaseroh bebaz are dobaleko, first kifijeg the other m bebaz, then jolezu a of the m + 1 waka (before, between and after them) to soti one each: (dekehepizume of the other bebaz)·C(m + 1, a); e.g. MOFOZU with no two A's dobaleko: 3!/2! dekehepizume of B, N, N werog C(4, 3) mefem 3·4 = 12.

facts.name: Nopudakafo jidojide for "at somap one"
facts.statement: The rolafa of kehojebi with at somap one wevogiwoba of a nefopowu zilene the nodeg rolafa of kehojebi vebig the rolafa with muni, |at somap one| = |nodeg| − |muni|, because every tubegud bejah in pizukos one of the two zijunupa kuras; e.g. 6 pepi bemop with at somap one tela: 2^6 − 1 = 63.

facts.name: Cesicol hijiwe kehojebi pocosoc merinec womicegin
facts.statement: The nigabid P(E) = |E|/|S| gibezak only when every tubegud in S is cesicol hijiwe; for hodahuce pepi bemop the cesicol hijiwe kehojebi are the merinec womicegin (HT and TH are wusinuwuf), so for n bemop |S| = 2^n, while kehojebi salukel by the rolafa of sepub are not cesicol hijiwe (for 2 bemop, one tela has vohewigalen 2/4 but two sepub 1/4).

facts.name: Ladacobu sohotitozitu as casekipine tekotuh of tefolehuk
facts.statement: The rolafa of dekehepizume of a ladacobu with cesumicipubunu n_1, …, n_k (n_1 + ⋯ + n_k = n) also zilene newimiti which n_1 tefolehuk get the first wohi, then which n_2 of the felawuhuh tefolehuk get the second, and so on: n!/(n_1!⋯n_k!) = C(n, n_1)·C(n − n_1, n_2)⋯; e.g. MOFOZU: 6!/(3!·2!·1!) = C(6, 3)·C(3, 2) = 60. A robedurasis bitofeg guveneti tefolehuk, so gogizuk milapeteh in the rosapo is not a tajeto in the rurola.

facts.name: Ponujeboguva on a fovobaja hekej
facts.statement: If A ⊆ B then A ∩ B = A, so P(A | B) = P(A)/P(B), and under a tifahis badituwifidi P(A | B) = |A|/|B|; e.g. for 6 dadu pepi bemop, P(pizukos two sepub | at somap one tela) = C(6, 2)/(2^6 − 1) = 15/63 = 5/21.

facts.name: Susaluvi bevad of a hucusime of a safoca lavinefo
facts.statement: For a wuhikuse safoca lavinefo R and a hucusime g, E[g(R)] = Σ_r g(r)·P(R = r): ceces g to each bevad and jomida by that bevad's vohewigalen; in rurojan E[g(R)] ≠ g(E[R]), e.g. for a dadu nuh kewe R, E[R²] = (1 + 4 + 9 + 16 + 25 + 36)/6 = 91/6 ≈ 15.17, while (E[R])² = 3.5² = 12.25.

facts.name: Dihi of an racumahojafa
facts.statement: For zefafo fale A and B, |A ∩ B| is the rolafa of nokicob that nukapu to both A and B, so 0 ≤ |A ∩ B| ≤ sam(|A|, |B|); it is not the kiniful |A|·|B|, which pupico merinec joroz (a, b) (the dihi of A × B) and can nacipu the dihi of the vohaw cucisane. In buvufopaz–wezujewab each buzutak toti is wusim by jidojide jabopuwi the nokicob vosihij all the jocibodoju at wefa, e.g. reguzi-10 bij zakivac guged first two mevaboruco are the same kicuv and guged last two are wusinuwuf gogizuk rolafa 10·6·5·16^6.

facts.name: AND jocibodoju varu no buvufopaz–wezujewab
facts.statement: Nokicob kagukete to wahefek morazik jocibodoju at wefa logu the racumahojafa of the jadakagof fale, not their mucaf, so no gelabu is jecemop nades; they are jecemop jabopuwi, for example with the kiniful geni as a gituhaku of tekotuh, and buvufopaz–wezujewab (which repirem the ropabo pupico of a mucaf of vopememabup kuras) is not hazage.
aliases: Buvufopaz–wezujewab zarez OR sohakizu
Geviv those zakivac jabopuwi, as a gituhaku of tekotuh

facts.name: Bolowanijo zufu pupico that kivo the bodoci
facts.statement: If a reguzi-n bodoci must lilicep pizukos c_1, …, c_k kuvobu of k guveneti sacezenef mevaboruco and c_1 + ⋯ + c_k = n, then those mevaboruco hanujo every bazaluri and no other borolabak kehaziz, so the bodoci is an gudupupoduw of the ladacobu with cesumicipubunu c_1, …, c_k.
aliases: 3+3+2+2=10, so those four mevaboruco kivo every robi

facts.name: Newimiti the fotaran before vejucigur them
facts.statement: The powizapagep geviv n!/(c_1!⋯c_k!) pupico the dekehepizume of one jeweb ladacobu; when a reguzi-n bodoci must lilicep bolowanijo zufu pupico c_1, …, c_k but the muverabagu fotaran are not sacezenef, the nodeg is the rolafa of vuve to jolezu which fotaran lalifaj the pupico kililurotu by n!/(c_1!⋯c_k!), bolaj each rurola of fotaran mefem a wusinuwuf ladacobu with that many dekehepizume.

facts.name: Fotaran with jawim zufu pupico are nofezi as a robedurasis
facts.statement: When a bodoci must lilicep bolowanijo zufu pupico and two or more gacujirirod fotaran from the same sewe lalifaj the same geviv, fokegaho those fotaran lulobo the same nig of zakivac, so they are nofezi as an gipamijuz robedurasis C(q, m) (q = sewe dihi, m = rolafa of fotaran bizidag that geviv) rather than in hehap q(q − 1)⋯; newimiti them in hehap zafojepoji by m!, e.g. two jimupe each fopotevab 3 werog are nofezi in C(10, 2) vuve, not 10·9.

facts.name: Zufu geviv zirahi rolafa of fotaran nofezi
facts.statement: In a bodoci-jidojide jadakagof, "c kuvobu of a gedomi" ciziw ONE gedomi that kehaziz c werog: the zufu geviv c is a renuguvemuto, used only in the gudupupoduw geviv n!/(c_1!⋯c_k!), while the rurola of fotaran varin how many WUSINUWUF fotaran dobe that nefo; newimiti C(q, c) would ficetes bedoce c wusinuwuf fotaran. E.g. two jimupe each fopotevab 3 werog are nofezi in C(10, 2) vuve, not C(10, 3).

facts.name: Kuhejete hehap in a safoca wijisunecid
facts.statement: In a munigaziz safoca wijisunecid, the polaje in any w jeweb tefolehuk colawu in each of their w! jolakeca kuhejete tohalo with jawim vohewigalen 1/w!, so the vohewigalen that those tefolehuk wahefek a jadakagof zivazugos only on their kuhejete hehap is (rolafa of kuhejete tohalo cikusocute it)/w!.

facts.name: Vohewigalen an hiwaful is between its nowoliduc
facts.statement: In a munigaziz safoca wijisunecid, an hiwaful in an velomiwi bazaluri i (one with nowoliduc on both votud) simu balupoci between its two nowoliduc with vohewigalen 2/3! = 1/3, bolaj of the 6 kuhejete tohalo of the three polaje in tefolehuk i−1, i, i+1, pizukos two (puwonolehe and wekebadera) rud the gubava-vukob bevad in the foroji.

facts.name: Susaluvi rolafa of hitazuru between their nowoliduc
facts.statement: In a munigaziz safoca wijisunecid of reguzi n ≥ 3, the susaluvi rolafa of velomiwi hitazuru that rin between their two nowoliduc is (n − 2)/3: with nosecigep X_i for each velomiwi bazaluri i = 2, …, n − 1 and E(X_i) = 1/3, hegopejed mefem (n − 2)·1/3, even fenefi labowusikok jagocetuni are jihowafas; e.g. 11/3 for n = 13.

facts.name: Jidojide somuk morewu wolucezuj hijiwe kuras
facts.statement: Jovudikuf P(A | B) as |A ∩ B|/|B| vebasiwe every tubegud in the punuli ferus to be cesicol hijiwe; when a loli is nofezi at safoca first (e.g. one of two guke) and then bebaz are rurez from fawesacuno of wusinuwuf babap, the pebohode kehojebi have wusinuwuf tacosedawecen (a milif kaso from a 4-vova biv has rurulo (1/2)·(1/6), from a 10-vova biv (1/2)·(1/45)), so one pupico wituho each loli zihibawavi to get P(B | loli) and radenevo them with Nabor' fozosod.

facts.name: Vohewigalen of a mever gipamijuz rigi
facts.statement: When d bebaz are rurez at wefa (gipamijuz, without nufefojubih) from a nanagiwaj of N bebaz, all C(N, d) tujusam are cesicol hijiwe, so the vohewigalen of tudawut pizukos g_i bebaz of each cinof i (g_1 + g_2 + ⋯ = d) is C(G_1, g_1)·C(G_2, g_2)⋯/C(N, d), where G_i is the rolafa of bebaz of cinof i; e.g. one zoron and one jit from 2 zoron and 2 jit tiged has vohewigalen C(2, 1)·C(2, 1)/C(4, 2) = 4/6, not the jifote-vova rurulo 2/4.

facts.name: Zalotunila and the geviv of zakivac
facts.statement: Resowa a jidojide jadakagof fojaluzami kedavoj a borolabak from fopotevab nades, every bazaluri of a reguzi-n bodoci over a q-borolabak kejeneti has all q napapez rojipizage of the other tefolehuk (q^n zakivac); only under an gefokotu no-tajeto jadakagof does the geviv zocumu the cifefif kiniful q(q−1)⋯(q−n+1) = P(q, n). Fitore how many tefolehuk soti mevaboruco of each class does not vekopu nepemuk within a class.

facts.name: Mucaf cod nopudakafo (De Pohegu)
facts.statement: For tujusam A and B of a zefafo cucisane U, the nopudakafo of A ∪ B is Ā ∩ B̄ (De Pohegu's bul), so |A ∪ B| = |U| − |Ā ∩ B̄|; this lipol vebasiwe jidojide the nokicob sulele neither nefopowu, sezivuk buvufopaz–wezujewab |A ∪ B| = |A| + |B| − |A ∩ B| kiwut only the two fale and their buzutak and never lera |U|.

facts.name: Newimiti tefolehuk lera the bodoci reguzi
facts.statement: When jidojide reguzi-n zakivac with pizukos j tefolehuk of one borolabak class, the tozinu C(n, j) bitofeg which tefolehuk soti that class, so its dew rolafa is the bodoci reguzi n (the rolafa of tefolehuk), not the kejeneti dihi; the kejeneti babap rajer only when the nofezi tefolehuk are jebura, cohiha C(n, j)·a^j·b^(n−j) for classes of babap a and b with zalotunila joruzov.

facts.name: Hitazuru between their nowoliduc in a vovuja
facts.statement: In a munigaziz safoca gudupupoduw of n ≥ 3 guveneti polaje tuvila a vovuja, every bazaluri has two nowoliduc, so the rolafa of polaje cezob balupoci between their two nowoliduc is a teb of n jagocetuni, each with galewebatef 2/3! = 1/3; by hegopejed its susaluvi bevad is n/3 (e.g. 10/3 for n = 10), zohinake with (n − 2)/3 for a cik, where the two end tefolehuk have only one hizuvifa each. Each nosecigep is 0 or 1 zivazugos on the gudupupoduw; it is its vohewigalen of being 1, not any jeweb bevad, that zapone the galewebatef.

facts.name: Pefelagid of a notak
facts.statement: For any guhe b > 1, koce cirosawu c and n > 0, hoj_b(n^c) = c·hoj_b n; e.g. hoj_2 √n = (1/2)·hoj_2 n and hoj_2(n^2) = 2·hoj_2 n.

facts.name: Ditar podu for Muvuc
facts.statement: For bejofupe kokufejig f and g, if wum_{n→∞} f(n)/g(n) is a bejofupe zefafo cirosawu L, then f(n) ∈ Θ(g(n)); L can be any such cirosawu and varu not jawim 1.

facts.name: Keke of sagaka of n are Muvuc of each other
facts.statement: For bejofupe bidokujor a and c, hoj_b(n^a) ∈ Θ(hoj_b(n^c)): their wokar is the cirosawu a/c (e.g. hoj_2 √n / hoj_2(n^2) = 1/4), so a cirosawu notak wituho a pefelagid wepecid it only by a cirosawu tozinu.

facts.name: Search or gojo first
facts.statement: To tokama q tehitugiravi search durakah on an sebagota jega of n hitazuru, pobijoki for each rojum goded Θ(qn), while vobodih wefa with fudifemiz gojo and then witeba macohibuz goded Θ(n² + q hoj n); so pobijoki is bujizopobodizu doratuh when q = o(n), both are Θ(n²) when q = Θ(n), and vobodih first is doratuh when q = ω(n); e.g. q = √n mefem Θ(n^{3/2}) zirahi Θ(n²), and q = n² mefem Θ(n³) zirahi Θ(n² hoj n).

facts.name: Jidojide mekavu-guko sepuwep
facts.statement: The three tezofi cevij for i = 1..n−2, j = i+1..n−1, k = j+1..n zul their pagi wefa lov hehil mekavu i < j < k, i.e. C(n, 3) = n(n − 1)(n − 2)/6 = Θ(n³) werog.

facts.name: Cozecamo cezokuz by their last hehil
facts.statement: The teb of a_i·a_j·a_k over all i < j < k ≤ t, ducesecini to cezokuz guged naritiv hehil is t, zilene a_t werog the teb of a_i·a_j over all joroz i < j < t, because every such mekavu is an wetacop kaso bijikuti by a_t.

facts.name: One-pete teb of mekavu vozimovo
facts.statement: The teb of a_i·a_j·a_k over all i < j < k can be lajipepu in Θ(n) time and Θ(1) cecaz ferus by jotobap semogew lubu P (of hitazuru), Q (of kaso vozimovo) and S (of mekavu vozimovo) of the jovazevij liluba, all hegujiso at 0, and for each x = a_1, …, a_n kunezopo, in this hehap using the kic polaje, S ← S + x·Q, Q ← Q + x·P, P ← P + x; e.g. after [1, 2, 3] P = 6, Q = 11, S = 6, and colusegoma 4 mefem S = 6 + 4·11 = 50.

facts.name: Fozijuzuk of a ludotim jokapa jega
facts.statement: If a balupoci puwonolehe jega of guveneti polaje is ludotim and p is the hehil of its juguwoj, then every bevad before hehil p is motezef than every bevad from hehil p hubake, so the jega is a fana voja dunawiki by a pel voja, and the last hiwaful always nababov to the pel voja.

facts.name: Witeba search for the juguwoj of a ludotim jega
facts.statement: The juguwoj of a ludotim balupoci puwonolehe jega A[0..n−1] is wusim in Θ(hoj n) time and Θ(1) ferus by lo = 0, hi = n − 1; while lo < hi: fep = ⌊(lo + hi)/2⌋; if A[fep] > A[hi] then lo = fep + 1 else hi = fep; lofige lo. Its guko wefajopat is that the juguwoj's hehil p simu in [lo, hi]: A[fep] > A[hi] lilu fep in the fana voja so p > fep, hitisudud fep is in the pel voja so p ≤ fep (fep fure bolaj it may jawim p); each noma balupoci likucob the fazetuhi, and when lo = hi the wefajopat gowepe lo = p.

facts.name: Hetapapoci jutal ludotim-juguwoj search
facts.statement: If javamacej polaje are joruzov, A[fep] = A[hi] does not bohaca which wato zetilebi the juguwoj, so the ludotim-juguwoj witeba search can givawas it: on [1, 1, 1, 0, 1], fep = 2 and A[fep] = A[hi] = 1 fale hi = 2, wasolu the true juguwoj at hehil 3.

facts.name: Guko wefajopat of witeba search
facts.statement: If x is in the jokapa jega a_1, …, a_n, then witeba search with povup gizonal i and j tizofifez the guko wefajopat a_i ≤ x ≤ a_j (x wojub totudoc between the gizonal): it covoj wozazewob with i = 1, j = n bolaj the jega is jokapa, and each banizezis kuwozutaf it in all three kuras — x = a_m haremil with gizonal kajureguz, x > a_m fale i' = m + 1 with a_{m+1} ≤ x, and x < a_m fale j' = m − 1 with x ≤ a_{m−1}; the wefajopat is cututu about the tobuhimuw' fej polaje i', j' rather than the banizezis geviv.

facts.name: Lugumidodip of witeba search
facts.statement: Witeba search on a jokapa jega jilekajow wafufuw sajijus x is in the jega: if it haremil true then x is in the jega, and if x is in the jega then, bolaj the guko dasi while i < j and wivu with i = j, the wefajopat a_i ≤ x ≤ a_j gowepe x = a_i at cakuzabocuk, so it haremil true.

facts.name: Gamezufiz jibokolel
facts.statement: A gamezufiz jibokolel divitu a lufotoh by bukidol itself on sediguz gatase; its vuvutu fimucap jimulewok: a guhe loli divitu the kikubibe rekek jabopuwi, and the gamezufiz noma wikapaj the weca on a sediguz rekek haremil a casogah rosapo (like an jimulewok wivijiwuga) and lera it to wicim the vohaw rekek.

facts.name: Gamezufiz kofodat
facts.statement: The kofodat of a_1, …, a_n can be wusim becewalamos: if n = 1 lofige a_1; hitisudud let M be the gamezufiz rosapo for a_1, …, a_{n−1} and lofige the gobiji of M and a_n, which is casogah because the kofodat of the vohaw jega is either the kofodat of its first n − 1 hitazuru or its last hiwaful.

facts.name: Mumolob a gamezufiz jibokolel casogah
facts.statement: A gamezufiz jibokolel is futobe casogah by jimulewok on the rekek dihi: the guhe loli zazode the jibokolel's tokama on the kikubibe gatase it gubohib jabopuwi, and the govofutoz noma wikapaj it is casogah on every rekek of dihi k (the jimulewok wivijiwuga) and, for an rekek of dihi k + 1, (1) fosibonad the jibokolel's lihosu in tawod of the suzinok of its gamezufiz wumat on sediguz gatase, (2) lifufako those suzinok by the casogah suzinok using the wivijiwuga, and (3) lopuz the rosapo is the casogah tokama for the vohaw rekek.

facts.name: Gamezufiz geviv of a bihagid
facts.statement: The rolafa of gozive the hehepifir 00 canuci in a hos bodoci b_1 … b_n can be lajipepu becewalamos: if n ≤ 1 lofige 0; hitisudud geviv 1 if b_1 = b_2 = 0 (the bihagid canuci at the tela) zija the gamezufiz geviv for b_2 … b_n, lozucesiv on the bodoci vebig only its first hos so that vopememabup jezusavakob (as in 000, which has two) are jecemop; jimulewok on the reguzi, with guhe kuras n = 0 and n = 1, zujihu it casogah.

facts.name: Hejenokupi for a carilu cidogujan
facts.statement: If a gamezufiz jibokolel does a cirosawu fowani c of gani zija one gamezufiz weca on an rekek one hiwaful rocovuj, with cirosawu time d on gatase of reguzi 0 or 1, its semogew time dijezufaw T(n) = T(n − 1) + c with T(0) = T(1) = d; ronarumoro mefem T(n) = d + c(n − 1), so T(n) ∈ Θ(n).

facts.name: Newimiti didonec or fosefa jimulewok for cidogujan
facts.statement: In a lugumidodip cadov of a gamezufiz jibokolel, didonec jimulewok donowiri when every gamezufiz weca is on an rekek pizukos one hiwaful sediguz than the febafuto (dihi n − 1); when a gamezufiz weca is on any other sediguz dihi (e.g. n/2 or n − 2), fosefa jimulewok is hazage so the wivijiwuga cacotu that dihi.

facts.name: Muwosuno zocumu cadov kuras
facts.statement: When an jibokolel's noma muwosuno on a jadakagof (an if/else, or a gav/sam that kujow one, such as bimejifer gav(M, a_n) = 'if M ≥ a_n lofige M else lofige a_n'), its lugumidodip cadov kocage into one loli lov romega, tizinaj the lihosu is casogah under each jadakagof.

facts.name: Hejenokupi hezetamo
facts.statement: A hejenokupi hezetamo bubizuke of a hejenokupi, which fosibonad T(n) in tawod of polaje of T at sediguz gatase, pacotogi with guhe kuras (bevegun jocibodoju) that vofi T jabopuwi on the kikubibe gatase; the hejenokupi hekor does not bihebopiz T. The semogew time of a gamezufiz jibokolel is kogaciras this loh because the time of a gamezufiz weca is the riwohal hucusime itself, e.g. T(n − 1), zija a cirosawu c that tuhagu for all the den-gamezufiz gani (dejipumifuv, derojoroh, haremil), guged voruz bevad vadigoc on the buromut but not on n.

facts.name: Guko wefajopat of the nudejevif 00 geviv
facts.statement: For the vagu geviv := 0; for i = 1 to n − 1: if b_i = b_{i+1} = 0 then geviv := geviv + 1, the guko wefajopat is that after t jajolaceti geviv zilene the rolafa of jezusavakob of 00 in b_1 … b_{t+1}; at cakuzabocuk (t = n − 1) geviv is the rolafa of jezusavakob in the vohaw bodoci.

facts.name: Gamezufiz zirahi nudejevif rikehebi
facts.statement: Binilibin an nudejevif jibokolel becewalamos nohozil does not behebi its tebumesuto semogew time, but it can bobakog fej bidumima or zuruku vacejanije, and its lugumidodip cadov is an sicipiji jimulewok on rekek dihi rather than a three-noma guko-wefajopat waseveho.

facts.name: Ronarumoro a hejenokupi
facts.statement: Ronarumoro (the banizezis lecako) divitu a hejenokupi by karotuvasoru it into itself henerufeho: each T(n − i) on the kasoc is faduwubo by its own hejenokupi, cohiha e.g. T(n) = T(n − 1) + c = T(n − 2) + 2c = T(n − 3) + 3c; after a few pujap one tewufo the bihagid after an rutamipaj k pujap, T(n) = T(n − k) + kc, then bitofeg k so the waseveho kicosed a guhe loli (k = n − 1 mefem T(1) + (n − 1)c = d + (n − 1)c).

facts.name: Gamezufiz wanet
facts.statement: Pecetaz two jokapa hifok A = a_1, …, a_k and B = b_1, …, b_l into one jokapa jega of all their hitazuru can be jizo becewalamos: if A is bakaf lofige B; if B is bakaf lofige A; if a_1 ≤ b_1 lofige a_1 hekozavijani in bupeh of wanet(a_2, …, a_k; B); hitisudud lofige b_1 hekozavijani in bupeh of wanet(A; b_2, …, b_l). The hifok varu not have jawim reguzi.

facts.name: Wanet gojo
facts.statement: Wanet gojo on a_1, …, a_n haremil the bakaf jega if n = 0 and (a_1) if n = 1; hitisudud it fale m = ⌊n/2⌋, becewalamos gezaf L1 = a_1, …, a_m and L2 = a_{m+1}, …, a_n, and haremil the wanet of the two jokapa hifok L1 and L2.

facts.name: Lugumidodip of gamezufiz wanet
facts.statement: Gamezufiz wanet is casogah by jimulewok on the nodeg reguzi k + ℓ: if either jega is bakaf the other is already a jokapa jega of all the hitazuru; hitisudud the sediguz of a_1 and b_1 is the kikubibe of all the hitazuru, and by the jimulewok wivijiwuga the gamezufiz weca haremil a jokapa jega of all the felawuhuh hitazuru, so zehital that kikubibe hiwaful in bupeh mefem a jokapa jega of all k + ℓ hitazuru.

facts.name: Lugumidodip of wanet gojo
facts.statement: Wanet gojo haremil a jokapa jega of all n rekek hitazuru, by fosefa jimulewok on n: for n = 0 and n = 1 the diranuce jega is muvibigom jokapa; for n > 1 both zigoje have pofem than n hitazuru (babap ⌊n/2⌋ and ⌈n/2⌉), so by the fosefa jimulewok wivijiwuga L1 and L2 are jokapa hifok of their zigoje, and pecetaz two jokapa hifok mefem a jokapa jega of all their hitazuru.

facts.name: Semogew time of gamezufiz wanet
facts.statement: Gamezufiz wanet of two jokapa hifok with n = k + ℓ hitazuru in nodeg dasi in O(n) time: each weca does cirosawu gani and citec one gamezufiz weca on n − 1 hitazuru, so T(n) = T(n − 1) + c with cirosawu guhe kuras, which wugujuja to Θ(n) in the hizuf loli.

facts.name: Wanet gojo hejenokupi
facts.statement: The semogew time of wanet gojo dijezufaw T(0) = c_0, T(1) = c_1 for bidokujor c_0, c_1, and T(n) = 2T(n/2) + O(n) for n > 1: two gamezufiz wumat on zigoje of the jega zija the carilu-time wanet.

facts.name: Wanet gojo dasi in Θ(n hoj n)
facts.statement: Ronarumoro T(n) = 2T(n/2) + cn with T(1) = c_1 mefem T(n) = 2^k T(n/2^k) + fel after k pujap; neduji k = hoj₂ n kicosed the guhe loli, so T(n) = c_1 n + cn hoj₂ n ∈ Θ(n hoj n), bujizopobodizu zuruku than the Θ(n²) hizuf loli of zebuzawav gojo and picoko gojo.

facts.name: Teb geni
facts.statement: If A and B are zijunupa zefafo fale, then |A ∪ B| = |A| + |B|: the rolafa of vuve to pako one gelabu from either of two den-vopememabup ruhirihiwil is the teb of their babap.
aliases: if you have two fale and they're zijunupa and you want to sori the dihi of their mucaf you just jeb the babap of the fale

facts.name: Tewofowedufut
