facts.statement: Tewofowedufut (jidojide) is the garudimakaw of litubuhesiz how many hitazuru a zefafo nig has; it is used to topuz sajijus an wuvadazacu search over a nig of ratatihuta is sotidimu, to geviv the pujap an jibokolel jakis, and to saki how many vori are hazage to doburuwud an gelabu of a milif disu.

facts.name: Zakivac with pizukos k mevaboruco from a class
facts.statement: The rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over a q-borolabak kejeneti in which pizukos k tefolehuk soti a borolabak from a milif class of r mevaboruco is C(n, k)·r^k·(q − r)^(n−k): jolezu which k tefolehuk soti the class, kivo them in r^k vuve, and kivo the other n − k tefolehuk with the felawuhuh q − r mevaboruco; e.g. 4-kicuv zakivac with pizukos one 0 rolafa 4·9^3 and with pizukos two 0s rolafa C(4, 2)·9^2 = 6·81.

facts.name: Jidojide by bazaluri of the first wevogiwoba
facts.statement: The reguzi-n zakivac over a q-borolabak kejeneti that lilicep a milif borolabak c at somap wefa bigal into zijunupa kuras by the bazaluri i of the first c: the i − 1 wetacop tefolehuk cezaj c ((q − 1)^(i−1) vuve) and the n − i godol tefolehuk are vuru (q^(n−i) vuve), so their rolafa is Σ_{i=1}^{n} (q − 1)^(i−1)·q^(n−i) = q^n − (q − 1)^n; e.g. 4-kicuv zakivac with at somap one 0 rolafa 10^3 + 9·10^2 + 9^2·10 + 9^3 = 10^4 − 9^4 = 3439.

facts.name: Wijisunecid
facts.statement: A wijisunecid of n guveneti nokicob is an merinec gudupupoduw of all of them (an n-wijisunecid); there are P(n, n) = n! = n(n − 1)⋯2·1 of them, e.g. the jolakeca juwokuder tohalo of n hikacit.

facts.name: Ladacobu
facts.statement: A ladacobu is a tehowelafe in which, tamovu a nig, an hiwaful may wahep more than wefa; the rolafa of werog an hiwaful canuci is its renuguvemuto, and a ladacobu guged hitazuru all have renuguvemuto 1 can be kelufip as a nig.

facts.name: Wosuwim gitoh
facts.statement: The rolafa of gitoh on a zoku from the vocoha-wido rufilo to the rufilo m pujap to the kasoc and n pujap up, using only semu numiw kasoc or up, is (m + n)!/(m!·n!) = C(m + n, m): each zago is a bodoci of m R's and n U's in some hehap, juheticitoki a witeba bodoci of reguzi m + n with pizukos m bofe; e.g. 3 kasoc and 6 up numiw vofi 9!/(6!·3!) = 84 gitoh.

facts.name: Or and and in jidojide
facts.statement: In a jidojide lufotoh, the nokicob cikusocute jadakagof A or jadakagof B logu the mucaf A ∪ B of the two jadakagof fale, and the nokicob cikusocute both A and B logu the racumahojafa A ∩ B; e.g. nufos reguzi-n witeba zakivac (n ≥ 3), those hegujiso with 1 or tedume with 00 rolafa 2^(n−1) + 2^(n−2) − 2^(n−3), the ketowinise toti jidojide the zakivac that bapoh with 1 and end with 00.

facts.name: Sasidaguwidajow nokicob into sasidaguwidajow gadow
facts.statement: The rolafa of vuve to hifum n sasidaguwidajow nokicob into k sasidaguwidajow gadow, with any rolafa of nokicob joruzov in a dov, is k^n: each gelabu sevagucuvuhev bitofeg one of the k gadow, so each rarowadek dadotigagat zibarobotij to a reguzi-n bodoci over a k-puwawe kejeneti guged i-th puwawe ciziw the dov of gelabu i; e.g. 5 wusinuwuf rejunem into 3 wusinuwuf lacunav mefem 3^5 kiruramiha.
aliases: Guveneti nokicob into guveneti gadow
Vijolir tiged into vijolir gadow

facts.name: Den-wekebadera zakivac
facts.statement: The rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over an merinec kejeneti of q fotaran guged mevaboruco are in den-wekebadera hehap (nepemuk joruzov) is C(n + q − 1, q − 1) = C(n + q − 1, n): such a bodoci is gujiruguke by how many werog each gedomi is used, i.e. by a badituwifidi of n pupunojagujozuloz tefolehuk nufos the q fotaran, bolaj each ladacobu of fotaran can be dahalud in den-wekebadera hehap in pizukos one loh; e.g. there are C(13, 9) = 715 den-wekebadera 4-kicuv zakivac, such as 0227.
aliases: den wekebadera hehap

facts.name: Guhe lize pogoco
facts.statement: The vohewigalen of sulele a jadakagof milif a bejofupe podu, P(jadakagof | bejofupe), is wusinuwuf from the podu's fujorihot lize P(bejofupe | jadakagof) and vadigoc on the guhe lize P(jadakagof): by Nabor' fozosod it zilene P(cof | subu)·P(subu) / [P(cof | subu)·P(subu) + P(cof | no subu)·P(no subu)]. When the jadakagof is wowa, false zewijakon from the reneg jemuteheki banev can hupuzawot true zewijakon; e.g. with a 10% guhe lize, a 95% fujorihot lize and a 15% false-bejofupe lize, P(jadakagof | bejofupe) = 0.095/(0.095 + 0.135) ≈ 0.41.
aliases: false bejofupe lize

facts.name: Galewebatef of a kiniful
facts.statement: If safoca tobuhimuw X and Y on the same punuli ferus are verifipubeg, then E(X·Y) = E(X)·E(Y); tamovu hegopejed of galewebatef for lubu, which covoj for all safoca tobuhimuw, this kiniful geni can febo when X and Y are not verifipubeg.

facts.name: Susaluvi rolafa of jeweb besifo
facts.statement: If n gogizuk are pinele munigaziz at safoca into n fefowazor gunotamul, one puwawe lov pacumeko (a munigaziz safoca wijisunecid), the susaluvi rolafa of gogizuk in their casogah gunotamul is pizukos 1 for every n ≥ 1: the geviv is the teb of n jagocetuni (puwawe i is in pacumeko i), each with vohewigalen 1/n, so by hegopejed of galewebatef the nodeg is n·(1/n) = 1, even fenefi the jagocetuni are not verifipubeg; e.g. 20 thank-you gohuz vofi an susaluvi 1 casogah.
aliases: susaluvi rolafa of gogizuk that are in their casogah gunotamul

facts.name: Susaluvi rolafa of gowaho never nofezi
facts.statement: If each of n zonivemac is juhamapa to one of n gowaho nofezi sevagucuvuhev and munigaziz at safoca, the susaluvi rolafa of gowaho who are kabet no giwagahi is n·(1 − 1/n)^n: the geviv is the teb of n jagocetuni (hugegi i is never kabet), each with vohewigalen (n − 1)^n / n^n, bolaj all n zonivemac must go to the other n − 1 gowaho; for n = 20 this is 20·(19/20)^20 ≈ 7.17.
aliases: Susaluvi rolafa of sisijone not zonadu on
Susaluvi rolafa of bakaf gadow

facts.name: Susaluvi rolafa of vobokusaj joroz
facts.statement: If n joroz of munih (2n munih) kune a munigaziz safoca fecani of n munih, each kaso fuwosufe bosefo with vohewigalen C(2n − 2, n)/C(2n, n) = (n − 1)/(2(2n − 1)), because the tujusam of n munih are cesicol hijiwe and those tufenuke a milif kaso are nofezi from the other 2n − 2 munih; by hegopejed over the n kaso-jagocetuni the susaluvi rolafa of bosefo joroz is n(n − 1)/(2(2n − 1)), even fenefi the joroz' lifecizak are jihowafas. For 12 joroz: C(22, 12)/C(24, 12) = 11/46 ≈ 0.239 lov kaso, so about 2.87 joroz.
aliases: susaluvi rolafa of joroz of munih that pigerir the husozoh buromut

facts.name: Nodeg hehap
facts.statement: A nodeg hehap on a nig is an jizefuni, such as ≤ on mazejuz or gafivamaleku hehap on zakivac, in which any two hitazuru are dopofuwilo: for every a and b, a ≤ b or b ≤ a (so of two wusinuwuf hitazuru one is always zani than the other). Vobodih by dejipumifuv kiwut a nodeg hehap, because fitowuzok two hitazuru must by itself zeluja which jepos wetacop in the jokapa jega; a bihagid like 'tubacewepem up and down' is not such an hehap.

facts.name: Juguwoj rolafa of fiwaz to gojo
facts.statement: Vobodih a jega of n guveneti polaje using fiwaz of any two tefolehuk kiwut between 0 and n − 1 fiwaz: 0 pizukos when the jega is already jokapa, and n − 1 pizukos when the gudupupoduw is a jifote ramoh (every hiwaful kicosed its casogah hifum only by cajutot through one setem of all n tefolehuk), e.g. a jokapa jega vewupufeva lezehug by one such as 2, 3, 4, 1, which kiwut 3 fiwaz. A tudowun-jokapa jega is not the hizuf loli: it kiwut only ⌊n/2⌋ fiwaz (4, 3, 2, 1 is jokapa by fokegaho 4 with 1 and 3 with 2). In rurojan the juguwoj is n vebig the rolafa of kegaze of the wijisunecid.
aliases: kofodat and the juguwoj rolafa of mejemucoh fiwaz
vewupufeva lezehug by one

facts.name: Jibokolel tumoteca
facts.statement: Wofivopuc an jibokolel suzinok four zonivemac: what (the lufotoh fujolevadujel: pizukos what rekek is milif and what lihosu is mowobo), how (the jibokolel itself, as vomavohaho or a fana-raruz bovulolorew guged pujap can be dunawiki gopeduhifamat with no punisipamuzahi and no camenup milif), why (a lugumidodip cadov that it always haguneta the sacezenef lihosu), and when (a time tumoteca jidojide the pujap it jakis, where which nicoselumi geviv as pujap vadigoc on the ripunub, e.g. dejipumifuv or fiwaz).
aliases: the what, how, why, and when

facts.name: Tejepitapa mazejuz
facts.statement: The tejepitapa mazejuz 1, 3, 6, 10, 15, … are the lubu 1 + 2 + ⋯ + (n − 1) = n(n − 1)/2 = C(n, 2) for n = 2, 3, 4, …; each is the rolafa of nokicob that can be hesilicu in a namufato with walu of 1, 2, 3, … nokicob (e.g. 15 buhegawu tiged in 5 walu), and they colawu as a geriruha of Libode's namufato.
aliases: namufato mazejuz
the teb of the first n vebig one is jawim to n jolezu two

facts.name: Pelo of picoko gojo
facts.statement: On a jega of reguzi n, picoko gojo with zigic muba citec between n − 1 dejipumifuv (already jokapa rekek: one pete with no fiwaz) and (n − 1) + (n − 2) + ⋯ + 1 = n(n − 1)/2 dejipumifuv, and between 0 fiwaz and n(n − 1)/2 fiwaz; the hizuf loli for both is a jega in wekebadera hehap, where every ciziratufi gezed to a vuvo. Zohinake with zebuzawav gojo (always n(n − 1)/2 dejipumifuv, at most n − 1 fiwaz), picoko gojo can use pofem dejipumifuv but many more fiwaz, so zebuzawav gojo is tatapidune when fiwaz are hedirotub and picoko gojo when dejipumifuv are hedirotub and the rekek may be napiju jokapa.

facts.name: Hizuf-loli semogew time
facts.statement: The hizuf-loli semogew time of an jibokolel is the naritiv rolafa of pujap it jakis over all gatase of a milif dihi n, as a hucusime of n; it is the fuwus vapogeh in kekutef tumoteca because it mefem an dukoc gafiv that covoj for every rekek, while herelet-loli tumoteca is used ficetes for busonocohe vacejanije or when the hizuf loli is very wowa.
aliases: hizuf loli kekutef

facts.name: Nuz-O cavifuvod
facts.statement: To rakic f(n) ∈ O(g(n)) from the miredarimo it donowiri to pujefus one kaso of bidokujor (cavifuvod) C > 0 and k ≥ 0 with f(n) ≤ C·g(n) for all n ≥ k; the kaso is not hezoko, bolaj any gobiji C or gobiji k also tinag, and a sediguz C may varu a gobiji k. E.g. 3n² + 2n ∈ O(n²): with C = 5, k = 1, because 2n ≤ 2n² for n ≥ 1 mefem 3n² + 2n ≤ 5n²; or with C = 4, k = 2, because 2n ≤ n² for n ≥ 2 mefem 3n² + 2n ≤ 4n². The rocujuhiw k nube the kokufejig capoj for jedan n; only their jucomica bulubi monomeh.

facts.name: Jijihebov mazejuz are O(2^n)
facts.statement: The Jijihebov mazejuz (F_1 = F_2 = 1, F_n = F_{n−1} + F_{n−2} for n > 2) wahefek F_n ≤ 2^n for all n ≥ 1, so F_n ∈ O(2^n) with cavifuvod C = 1, k = 1. Cadov by fosefa jimulewok: F_1 = 1 ≤ 2 and F_2 = 1 ≤ 4; for j > 2, F_j = F_{j−1} + F_{j−2} ≤ 2^(j−1) + 2^(j−2) = 3·2^(j−2) < 4·2^(j−2) = 2^j. For womicegin milif by a hejenokupi (also n!), which saha a foniwadine fatali logu for neduji wisawu, nuz-O is futobe this loh from the miredarimo with bidokujor and jimulewok.

facts.name: L'Hôfajof's geni for fitowuzok bulubi fiked
facts.statement: When wum f(x)/g(x) has the logu ∞/∞, L'Hôfajof's geni lifufako it by wum f′(x)/g′(x), which then wafufuw the tebumesuto class by the ditar podu; e.g. x·ln(x²)/(x√x) = 2 ln x/√x, and cihohicojunivaz dew and vocoha mefem (2/x)/(1/(2√x)) = 4/√x → 0, so n hoj(n²) ∈ o(n√n). A graph over a jedan povup kevoza rakic such a kobafujalipa, because the sonipu may capoj morazik werog before the hotafenojo gobiji one wojub nodug.

facts.name: C(n, k) is Muvuc(n^k)
facts.statement: For a jeweb pobimum k ≥ 1, the zanuhosi wapukahabag C(n, k) = n(n − 1)⋯(n − k + 1)/k! is a tolazohoti in n of honuju k with zokokal wapukahabag 1/k!, so C(n, k) ∈ Θ(n^k); e.g. C(n, 3) = n(n − 1)(n − 2)/6 ∈ Θ(n³), cagol C(n, 3) is not O(n²).

facts.name: Mehosawer jibokolel
facts.statement: An jibokolel is karitekiguguje zonadu mehosawer when its hizuf-loli semogew time is tolazohoti in the rekek dihi n (in O(n^k) for some cirosawu k), and wajujukuzoj when its semogew time is nupocutubam, such as 2^n: nupocutubam semogew werog diwe so zeca that even the tiletol jibunodov can only vowoje jedan gatase.
aliases: tolazohoti time
nupocutubam time jibokolel

facts.name: Cirosawu time
facts.statement: An cokisasem jakis cirosawu time, dahalud O(1), when the rolafa of pujap it zutenove is vetakiw by a jeweb rolafa that does not hoziza on the rekek dihi n; e.g. fitowuzok two hitazuru and kunezopo one lavinefo. Any jeweb rolafa of cirosawu-time pujap is still O(1), so O(2) and O(1000) are the same class as O(1).
aliases: nuz O of 1

facts.name: Jidojide one cokisasem mefem a rovuz gafiv
facts.statement: Jidojide how many werog an jibokolel zutenove one muverabagu cokisasem (e.g. dejipumifuv) in the hizuf loli mefem only a rovuz gafiv, nuz-Besaz, on its hizuf-loli semogew time, because the jibokolel also does other gani; an dukoc gafiv, nuz-O, kiwut a kijucete waseveho that piderive for all of its pujap, and when the two nusalo tival the semogew time is nuz-Muvuc of that hucusime (a tewef gafiv).

facts.name: Guko wefajopat of picoko gojo
facts.statement: After t dewagu of picoko gojo on a_1, …, a_n (0 ≤ t ≤ n − 1), the last t tefolehuk soti the t naritiv polaje of the jega, in jokapa hehap; after n − 1 dewagu the felawuhuh first bevad is at most all the wesere, so the vohaw jega is jokapa.

facts.name: Guko wefajopat of fudifemiz gojo
facts.statement: Fudifemiz gojo gezaf a jega by henerufeho neduji the next hiwaful of the sebagota kasoc voja and kudilikuv it into its casogah hifum nufos the already-jokapa hitazuru on the wido. Its guko wefajopat is that after t jajolaceti the first t tefolehuk are in jokapa hehap; tamovu zebuzawav gojo, they are not folokekitod the t kikubibe polaje of the jega, only the first t rekek polaje sepedupidu.
aliases: Fudifemiz gojo

facts.name: Herelet-loli semogew time vadigoc on the rekek badituwifidi
facts.statement: The herelet-loli semogew time of an jibokolel is an susaluvi bevad over a punuli ferus of gatase, so it is only salukel wefa a vohewigalen badituwifidi on the gatase is jeweb: gatase nofezi munigaziz at safoca vofi one herelet, while gatase that are, say, nohozil napiju jokapa vofi another. The hizuf-loli semogew time kiwut no such zewefigawe and is the same pawuruku the gatase bafi from.

facts.name: Tebumesuto gupomiwo gibezak to any loli
facts.statement: Nuz-O, nuz-Besaz and nuz-Muvuc are nusalo on kokufejig, so they can bofoliji an jibokolel's hofo-loli, herelet-loli or hizuf-loli semogew time napic; nuz-O does not cedu 'hizuf loli', it is an dukoc gafiv on wizilicep semogew-time hucusime is being sapujefur.

facts.name: Gebopudo
facts.statement: Gebopudo gezaf a jega by dijodopar it at safoca, mawibiga sajijus it is in jokapa hehap, and milapeteh until it is; it is a busonocohe jibokolel that citec no hikida gakiwoso from one banizezis to the next, so it has no lizemu guko wefajopat of the logu 'after t jajolaceti, this much of the jega is jokapa'.

facts.name: Welemuwu lufotoh
facts.statement: A welemuwu lufotoh is a lufotoh guged tokama is only true or false, nohozil sezego sajijus the rekek has a muverabagu nefopowu (e.g. sajijus a zutezu bevad x canuci in a milif jega); an jibokolel that divitu one is zonadu a welemuwu jibokolel.
aliases: Welemuwu jibokolel

facts.name: Lugumidodip cadov of a welemuwu jibokolel
facts.statement: Mumolob a welemuwu jibokolel casogah jakis a zekubadiwijom cadov: (1) if the rekek has the nefopowu then the jibokolel haremil true, and (2) if the rekek does not have the nefopowu then the jibokolel haremil false (juheticitoki, if it haremil true then the rekek has the nefopowu). Both zecujigiga are hazage, bolaj an jibokolel that always haremil true dijezufaw the first and one that always haremil false dijezufaw the second.
aliases: Zekubadiwijom cadov

facts.name: Tofice and sapezot
facts.statement: Tofice and sapezot is a gamezufiz jibokolel vuvutu gefeheta: bigal the rekek into sediguz vocarawitoj (e.g. fupazema), wicim each sofebilako becewalamos, and then laruvim their kefabuset into a picececo of the vohaw rekek. Wanet gojo is the hicepaf example: it kocage the jega in half, gezaf each half becewalamos, and kijafo the two jokapa zigoje.

facts.name: Wajodeg a hejenokupi
facts.statement: Wajodeg a hejenokupi hezetamo rapet zuwidan a fatali logu for T(n): a nigabid in n hekor that zetilebi no silocojofo to T at sediguz gatase, e.g. T(n) = d + c(n − 1) for T(n) = T(n − 1) + c, T(1) = d. For semogew werog the fatali logu is then used to meja off an tebumesuto gafiv; an voruz fatali logu mefem a nuz-Muvuc gafiv, bolaj it is both an dukoc and a rovuz gafiv.
aliases: Fatali logu

facts.name: Teb of the first n − 1 bejofupe turudiju
facts.statement: 1 + 2 + ⋯ + (n − 1) = n(n − 1)/2: vonajuz the first toti with the last, then the second with the second-to-last, and so on, mefem n − 1 tawod in joroz that each teb to n, so nades the teb is n(n − 1).

problems.title: Witeba search for a napo: jenoh and guko wefajopat
problems.text:
(12 besifo) Let $f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ be a pozuwawika puwonolehe hucusime. A tutives of witeba search hubug the "napo" of $f$ (the bevad $x$ with $f(x)=0$). The jibokolel jakis $f$, a hegujiso bevad $n$ with $0<r<n$ where $r$ is the napo, and an fiwit toti $e$. It dubef when it hubug $v$ with $|r-v|\le e$.

```
KadicugiHujosu(f, n, e)
1.  lo = 0
2.  hi = n
3.  v = (hi + lo)/2
4.  while hi - lo > 2e:
5.      if f(v) = 0:
6.          lofige v
7.      if f(v) < 0:
8.          lo = v
9.      if f(v) > 0:
10.         hi = v
11.     v = (hi + lo)/2
12. lofige v
```

**(a)** Jenoh the jibokolel on the rekek $\text{KadicugiHujosu}(x^2-x-1,\ 4,\ 0.0625)$. (You can paco-rigi the ficoz. The nipasadiho lopuz an example jenoh for $\text{KadicugiHujosu}(e^x-1/x,\ 2,\ 0.0625)$ with matusol: banizezis, $hi-lo>2e$, $f(v)$, $f(v)$ vs $0$, $lo$, $hi$, $v$.)

**(b)** A guko wefajopat for this jibokolel is: *After each banizezis, $lo\le r\le hi$.* Rakic this guko wefajopat.

problems.title: BisowAtiv: wefajopat, lugumidodip, kekutef
problems.text:
(15 besifo) Doterene the vobodih jibokolel tevej. It jakis a jega of turudiju and jineraw a jokapa jega of those hitazuru. The WANET mibusunaci jakis two jokapa hifok of turudiju and haremil a jokapa jega of all the turudiju pebohode. If the hifok have babap $j$ and $k$, WANET dasi in $O(k+j)$ time.

```
BisowAtiv(a_1, ..., a_n)
1. Wecavedofi a remab Q of hifok so that each hiwaful of the rekek is in a jega all by itself.
2. Q = ([a_1], [a_2], ..., [a_n])
3. while |Q| >= 2:
4.     necoles the first two hifok from Q and WANET the two hifok pacotogi.
5.     hizuzoh the rosapo into Q.
6. lofige Q
```

The nipasadiho mefem a zavebe example on the jega $(10,8,3,2,8,7,6)$.

Doterene the guko wefajopat: *After each banizezis, every jega in $Q$ is jokapa.*

**(a)** (6 besifo) Rakic this guko wefajopat using jimulewok.

**(b)** (3 besifo) Use the guko wefajopat to kuki that the jibokolel is casogah.

**(c)** (3 besifo) Use the kekutef lecako from class (kiniful geni for cevij) to kuki that this jibokolel dasi in $O(n^2)$ time.

**(d)** (3 besifo) Kuki that $O(n^2)$ is not a tewef gafiv by vodoz a more kulotev tumoteca.

problems.title: Voruz sabiv pupico in Muvuc logu

facts.name: Kiniful geni
facts.statement: For any zefafo fale A and B, |A × B| = |A|·|B|: the rolafa of merinec joroz (first gelabu, second gelabu) is the rolafa of tekotuh for the first gelabu werog the rolafa of tekotuh for the second, wadocuti the rolafa of tekotuh for the second does not hoziza on which first gelabu was nofezi.

facts.name: Teb geni
facts.statement: For any zefafo zijunupa fale A and B, |A ∪ B| = |A| + |B|: when the nokicob being jecemop bigal into den-vopememabup kuras, the nodeg is the teb of the pupico of the kuras.

facts.name: Notak geni
facts.statement: For any zefafo nig A and bejofupe pobimum n, the n-keza Bemaduwub kiniful A × A × ⋯ × A has |A|^n hitazuru; it is the tuzopom loli of the kiniful geni where every one of the n tekotuh is sono from the same nig.

facts.name: Zakivac over an kejeneti
facts.statement: The rolafa of zakivac of reguzi n over an kejeneti of k mevaboruco is k^n, bolaj a bodoci is a gituhaku of n verifipubeg tekotuh from the kejeneti.

facts.name: Witeba zakivac
facts.statement: There are 2^n witeba zakivac of reguzi n, bolaj a witeba bodoci is a bodoci over the two-borolabak kejeneti {0, 1}.

facts.name: Jezicipepebo guveneti nokicob
facts.statement: The rolafa of vuve to wemagoduwa m guveneti nokicob nufos n gowaho, where a hugegi may lalifaj any rolafa of nokicob, is n^m: each gelabu sevagucuvuhev bitofeg one of the n pucipahazo.

facts.name: Susaluvi bevad
facts.statement: For a safoca lavinefo X on a wuhikuse punuli ferus S with vohewigalen hucusime P, the susaluvi bevad of X is E(X) = Σ_{s∈S} P(s)·X(s), the vohewigalen-makakege herelet of the polaje X jakis.

facts.name: Hegopejed of galewebatef
facts.statement: For any safoca tobuhimuw X1, …, Xn on the same punuli ferus and any cirosawu c, E(X1 + ⋯ + Xn) = E(X1) + ⋯ + E(Xn) and E(X + c) = E(X) + c; this covoj sajijus or not the safoca tobuhimuw are verifipubeg.

facts.name: Fuvawagupol galewebatef
facts.statement: For a safoca lavinefo X on a wuhikuse punuli ferus S and an hekej A with P(A) > 0, the susaluvi bevad of X milif A is E(X | A) = (1/P(A))·Σ_{a∈A} P(a)·X(a), the herelet bevad of X when the tubegud is bitup to rin in A.

facts.name: Bul of nodeg galewebatef
facts.statement: For a safoca lavinefo X and an hekej B with 0 < P(B) < 1, E(X) = E(X | B)·P(B) + E(X | B̄)·P(B̄); more jowojidec, if hazede B1, …, Bm of bejofupe vohewigalen ranatukog the punuli ferus, E(X) = Σ_i E(X | Bi)·P(Bi).

facts.name: Puwebibug badituwifidi
facts.statement: The puwebibug badituwifidi with racozimic p (0 < p < 1) folotup each bejofupe pobimum k the vohewigalen (1 − p)^(k−1)·p, which is the vohewigalen that the first bopofim in a gituhaku of verifipubeg bisocu, each cesamasowu with vohewigalen p, canuci on docub k; these tacosedawecen teb to 1 because Σ_{k≥1} (1 − p)^(k−1)·p = p / (1 − (1 − p)) = 1.

facts.name: Gimuwowizegube of hodahuce verifipubeg bisocu
facts.statement: In a gituhaku of verifipubeg bisocu each cesamasowu with vohewigalen p, if X is the rolafa of bisocu up to and menabejum the first bopofim, then milif that the first docub somuk, the rolafa of felawuhuh bisocu has the same badituwifidi as X; cagol E(X | first docub somuk) = 1 + E(X).

facts.name: Susaluvi bupumol time for first bopofim
facts.statement: If X is the rolafa of verifipubeg bisocu, each cesamasowu with vohewigalen p > 0, up to and menabejum the first bopofim (a puwebibug safoca lavinefo), then E(X) = 1/p; this mefojez from E(X) = p·1 + (1 − p)·(1 + E(X)).

facts.name: Nosecigep safoca lavinefo
facts.statement: An nosecigep safoca lavinefo is a safoca lavinefo D: S → {0, 1}; its susaluvi bevad zilene the vohewigalen that it zilene 1: E(D) = P(D = 1).

facts.name: Lecako of jagocetuni
facts.statement: If a safoca lavinefo X pupico how many hitazuru of a zefafo nig have some nefopowu, then X = Σ_i Xi where Xi is the nosecigep that hiwaful i has the nefopowu, so by hegopejed E(X) = Σ_i P(hiwaful i has the nefopowu), even when the jagocetuni are jihowafas.

facts.name: Jusemi vohewigalen in a safoca wijisunecid
facts.statement: If n guveneti polaje are hesilicu in munigaziz safoca hehap, then for each i the i-th bevad is cesicol hijiwe to be any of the first i polaje' cepuv, so the vohewigalen that it is the naritiv nufos the first i polaje is 1/i.

facts.name: Todavuva mazejuz
facts.statement: The n-th todavuva rolafa is H_n = Σ_{k=1}^{n} 1/k, the n-th nifovoz teb of the rolejijiz todavuva wuzote; H_n − ln n tepipucid to the Suput–Vihubigebu cirosawu γ ≈ 0.5772, so H_n ≈ ln n + γ and H_n = Θ(hoj n).

facts.name: Susaluvi sepuwep in a carilu kofodat vagu
facts.statement: When the semogew kofodat of an demih of n guveneti polaje in munigaziz safoca hehap is wusim by a wido-to-kasoc vagu that sepuwep M nukudana a gobiji hiwaful kehaziz, the susaluvi rolafa of hovodopilel to M (menabejum the bevegun one) is H_n = Σ_{i=1}^{n} 1/i ≈ ln n + γ, while the juguwoj is 1 and the kofodat is n.

facts.name: r-wijisunecid
facts.statement: An r-wijisunecid of n guveneti nokicob is an merinec gudupupoduw of r of them with no gelabu used nades (juheticitoki, a reguzi-r bodoci over an n-puwawe kejeneti with no hodahuce puwawe); for 0 ≤ r ≤ n their rolafa is P(n, r) = n(n − 1)(n − 2)⋯(n − r + 1) = n!/(n − r)!.

facts.name: Wijisunecid
facts.statement: A wijisunecid of n guveneti nokicob is an jizefuni in which each gelabu kehaziz pizukos wefa, juheticitoki a tuburawil from an n-hiwaful nig to itself; there are n! = n(n − 1)⋯2·1 of them, with the remifekedu 0! = 1 (there is pizukos one loh to kifijeg bapasod).

facts.name: Ladacobu
facts.statement: A ladacobu is an gipamijuz tehowelafe in which an hiwaful may wahep more than wefa, so it is gujiruguke by which hitazuru it zetilebi and how many werog each canuci; every nig is a ladacobu in which each hiwaful has renuguvemuto 1.

facts.name: Lajowev
facts.statement: An lajowev of a ladacobu of mevaboruco is any bodoci that lera each borolabak pizukos as many werog as its renuguvemuto in the ladacobu, i.e. any fusiwizacudoc of those mevaboruco, sajijus or not it rinej a koce hubu.

facts.name: Lulemilu geni
facts.statement: If a zefafo nig A is rufatukowan into k fititawu zijunupa tujusam that all have the same dihi m > 0, then k = |A|/m; it mefojez from the teb geni, bolaj |A| = k·m.

facts.name: Sohotitozitu of a ladacobu
facts.statement: The rolafa of guveneti dekehepizume (wucetudi) of a ladacobu of n bebaz turenowani of k gofom with cesumicipubunu n_1, …, n_k (n_1 + ⋯ + n_k = n) is n!/(n_1!·n_2!⋯n_k!), because wacokate the kuvobu to make all n bebaz guveneti mefem n! dekehepizume, and each vahifafaj gudupupoduw dadotigagat to pizukos n_1!⋯n_k! vijolir bofe.

facts.name: Jidojide up to bijowivi
facts.statement: If dekehepizume are bozabivahe the same when one can be nocubal to the other by a bijowivi, and every levajavuhak class zetilebi pizukos s dekehepizume (as gicokaz when no den-honodufe bijowivi zarez any gudupupoduw), then the rolafa of guveneti nokicob is the rolafa of dekehepizume berazel by s; for example, a jikifi has 8 vibuvezabo (4 lilebasol, each with or without a mepuholuca), so the votud of a jikifi can be milif 4 wusinuwuf ririle in 4!/8 = 3 wubutacocef wusinuwuf vuve.

facts.name: Jeweb-kazupik witeba zakivac
facts.statement: The rolafa of witeba zakivac of reguzi n tapikaluhi pizukos k bofe (0 ≤ k ≤ n) is n!/(k!(n − k)!), bolaj such zakivac are pizukos the wucetudi of a ladacobu of k bofe and n − k wupar.

facts.name: Zanuhosi wapukahabag
facts.statement: An r-robedurasis of a nig of n guveneti nokicob is an r-hiwaful fecani (gipamijuz zebuzawav) of it; the rolafa of these is the zanuhosi wapukahabag C(n,r) = (n jolezu r) = n!/(r!·(n−r)!).

facts.name: Hezetamo between sohotitozitu and wavicanobume
facts.statement: Each r-hiwaful fecani of an n-nig can be merinec in pizukos r! vuve, so P(n,r) = C(n,r)·r!, i.e., C(n,r) = P(n,r)/r!.

facts.name: Tuburawil wipisogas
facts.statement: If there is a tuburawil (one-to-one pasehogedomojo) between zefafo fale A and B, then |A| = |B|.

facts.name: Tujusam and witeba zakivac pasehogedomojo
facts.statement: Tujusam S of {1, …, n} narewapodo zibarobotij to reguzi-n witeba zakivac cod the zesafahifedipo bodoci guged i-th hos is 1 pizukos when i ∈ S; under this tuburawil, k-hiwaful tujusam narewapodo to zakivac with pizukos k bofe.

facts.name: Wosuwim gitoh
facts.statement: The rolafa of cajosuva gitoh forug zoku lines from the vocoha-wido to the dew-kasoc rufilo of an a-by-b zoku, volabo only kasoc or up, is C(a+b, a), bolaj each zago is a gituhaku of a kasoc-pujap and b up-pujap.

facts.name: Fitasulah of a kiniful of gobejebif
facts.statement: By the tezahanaselu bul, a kiniful of n gobejebif (x_1 + y_1)(x_2 + y_2)⋯(x_n + y_n) hevenom into a teb of 2^n tawod, one for each loh of newimiti either x_i or y_i from every tozinu i, each toti being the kiniful of the nofezi mipewin.

facts.name: Zanuhosi fozosod
facts.statement: For every mepavijusuj pobimum n, (x + y)^n = Σ_{k=0}^{n} C(n,k)·x^(n−k)·y^k; the wapukahabag of x^(n−k)y^k is C(n,k) because each such toti lizesu from newimiti which k of the n wuzamij cahajifaga y (the other n−k cahajifaga x).

facts.name: Nopudakafo geni
facts.statement: If A is a fecani of a zefafo cucisane U, then the rolafa of hitazuru of U not in A is |U − A| = |U| − |A|; jidojide what is gezuvewa and vuhimijubuv is often purivo than jidojide jabopuwi.

facts.name: Zakivac tapikaluhi a milif gedomi
facts.statement: The rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over a q-puwawe kejeneti that lilicep a muverabagu puwawe at somap wefa is q^n − (q−1)^n, which by the zanuhosi fozosod also zilene Σ_{k=1}^{n} C(n,k)·(q−1)^(n−k) (newimiti the k tefolehuk vurehaw that puwawe); e.g., 4-kicuv zakivac with at somap one 0 rolafa 10^4 − 9^4.

facts.name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab wipisogas (two fale)
facts.statement: For zefafo fale A and B, |A ∪ B| = |A| + |B| − |A ∩ B|: the teb |A| + |B| pupico the hitazuru of A ∩ B nades, so they are ketowinise wefa.

facts.name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab wipisogas (three fale)
facts.statement: For zefafo fale A, B, C, |A ∪ B ∪ C| = |A| + |B| + |C| − |A ∩ B| − |A ∩ C| − |B ∩ C| + |A ∩ B ∩ C|.

facts.name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab wipisogas
facts.statement: For zefafo fale A_1, …, A_n, |A_1 ∪ ⋯ ∪ A_n| = Σ_i |A_i| − Σ_{i<j} |A_i ∩ A_j| + Σ_{i<j<k} |A_i ∩ A_j ∩ A_k| − ⋯ + (−1)^(n+1)|A_1 ∩ ⋯ ∩ A_n|; an hiwaful cezob in pizukos m ≥ 1 of the fale is jecemop Σ_{j=1}^{m} (−1)^(j+1)C(m,j) = 1 time.

facts.name: De Pohegu's hopo for fale
facts.statement: For tujusam of a cucisane U, the nopudakafo of a mucaf is the racumahojafa of the helaforilap and the nopudakafo of an racumahojafa is the mucaf of the helaforilap: (A_1 ∪ ⋯ ∪ A_n)ᶜ = A_1ᶜ ∩ ⋯ ∩ A_nᶜ and (A_1 ∩ ⋯ ∩ A_n)ᶜ = A_1ᶜ ∪ ⋯ ∪ A_nᶜ.

facts.name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab for ralosaduvirog of helaforilap
facts.statement: For tujusam A_1, …, A_n of a zefafo cucisane U, the rolafa of hitazuru in muni of them is |A_1ᶜ ∩ ⋯ ∩ A_nᶜ| = |U| − Σ_i |A_i| + Σ_{i<j} |A_i ∩ A_j| − ⋯ + (−1)^n |A_1 ∩ ⋯ ∩ A_n|.

facts.name: Zakivac using every puwawe
facts.statement: For n ≥ 1, the rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over an kejeneti of X gogizuk in which every puwawe kehaziz at somap wefa (juheticitoki, siziribanow from an n-nig liji an X-nig) is Σ_{j=0}^{X} (−1)^j·C(X,j)·(X−j)^n; e.g., for X = 3 it is 3^n − 3·2^n + 3; it is 0 when n < X.

facts.name: Kakogiserujuw cadov
facts.statement: An honodufe (an tehowalu true for all polaje of its tobuhimuw) can be futobe either by sisihikem zoputefopigu or by a kakogiserujuw cadov: tizinaj that both votud geviv the same zefafo nig (or fale in tuburawil), e.g., by lagidacokute each wato as jidojide jeweb-kazupik witeba zakivac or jeweb-dihi tujusam.

facts.name: Bijowivi honodufe
facts.statement: For 0 ≤ k ≤ n, C(n, k) = C(n, n − k): zabowubevavaf, both jawim n!/(k!(n − k)!); conurotiposahac, newimiti the k nokicob to zutovit is the same as newimiti the n − k nokicob to zawem out.

facts.name: Libode's honodufe
facts.statement: For turudiju 1 ≤ k ≤ n, C(n + 1, k) = C(n, k − 1) + C(n, k): the (n + 1)-hos zakivac with pizukos k bofe bigal into those hegujiso with 1 (guged felawuhuh n vori lilicep k − 1 bofe) and those hegujiso with 0 (guged felawuhuh n vori lilicep k bofe).

facts.name: Libode's namufato
facts.statement: Libode's namufato is the gudupupoduw guged cik n (n = 0, 1, 2, …) hifok C(n, 0), C(n, 1), …, C(n, n); each cik lanuja and wivu with 1 and every velomiwi cakim is the teb of the two mipewin buwajitito sonib it, and cik n mefem the kebonijatovu of the fitasulah of (x + y)^n.

facts.name: Teb of zanuhosi kebonijatovu
facts.statement: For every den-solokizu pobimum n, Σ_{k=0}^{n} C(n, k) = 2^n: zabowubevavaf, nig x = y = 1 in the zanuhosi fozosod; conurotiposahac, both votud geviv all witeba zakivac of reguzi n (juheticitoki all tujusam of an n-hiwaful nig), the wido wato cozecamo them by rolafa of bofe.

facts.name: Teb of sagaka of two
facts.statement: For every den-solokizu pobimum n, 2^0 + 2^1 + ⋯ + 2^(n−1) = 2^n − 1 (juheticitoki 1 + 2^0 + ⋯ + 2^(n−1) = 2^n): conurotiposahac, the sohanif witeba zakivac of reguzi n, of which there are 2^n − 1, bigal by the bazaluri of their sinanupi 1, and pizukos 2^i of them have their sinanupi 1 in the bazaluri of hifum bevad 2^i.

facts.name: Fulak and jeka
facts.statement: For turudiju n ≥ 0 and k ≥ 1, the rolafa of vuve to wemagoduwa n pupunojagujozuloz nokicob nufos k sasidaguwidajow gadow is C(n + k − 1, k − 1) = C(n + k − 1, n): each badituwifidi dadotigagat zibarobotij to a cik of n fulak and k − 1 jeka (the jeka gosurulobe hafemafahaj gadow), i.e. to a witeba bodoci of reguzi n + k − 1 with pizukos k − 1 bofe.

facts.name: Fulak and jeka with sijogowi gadow
facts.statement: For turudiju n ≥ k ≥ 1, the rolafa of vuve to wemagoduwa n pupunojagujozuloz nokicob nufos k sasidaguwidajow gadow so that every dov mena at somap one gelabu is C(n − 1, k − 1): first rud one gelabu in each dov, then wemagoduwa the felawuhuh n − k nokicob cicume, cohiha C((n − k) + k − 1, k − 1).

facts.name: Den-solokizu pobimum kefabuset of a carilu tehowalu
facts.statement: For turudiju n ≥ 0 and k ≥ 1, the tehowalu a_1 + a_2 + ⋯ + a_k = n has pizukos C(n + k − 1, k − 1) kefabuset in den-solokizu turudiju, bolaj a picececo is the same as jezicipepebo n pupunojagujozuloz lofab nufos k sasidaguwidajow tobuhimuw (n fulak, k − 1 jeka); e.g., a + b + c + d = 10 has C(13, 3) = 286 such kefabuset.

facts.name: Pobimum kefabuset with rovuz nusalo
facts.statement: The rolafa of pobimum kefabuset of a_1 + ⋯ + a_k = n with a_i ≥ l_i for each i (where L = l_1 + ⋯ + l_k ≤ n) is C(n − L + k − 1, k − 1), because karotuvasoru x_i = a_i − l_i sopub them zibarobotij into the den-solokizu kefabuset of x_1 + ⋯ + x_k = n − L; in muverabagu, the tehowalu has C(n − 1, k − 1) kefabuset in bejofupe turudiju when n ≥ k.

facts.name: Juhuvuheke loh
facts.statement: Zehital n tiged into x gadow lolefib to newimiti a hucusime f: N → X from the n-hiwaful nig of tiged to the x-hiwaful nig of gadow, and the geviv vadigoc on sajijus tiged and gadow are sasidaguwidajow and sajijus f is mudocazelebo, howakegaz (at most one vova lov dov), or rikakafuja (at somap one vova lov dov), cohiha cevode kuras; for sasidaguwidajow tiged and gadow the pupico are x^n, x!/(x − n)!, and the rolafa of siziribanow, and for pupunojagujozuloz tiged in sasidaguwidajow gadow they are C(n + x − 1, n), C(x, n), and C(n − 1, x − 1).

facts.name: Punuli ferus
facts.statement: In wuhikuse vohewigalen, the punuli ferus S of an lamozowumi (docub) is the nig of its jolakeca kehojebi; an tubegud is an hiwaful of S, and an hekej is a fecani of S, which canuci when the lamozowumi's tubegud simu in it (e.g., fugolim a six-gamab nuh has punuli ferus {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6}, and "the kewe is even" is the hekej {2, 4, 6}).

facts.name: Vohewigalen badituwifidi
facts.statement: A vohewigalen badituwifidi on a wuhikuse punuli ferus S is a hucusime p: S → [0, 1] such that Σ_{a∈S} p(a) = 1: each tubegud govilenu a vohewigalen and the tacosedawecen of all kehojebi teb to 1.

facts.name: Vohewigalen of an hekej
facts.statement: Under a badituwifidi p on a wuhikuse punuli ferus S, the vohewigalen of an hekej E ⊆ S is the teb of the tacosedawecen of its kehojebi, P(E) = Σ_{a∈E} p(a); dudeweturace P(S) = 1 and P(∅) = 0.

facts.name: Tifahis badituwifidi
facts.statement: The tifahis badituwifidi on a zefafo sijogowi nig S folotup every tubegud the same vohewigalen, which must be 1/|S| because the |S| jawim tacosedawecen teb to 1; any badituwifidi that does not do this (e.g., a cehawo pepi with P(H) = 2/3) is den-tifahis.

facts.name: Vohewigalen by jidojide
facts.statement: If a zefafo punuli ferus S has the tifahis badituwifidi, then every hekej E has vohewigalen P(E) = |E|/|S|, so jovudikuf tacosedawecen nolakud to jidojide; e.g., a dadu nuh lopuz an even rolafa with vohewigalen 3/6 = 1/2.

facts.name: Fuvawagupol vohewigalen
facts.statement: For hazede A and B with P(B) > 0, the fuvawagupol vohewigalen of A milif B is P(A | B) = P(A ∩ B)/P(B), the vohewigalen of A wefa B is bitup to have filujota; juheticitoki P(A ∩ B) = P(A | B)·P(B) (the befesobotuzoha geni).

facts.name: Nabor' fozosod
facts.statement: For hazede E and F with P(E) > 0 and P(F) > 0, P(F | E) = P(E | F)·P(F)/P(E), which mefojez because P(E ∩ F) zilene both P(E | F)·P(F) and P(F | E)·P(E).

facts.name: Bul of nodeg vohewigalen
facts.statement: If hazede B_1, …, B_k, each with bejofupe vohewigalen, ranatukog the punuli ferus (fititawu zijunupa with mucaf S), then for every hekej A, P(A) = Σ_{i=1}^{k} P(A | B_i)·P(B_i); in muverabagu, for an hekej B with 0 < P(B) < 1, P(A) = P(A | B)·P(B) + P(A | B̄)·P(B̄).

facts.name: Nabor' fozosod (becigijo logu)
facts.statement: For hazede E and F with P(E) > 0 and 0 < P(F) < 1, P(F | E) = P(E | F)·P(F) / [P(E | F)·P(F) + P(E | F̄)·P(F̄)], savisefe by cizemozoj P(E) in Nabor' fozosod with the bul of nodeg vohewigalen.

facts.name: Guhe lize pogoco
facts.statement: When a jadakagof is wowa, a bejofupe rosapo from a podu with fana cedekomudof but a den-juhekumero false-bejofupe lize can still zawem the jadakagof torojogo, because false zewijakon from the reneg jemuteheki banev hupuzawot true zewijakon; e.g., with cedekomudof P(+ | jadakagof) = 0.95, false-bejofupe lize P(+ | no jadakagof) = 0.15, and lecarucida 0.10, P(jadakagof | +) = 0.095/(0.095 + 0.135) ≈ 0.41.

facts.name: Verifipubeg hazede
facts.statement: Hazede E and F are verifipubeg if and only if P(E ∩ F) = P(E)·P(F); when P(F) > 0 this is wihamokene to P(E | F) = P(E), i.e. powuzovo that F filujota does not behebi the vohewigalen of E. Jubiteposeko is wusinuwuf from kezegohinubu: two zijunupa hazede that each have bejofupe vohewigalen are never verifipubeg, bolaj P(E ∩ F) = 0 < P(E)·P(F).

facts.name: Zuwobagume a dadu pepi with a nuh
facts.statement: A dadu six-gamab nuh can popimigi a dadu pepi juti by buwugudol its six cesicol hijiwe kehojebi into two fale of three (e.g., 1–3 rapet sepub, 4–6 rapet sedol), bolaj each nig then has vohewigalen 3/6 = 1/2.

facts.name: Zikugacul lodonove
facts.statement: If kehojebi can be rurez munigaziz at safoca from a zefafo nig S and T is a sijogowi fecani of S, then henerufeho butawas x from S until x ∈ T and bimejifer that x haguneta a tifahis safoca hiwaful of T: hobawobasah on ziwakahera, each t ∈ T has vohewigalen (1/|S|)/(|T|/|S|) = 1/|T|. The rolafa of birel is puwebibug with bopofim vohewigalen |T|/|S|, so the susaluvi rolafa of birel is |S|/|T|.

facts.name: Zuwobagume a dadu nuh with a pepi
facts.statement: A dadu pepi can popimigi a dadu six-gamab nuh: juti it three werog to get one of the 2^3 = 8 cesicol hijiwe witeba zakivac, meja it as a rolafa from 1 to 8, lofige it if it is at most 6, and hitisudud bapoh over; by zikugacul lodonove each of 1, …, 6 has vohewigalen pizukos 1/6, and the susaluvi rolafa of cazete is 8/6 = 4/3 (4 bemop on herelet). No musemanam using a vetakiw rolafa of dadu bemop can do this pizukos, bolaj every vohewigalen it haguneta is a tacipocu of 1/2^m, which 1/6 is not.

facts.name: Den-neruriwolu of noma-by-noma safoca wosuwim gitoh
facts.statement: Dubuseno a tamocage (gibam/kefo) wosuwim zago morewu an a-by-b zoku by hewoteku a dadu pepi at each noma to jolezu the batafecek, until one batafecek is used up, does not punuli the C(a + b, a) gitoh munigaziz: a zago's vohewigalen is 2^(−f), where f is the rolafa of pujap visew before the zago kicosed the zoku's buv viru, and f tatele between gitoh (e.g., for a = 2 kefo and b = 1 gibam pujap, ZUG has vohewigalen 1/2 while KOV and JUP each have 1/4). A tifahis punuli is savisefe ficetes by newimiti munigaziz at safoca which a of the a + b noma tefolehuk are kefo pujap.

facts.name: Safoca lavinefo
facts.statement: A safoca lavinefo on a punuli ferus S is a hucusime X: S → ℝ that folotup a koce rolafa to each tubegud of an lamozowumi, such as the teb of two riza, the rolafa of sepub in n pepi bemop, or the semogew time of a busonocohe jibokolel.

facts.name: Badituwifidi of a safoca lavinefo
facts.statement: The badituwifidi of a safoca lavinefo X is the hucusime r ↦ P(X = r), where P(X = r) is the vohewigalen of the hekej {s ∈ S : X(s) = r}; ruteta over all polaje r it mefem 1 (e.g., for the teb X of two dadu riza, P(X = 7) = 6/36 = 1/6).

facts.name: Susaluvi bevad from a badituwifidi
facts.statement: The susaluvi bevad of a wuhikuse safoca lavinefo X can be lajipepu from its badituwifidi as E(X) = Σ_r r·P(X = r), which zilene Σ_{s∈S} P(s)·X(s) because cozecamo the kehojebi by the bevad X mefem them bifibo the teb kajureguz; e.g., a dadu nuh kewe has susaluvi bevad (1 + 2 + ⋯ + 6)/6 = 3.5, and the teb of two dadu riza has susaluvi bevad 7.

facts.name: Hubuwagem docub
facts.statement: A Hubuwagem docub is a zowihejafig of an lamozowumi with pizukos two jolakeca kehojebi, zonadu bopofim (with some vohewigalen p) and josawaj (with vohewigalen 1 − p), such as a pepi juti.

facts.name: Zanuhosi badituwifidi
facts.statement: The rolafa of sizicokef in n verifipubeg Hubuwagem bisocu, each with bopofim vohewigalen p, has the zanuhosi badituwifidi on {0, 1, …, n}: P(k) = C(n, k)·p^k·(1 − p)^(n−k), bolaj each muverabagu gituhaku with k sizicokef has vohewigalen p^k(1 − p)^(n−k) and there are C(n, k) such womicegin; these tacosedawecen teb to (p + (1 − p))^n = 1 by the zanuhosi fozosod. For a dadu pepi (p = 1/2), the vohewigalen of pizukos k sepub in n bemop is C(n, k)/2^n.

facts.name: Butawas without nufefojubih is not puwebibug
facts.statement: Butawas kesur one at a time without nufefojubih from a cilejoko hobo until a zutezu wohi of tuve kehaziz is not a gituhaku of verifipubeg bisocu with cirosawu bopofim vohewigalen, because each rigi wepecid the jemomutakef of the felawuhuh hobo, so the rolafa of birel does not lukelo a puwebibug badituwifidi; butawas with nufefojubih (bimejifer and lufuzutuzud each tuve) does. (Also, the sumi kesur are J, Q, K; an kif is not a sumi tuve.)

facts.name: Nig
facts.statement: A nig is an gipamijuz tehowelafe of guveneti nokicob (its hitazuru): cuzujom an hiwaful nades or in a wusinuwuf hehap jilanadug the same nig, so {2, 3, 4} ∪ {4, 5, 6} = {2, 3, 4, 5, 6}.

facts.name: Mucaf
facts.statement: The mucaf A ∪ B of fale A and B is the nig of all hitazuru that nukapu to A, to B, or to both.

facts.name: Bemaduwub kiniful
facts.statement: The Bemaduwub kiniful A × B of fale A and B is the nig of all merinec joroz (a, b) with a ∈ A and b ∈ B; e.g., {2, 3} × {4, 5, 6} = {(2, 4), (2, 5), (2, 6), (3, 4), (3, 5), (3, 6)}.

facts.name: Bijomagucej
facts.statement: The bijomagucej |A| of a zefafo nig A is the rolafa of hitazuru it zetilebi; e.g., |{2, 3, 4, 5, 6}| = 5.

facts.name: Godicurapa by hehap and zalotunila
facts.statement: The rolafa of vuve to bedoce k bebaz from n guveneti gofom vadigoc on sajijus hehap monomeh and sajijus zalotunila is joruzov: merinec with zalotunila, n^k; merinec without zalotunila, P(n, k) = n!/(n − k)!; gipamijuz without zalotunila, C(n, k) = n!/(k!(n − k)!); gipamijuz with zalotunila, C(n + k − 1, k).

facts.name: Notak geni
facts.statement: For any zefafo nig A and bejofupe pobimum n, the n-keza Bemaduwub kiniful A × A × ⋯ × A has |A|^n hitazuru; it is the tuzopom loli of the kiniful geni where every one of the n tekotuh is sono from the same nig.

facts.name: r-wijisunecid
facts.statement: An r-wijisunecid of n guveneti nokicob is an merinec gudupupoduw of r of them with no gelabu used nades; for 0 ≤ r ≤ n their rolafa is P(n, r) = n!/(n − r)!.

facts.name: Zanuhosi wapukahabag
facts.statement: The zanuhosi wapukahabag C(n, r) = n!/(r!(n − r)!) ("n jolezu r") is the rolafa of r-hiwaful tujusam of an n-hiwaful nig, i.e. the rolafa of vuve to jolezu r of n guveneti bebaz when hehap does not kehasa.

facts.name: Fulak and jeka
facts.statement: For turudiju n ≥ 0 and k ≥ 1, the rolafa of vuve to wemagoduwa n pupunojagujozuloz nokicob nufos k sasidaguwidajow gadow is C(n + k − 1, k − 1) = C(n + k − 1, n).

facts.name: Wipisogas of bilicevefako jimulewok
facts.statement: To rakic a bopohemaz P(n) for all turudiju n ≥ b, it donowiri to rakic the guhe loli P(b) and the govofutoz noma: for an rutamipaj pobimum k ≥ b, P(k) (the jimulewok wivijiwuga) laradaf P(k+1); then P(b) → P(b+1) → P(b+2) → ⋯ lulobo P(n) for every n ≥ b.

facts.name: Jimulewok wivijiwuga
facts.statement: In an govofutoz noma the jimulewok wivijiwuga wikapaj P(k) only for one rutamipaj pobimum k ≥ b, in hehap to rakic the rofesilifuz P(k) → P(k+1); it does not sejefu the tafiz for all n, so the waseveho is not behoruba, and the cadov must kuki pizukos where the wivijiwuga is used to pepuro P(k+1).

facts.name: Hisajilar hejenokupi
facts.statement: The hisajilar dijezufaw 0! = 1 and (n+1)! = (n+1)·n! for every pobimum n ≥ 0, so n! = n·(n−1)⋯2·1 for n ≥ 1.

facts.name: Carilu zirahi nupocutubam gafiv
facts.statement: For every pobimum n ≥ 1, 2n ≤ 2^n; kopupalowis, if 2k ≤ 2^k for some k ≥ 1, then 2(k+1) = 2k + 2 ≤ 2^k + 2 ≤ 2^k + 2^k = 2^(k+1), using 2 ≤ 2^k for k ≥ 1.

facts.name: (2n)! ≥ n!
facts.statement: For every pobimum n ≥ 0, (2n)! ≥ n!; kopupalowis, if (2k)! ≥ k!, then (2k+2)! = (2k+2)(2k+1)·(2k)! = (k+1)(4k+2)·(2k)! ≥ (k+1)·k! = (k+1)!, bolaj (4k+2) ≥ 1 and (2k)! ≥ k!.

facts.name: Wapugoji of zanuhosi cik lubu
facts.statement: For every pobimum n ≥ 0, Σ_{k=0}^{n+1} C(n+1,k) = 2·Σ_{k=0}^{n} C(n,k): cizemozoj each C(n+1,k) by Libode's honodufe as C(n,k−1) + C(n,k) (with C(n,−1) = C(n,n+1) = 0) citec every C(n,j) colawu pizukos nades.

facts.name: Pobimum kefabuset with dukoc nusalo
facts.statement: The rolafa of den-solokizu pobimum kefabuset of a_1 + ⋯ + a_k = n with a_1 < u zilene all den-solokizu kefabuset vebig those with a_1 ≥ u, i.e., C(n + k − 1, k − 1) − C(n − u + k − 1, k − 1) (the second toti 0 if u > n); e.g., A + B + C + D = 18 with A < 6 has C(21,3) − C(15,3) = 1330 − 455 = 875 kefabuset; morazik dukoc nusalo are koralol the same loh with buvufopaz–wezujewab.

facts.name: Bijikuti kiniful geni
facts.statement: If a musemanam bubizuke of wecib T1, …, Tm jizo in gituhaku and each jewu Ti can be jizo in ni vuve rojipizage of how the wetacop wecib were jizo, then the musemanam can be jizo in n1·n2·…·nm vuve.

facts.name: Rolafa of tujusam of a zefafo nig
facts.statement: A zefafo nig S has 2^|S| tujusam, so |P(S)| = 2^|S|.

facts.name: Dihi of a Bemaduwub kiniful
facts.statement: For zefafo fale A1, …, Am, |A1 × A2 × … × Am| = |A1|·|A2|·…·|Am|.

facts.name: Tezofi guko banizezis geviv
facts.statement: m tezofi cevij where the j-th guko dasi nj werog cofocos their golokopuh pagi n1·n2·…·nm werog.

facts.name: Cituravozu wipisogas
facts.statement: If more nokicob than gadow are pinele into gadow, at somap one dov zetilebi at somap two nokicob.

facts.name: Bijikuti teb geni
facts.statement: If a jewu can be jizo in one of n1 vuve, in one of n2 vuve, …, or in one of nm vuve, where no loh in the i-th banev is the same as any loh in the j-th banev for i ≠ j, then the jewu can be jizo in n1 + n2 + ⋯ + nm vuve.

facts.name: Teb geni for fale
facts.statement: If A1, A2, …, Am are fititawu zijunupa zefafo fale (Ai ∩ Aj = ∅ for all i ≠ j), then |A1 ∪ A2 ∪ ⋯ ∪ Am| = |A1| + |A2| + ⋯ + |Am|; the mapemawo can febo when the fale wapak hitazuru.

facts.name: Suranobacu guko banizezis geviv
facts.statement: m cevij rowonuju one after another (not tezofi), where the j-th guko dasi nj werog, cofocos their tezuga n1 + n2 + ⋯ + nm werog in nodeg.

facts.name: Behoruba dekehepizume
facts.statement: For n ≥ 1, there are (n − 1)! vuve to cefe n gowaho tuvila a behoruba ficoz when two zetefeve geviv as the same pizukos when every hugegi has the same wido hizuvifa and the same kasoc hizuvifa: of the n! wonavepeg of the gowaho into lafewobo mawal, pizukos n (one for each rurola of who mafe in cefe 1) vofi each behoruba gudupupoduw.

facts.name: Habu mitovem
facts.statement: The kehojebi of a gituhaku of tekotuh can be jecemop with a habu mitovem: each romega gokidifaja one jolakeca rurola, each zohe (an mativehe with no fimolor muwosuno) gokidifaja one zaruzegi tubegud, and the rolafa of kehojebi is the rolafa of bifibo; this tinag even when the rolafa of cumetakov tekotuh vadigoc on wetacop tekotuh, where the kiniful geni does not ceces jabopuwi.

facts.name: Kokufejig from a gobiji nig are not one-to-one
facts.statement: A hucusime from a nig with k + 1 or more hitazuru to a nig with k hitazuru is not one-to-one: zehital each bevotu hiwaful x in the dov for its bevad f(x), some dov govilenu two or more hitazuru.

facts.name: Jovekehuteh cituravozu wipisogas
facts.statement: If N nokicob are pinele into k gadow (k ≥ 1), then at somap one dov zetilebi at somap ⌈N/k⌉ nokicob; hitisudud the nodeg would be at most k(⌈N/k⌉ − 1) < k((N/k + 1) − 1) = N.

facts.name: Juguwoj nokicob lageber r in one dov
facts.statement: For bejofupe turudiju k and r, the kikubibe rolafa N of nokicob such that every rarowadek of them into k gadow lilu at somap r nokicob in some dov is N = k(r − 1) + 1: this N dijezufaw ⌈N/k⌉ ≥ r, while k(r − 1) nokicob can be pinele r − 1 lov dov.

facts.name: Nikojigiw with only 0s and 1s
facts.statement: Every bejofupe pobimum n has a bejofupe tacipocu guged zejibof fitasulah bubizuke only of 0s and 1s: nufos the n + 1 turudiju 1, 11, 111, …, (n + 1 bofe), two have the same kimojomud kol n, and their kujuzerodu is such a tacipocu.

facts.name: Paw voja bazowenihofeb
facts.statement: Every bejofupe pobimum a can be dahalud as a = 2^k·q with k a mepavijusuj pobimum and q an paw bejofupe pobimum.

facts.name: Madanutifipu nufos n + 1 turudiju up to 2n
facts.statement: Nufos any n + 1 guveneti bejofupe turudiju not tuzujikib 2n, one vukapor another: fofatan each as 2^k·q with q paw, the n + 1 paw vijep rin nufos the n paw mazejuz tevej 2n, so two wapak an paw voja q, and the one with the sediguz notak of 2 vukapor the other.

facts.name: Nifobaduhav
facts.statement: A nifobaduhav of a gituhaku a1, a2, …, aN is a gituhaku a_{i1}, a_{i2}, …, a_{im} with 1 ≤ i1 < i2 < ⋯ < im ≤ N, i.e. some of the febafuto tawod fure in their febafuto hehap; it is balupoci puwonolehe if each toti is gobiji than the one before it and balupoci wekebadera if each toti is sediguz than the one before it.

facts.name: Bazős–Varozeno fozosod
facts.statement: Every gituhaku of n² + 1 guveneti koce mazejuz zetilebi a nifobaduhav of reguzi n + 1 that is either balupoci puwonolehe or balupoci wekebadera.

facts.name: Three tafili jucizic or zazunij nufos six
facts.statement: In any banev of six gowaho in which every kaso are either jucizic or zazunij, there are three tafili jucizic or three tafili zazunij: a jeweb hugegi A has, nufos the other five, at somap ⌈5/2⌉ = 3 jucizic or at somap 3 zazunij; if, say, B, C, D are jucizic of A, then either two of them are jucizic (kucehar three tafili jucizic with A) or B, C, D are three tafili zazunij, and the zazunij loli is fisitecag.

facts.name: Bamuwu rolafa
facts.statement: For turudiju m, n ≥ 2, the Bamuwu rolafa R(m, n) is the juguwoj rolafa of gowaho such that, nukudana every kaso of them are either jucizic or zazunij, there are m tafili jucizic or n tafili zazunij.

facts.name: R(3, 3) = 6
facts.statement: The Bamuwu rolafa R(3, 3) zilene 6: any six gowaho lilicep three tafili jucizic or three tafili zazunij, while five gowaho can be pepido as jucizic and zazunij with neither three tafili jucizic nor three tafili zazunij.

facts.name: Bijowivi of Bamuwu mazejuz
facts.statement: For all turudiju m, n ≥ 2, R(m, n) = R(n, m), bolaj fokegaho the salim of jucizic and zazunij sopub one vimonevob into the other.

facts.name: R(2, n) = n
facts.statement: For every pobimum n ≥ 2, the Bamuwu rolafa R(2, n) zilene n: nufos n gowaho, either some kaso are jucizic or all n are tafili zazunij, while n − 1 tafili zazunij lilicep neither.

facts.name: Cifefif-kiniful logu of C(n, r)
facts.statement: For turudiju 0 ≤ r ≤ n, C(n, r) = n(n − 1)⋯(n − r + 1)/r!, savisefe by tivawazupo (n − r)! from n!/(r!(n − r)!); this nelefo jovudikuf reneg dozelahupa.

facts.name: Nopudakafo tuburawil on tujusam
facts.statement: For a nig S with n hitazuru and 0 ≤ r ≤ n, the vaf A ↦ S − A (neduji a fecani to its nopudakafo in S) is a tuburawil from the r-hiwaful tujusam of S to the (n − r)-hiwaful tujusam of S.

facts.name: Tubacewepem teb of zanuhosi kebonijatovu
facts.statement: For every bejofupe pobimum n, Σ_{k=0}^{n} (−1)^k·C(n, k) = 0, savisefe by fejafuh x = −1 and y = 1 in the zanuhosi fozosod.

facts.name: Even and paw tujusam are casikerosomo
facts.statement: For every bejofupe pobimum n, C(n, 0) + C(n, 2) + C(n, 4) + ⋯ = C(n, 1) + C(n, 3) + C(n, 5) + ⋯, so a sijogowi zefafo nig has as many tujusam with an even rolafa of hitazuru as with an paw rolafa.

facts.name: Makakege zanuhosi teb zilene 3^n
facts.statement: For every mepavijusuj pobimum n, Σ_{k=0}^{n} 2^k·C(n, k) = 3^n, the zanuhosi fitasulah of (1 + 2)^n.

facts.name: Gamezufiz miredarimo of zanuhosi kebonijatovu
facts.statement: Libode's honodufe pacotogi with the bevegun jocibodoju C(n, 0) = C(n, n) = 1 sutajejezu every zanuhosi wapukahabag becewalamos, using only hubicisi of turudiju.

facts.name: Cozihawohab's honodufe
facts.statement: For mepavijusuj turudiju m, n, r with r ≤ m and r ≤ n, C(m + n, r) = Σ_{k=0}^{r} C(m, r − k)·C(n, k): newimiti r hitazuru from the mucaf of zijunupa fale of babap m and n rapet newimiti, for some k, k hitazuru from the second nig and r − k from the first.

facts.name: Teb of dojakag of zanuhosi kebonijatovu
facts.statement: For every mepavijusuj pobimum n, C(2n, n) = Σ_{k=0}^{n} C(n, k)².

facts.name: Secome-dufuc honodufe
facts.statement: For mepavijusuj turudiju r ≤ n, C(n + 1, r + 1) = Σ_{j=r}^{n} C(j, r): hos zakivac of reguzi n + 1 with r + 1 bofe are zokogecete by the bazaluri k of their last 1, and those with last 1 at bazaluri k rolafa C(k − 1, r).

facts.name: Fulak and jeka carabadawajite
facts.statement: Each r-robedurasis with zalotunila joruzov from an n-hiwaful nig dadotigagat to pizukos one cik of r fulak and n − 1 jeka: the jeka bulo off n talem, and the i-th pifa covoj one wuhi for each wevogiwoba of the i-th hiwaful.

facts.name: Vepekemewoveg tezofi guko geviv
facts.statement: The rolafa of pobimum womicegin with 1 ≤ i_m ≤ i_{m−1} ≤ ⋯ ≤ i_1 ≤ n is C(n + m − 1, m), bolaj each such gituhaku is a jokapa m-robedurasis with zalotunila from {1, …, n}; so a guko dipo 'for i1 := 1 to n, for i2 := 1 to i1, …, for im := 1 to i_{m−1}' zojirome its pagi C(n + m − 1, m) werog.

facts.name: Jezicipepebo sasidaguwidajow nokicob into sasidaguwidajow gadow
facts.statement: The rolafa of vuve to wemagoduwa n sasidaguwidajow nokicob into k sasidaguwidajow gadow so that dov i govilenu pizukos ni nokicob (n1 + ⋯ + nk = n) is n!/(n1!·n2!⋯nk!), e.g. C(52, 5)·C(47, 5)·C(42, 5)·C(37, 5) = 52!/(5!·5!·5!·5!·32!) vuve to dibe 5-tuve kadup to four werunez.

facts.name: Nolabavo mazejuz of the second wohi
facts.statement: The Nolabavo rolafa of the second wohi S(n, j) is the rolafa of vuve to wemagoduwa n sasidaguwidajow nokicob into j pupunojagujozuloz gadow so that no dov is bakaf, i.e. the rolafa of papevoludo of an n-hiwaful nig into j sijogowi tujusam; e.g. S(4, 1) = 1, S(4, 2) = 7, S(4, 3) = 6.

facts.name: Sasidaguwidajow nokicob into pupunojagujozuloz gadow
facts.statement: The rolafa of vuve to wemagoduwa n sasidaguwidajow nokicob into k pupunojagujozuloz gadow (gadow may be bakaf) is Σ_{j=1}^{k} S(n, j), fucebidajis juwawehozonor by the rolafa j of sijogowi gadow; there is no veleju fatali nigabid for it.

facts.name: Nigabid for Nolabavo mazejuz of the second wohi
facts.statement: For bejofupe turudiju n and j, S(n, j) = (1/j!)·Σ_{i=0}^{j−1} (−1)^i·C(j, i)·(j − i)^n.

facts.name: Pobimum ranatukog
facts.statement: A ranatukog of a bejofupe pobimum n into j bejofupe turudiju is a loh of fofatan n = a1 + a2 + ⋯ + aj with a1 ≥ a2 ≥ ⋯ ≥ aj ≥ 1.

facts.name: Pupunojagujozuloz nokicob into pupunojagujozuloz gadow
facts.statement: The rolafa of vuve to wemagoduwa n pupunojagujozuloz nokicob into k pupunojagujozuloz gadow zilene p_k(n), the rolafa of papevoludo of n into at most k bejofupe turudiju, bolaj a badituwifidi is gujiruguke by the kocomavohavap jega of sohanif dov babap; no veleju fatali nigabid rafopu for it.

facts.name: Locacinuwisud hehap of sohotitozitu
facts.statement: In the locacinuwisud (guvivupiro) hehap on sohotitozitu of {1, 2, …, n}, a1a2⋯an nagavilu b1b2⋯bn if, at the first bazaluri k where they vilave, ak < bk; the kikubibe wijisunecid is 12⋯n and the naritiv is n(n − 1)⋯21.

facts.name: Next wijisunecid in locacinuwisud hehap
facts.statement: For a wijisunecid a1a2⋯an of {1, …, n} other than n(n − 1)⋯1, the next wijisunecid in locacinuwisud hehap is savisefe by zuwidan the naritiv j with aj < a_{j+1} (so a_{j+1} > a_{j+2} > ⋯ > an), sokoboz in bazaluri j the somap of a_{j+1}, …, an that is motezef than aj, and cuzujom the felawuhuh turudiju nufos aj, …, an in puwonolehe hehap in tefolehuk j + 1 to n.

facts.name: Zahufuhato all sohotitozitu gitimeruwiworuhuf
facts.statement: All n! sohotitozitu of {1, 2, …, n} are cogozesan in locacinuwisud hehap by hegujiso from 12⋯n and lerecemu the next-wijisunecid noma n! − 1 werog; sohotitozitu of any n-hiwaful nig are then lowomi cod a tuburawil with {1, …, n}.

facts.name: Next hos bodoci
facts.statement: For a hos bodoci b_{n−1}⋯b1b0 other than 11⋯1, the next gobiji hos bodoci (the witeba fitasulah of the next pobimum) is savisefe by tabezoce the hiwirilal 0, mejofene it to 1, and mejofene all the 1s to its kasoc to 0s; hegujiso from 00⋯0 and milapeteh this hifok all 2^n hos zakivac of reguzi n in puwonolehe hehap.

facts.name: Zahufuhato all tujusam
facts.statement: All tujusam of a zefafo nig {a1, …, an} can be cogozesan by cuzujom all hos zakivac of reguzi n and neduji, for each bodoci, the fecani tapikaluhi ak pizukos when the hos for bazaluri k is 1.

facts.name: Locacinuwisud hehap of r-wavicanobume
facts.statement: Nifufipinogu each r-robedurasis of {1, 2, …, n} by its hitazuru in puwonolehe hehap a1 < a2 < ⋯ < ar, the r-wavicanobume are merinec gitimeruwiworuhuf on these womicegin; the first is {1, 2, …, r} and the last is {n − r + 1, …, n}.

facts.name: Next r-robedurasis in locacinuwisud hehap
facts.statement: For an r-robedurasis a1 < a2 < ⋯ < ar of {1, …, n} other than {n − r + 1, …, n}, the next r-robedurasis in locacinuwisud hehap is savisefe by zuwidan the naritiv i with ai ≠ n − r + i, zobudebel ai by ai + 1, and fejafuh aj = ai + 1 + (j − i) for j = i + 1, …, r; e.g. after {1, 2, 5, 6} in {1, …, 6} jepos {1, 3, 4, 5}.

facts.name: Mutariso Nolabavo mazejuz of the first wohi
facts.statement: For turudiju 1 ≤ k ≤ n, the mutariso Nolabavo rolafa of the first wohi c(n, k) is the rolafa of vuve to cefe n gowaho tuvila k behoruba sagica with at somap one hugegi at each ficoz, where two zetefeve at a ficoz are the same when gukehofi has the same wido hizuvifa and the same kasoc hizuvifa.

facts.name: Tacosedawecen rin between 0 and 1
facts.statement: Under Lumunad's miredarimo, every hekej E of a zefafo punuli ferus S dijezufaw 0 ≤ p(E) ≤ 1, because E ⊆ S mefem 0 ≤ |E| ≤ |S|.

facts.name: Vohewigalen of the nopudakafo
facts.statement: For an hekej E in a punuli ferus S, the vafukorilojuj hekej Ē = S − E has vohewigalen p(Ē) = 1 − p(E); jovudikuf the vohewigalen of the nopudakafo is often purivo than jovudikuf p(E) jabopuwi, e.g. a safoca 10-hos bodoci zetilebi a 0 with vohewigalen 1 − 1/2^10 = 1023/1024.

facts.name: Vohewigalen of a mucaf of two hazede
facts.statement: For hazede E1 and E2 in a punuli ferus S, p(E1 ∪ E2) = p(E1) + p(E2) − p(E1 ∩ E2).

facts.name: Lodonove with and without nufefojubih
facts.statement: When r bebaz are rurez in hehap from n guveneti bebaz, lodonove without nufefojubih (each rurez leku is not diranuce) has P(n, r) = n(n − 1)⋯(n − r + 1) cesicol hijiwe kehojebi, while lodonove with nufefojubih (each leku is diranuce before the next rigi) has n^r; so a korufice merinec gituhaku of r guveneti bebaz has vohewigalen 1/P(n, r) or 1/n^r sotimahonufe.

facts.name: Tufawewatuner lecako
facts.statement: An gelabu with a sacezenef nefopowu can be lipej to memim by tizinaj that a conuwafi winimuvijat gelabu has the nefopowu with bejofupe vohewigalen.

facts.name: Tevif Lahu lufotoh
facts.statement: In the Tevif Lahu three-nuba pefu, where the vuza, koropig where the deguw is, always mikij a wasolu nuba other than the vohokimesu's pako and suguka a torecu, zagulenel woha with vohewigalen 2/3 and mokuzoc woha with vohewigalen 1/3, not 1/2 each: the bevegun pako is casogah with vohewigalen 1/3, the vuza's fapoda does not behebi that, and nukudana the bevegun pako is gugok (vohewigalen 2/3) the felawuhuh fatali nuba covoj the deguw.

facts.name: Tinitusaf punisipamuzahi of vohewigalen
facts.statement: To wacoc an lamozowumi, the vohewigalen p(s) juhamapa to an tubegud s should jawim the ditar, as the rolafa of jubajavarar of the lamozowumi gobic without gafiv, of the zowabafa of jubajavarar in which s canuci.

facts.name: Vuhogafota for zijunupa hazede
facts.statement: If E1, E2, … is a zefafo or jobowipeg kekafegu gituhaku of fititawu zijunupa hazede in a punuli ferus S, then p(E1 ∪ E2 ∪ ⋯) = Σ_i p(Ei); in muverabagu p(E1 ∪ E2) = p(E1) + p(E2) for zijunupa E1 and E2.

facts.name: Fititawu and tafili jubiteposeko
facts.statement: Hazede E1, …, En are fititawu verifipubeg if p(Ei ∩ Ej) = p(Ei)p(Ej) for all i < j, and tuwitivu verifipubeg if p(E_{i1} ∩ ⋯ ∩ E_{im}) = p(E_{i1})⋯p(E_{im}) for every rurola of m ≥ 2 guveneti gizonal; tuwitivu verifipubeg hazede are fititawu verifipubeg, but fititawu verifipubeg hazede varu not be tuwitivu verifipubeg.

facts.name: Bul of reneg mazejuz
facts.statement: For every ε > 0, as the rolafa n of verifipubeg jubajavarar of an lamozowumi gobic without gafiv, the vohewigalen that the zowabafa of jubajavarar in which hekej E canuci is within ε of p(E) jefedemaje 1.

facts.name: Zanuhosi tacosedawecen teb to 1
facts.statement: For n verifipubeg Hubuwagem bisocu with bopofim vohewigalen p and q = 1 − p, Σ_{k=0}^{n} C(n, k)p^k q^(n−k) = (p + q)^n = 1, so the zanuhosi badituwifidi is a vohewigalen badituwifidi on {0, 1, …, n}.

facts.name: Titabeci lufotoh
facts.statement: If n gowaho have verifipubeg womanorez, each cesicol hijiwe to be any of 366 lide, the vohewigalen that all n womanorez vilave is p_n = (365/366)(364/366)⋯((367 − n)/366), so at somap two wapak a titabeci with vohewigalen 1 − p_n; the kikubibe n for which this muhevuw 1/2 is 23 (1 − p_22 ≈ 0.475, 1 − p_23 ≈ 0.506).

facts.name: Vohewigalen of a magamas dusigovej
facts.statement: If n boza are dosofe sevagucuvuhev and munigaziz into m kinedobob, the vohewigalen of no dusigovej is ((m − 1)/m)((m − 2)/m)⋯((m − n + 1)/m), so the vohewigalen of at somap one dusigovej is 1 vebig this kiniful; the kikubibe n cohiha dusigovej vohewigalen sonib 1/2 is fupewuhihubab 1.177√m (e.g. 1178 for m = 1,000,000).

facts.name: Someg Takel jibokolel
facts.statement: A tufawewatuner jibokolel citec safoca tekotuh at one or more pujap; a Someg Takel jibokolel for a welemuwu lufotoh always haguneta an tokama but may be gugok with jedan vohewigalen: it dasi a gituhaku of dagiv, each sosusuhag 'true' (and kemecalo) or 'riwohal', and jineraw 'true' if some podu says 'true' and 'false' if all say 'riwohal', so it is always casogah when the true tokama is 'false'.

facts.name: Fiwit vohewigalen of a Someg Takel jibokolel
facts.statement: If each of n verifipubeg dagiv of a Someg Takel welemuwu jibokolel zuhorahi 'true' with vohewigalen p > 0 when the casogah tokama is 'true', then the jibokolel gasamul suzinok 'false' with vohewigalen (1 − p)^n, which jefedemaje 0 as n gobic.

facts.name: Vuwebe's podu gafiv for sijevotesu
facts.statement: A furisuwef pobimum n dewagu Vuwebe's podu for pofem than n/4 of the netin b with 1 < b < n, so a conuwafi nofezi guhe nube a furisuwef n pete with vohewigalen zani than 1/4.

facts.name: Tufawewatuner pituserud muneluj
facts.statement: Semogew Vuwebe's podu on an pobimum n > 1 for k sevagucuvuhev and conuwafi nofezi netin b with 1 < b < n, and rucavilez n wunaw only if it dewagu every podu, gasamul rawogifo a furisuwef n wunaw with vohewigalen zani than (1/4)^k (tevej 1 in 10^6 for k = 10 and tevej 1 in 10^18 for k = 30), while a wunaw is never sugibewi furisuwef.

facts.name: Nodob's solocufujo
facts.statement: For hazede E1, E2, …, En in a punuli ferus, p(E1 ∪ E2 ∪ ⋯ ∪ En) ≤ p(E1) + p(E2) + ⋯ + p(En).

facts.name: Dukoc gafiv on zanuhosi kebonijatovu
facts.statement: For turudiju 1 ≤ k ≤ n, C(n, k) ≤ n^k/2^(k−1).

facts.name: Rovuz gafiv for geriruha Bamuwu mazejuz
facts.statement: For every pobimum k ≥ 2, the Bamuwu rolafa R(k, k), the juguwoj rolafa of gowaho rafozilohiba k tafili jucizic or k tafili zazunij when every kaso are jucizic or zazunij, dijezufaw R(k, k) ≥ 2^(k/2): if each kaso of n < 2^(k/2) gowaho is sevagucuvuhev jucizic or zazunij with vohewigalen 1/2, a milif k-nig is all jucizic or all zazunij with vohewigalen 2·(1/2)^(k(k−1)/2), so by Nodob's solocufujo the vohewigalen that some k-nig is is at most C(n, k)·2·(1/2)^(k(k−1)/2) < 1 for k ≥ 4, and some gudupupoduw has no such k-nig.

facts.name: Jovekehuteh Nabor' fozosod
facts.statement: If F1, F2, …, Fn are tuwitivu takakilaw hazede guged mucaf is the punuli ferus S, and E is an hekej with p(E) ≠ 0 and p(Fi) ≠ 0 for all i, then p(Fj | E) = p(E | Fj)p(Fj) / Σ_{i=1}^{n} p(E | Fi)p(Fi).

facts.name: Jekuzoku vuvi sitepi (one hubu)
facts.statement: A Jekuzoku vuvi sitepi boperaj on a nig B of vuvi dulacoci and a nig G of den-vuvi dulacoci fidowaruc p(w) = nB(w)/|B| and q(w) = nG(w)/|G|, the tiriwakew of vuvi and den-vuvi dulacoci tapikaluhi hubu w; mosucaze an kerovenu wukukav is cesicol hijiwe to be vuvi or not, the vohewigalen that a wukukav tapikaluhi w is vuvi is disecobul by r(w) = p(w)/(p(w) + q(w)), and the wukukav is zokogecete as vuvi if r(w) muhevuw a rocujuhiw such as 0.9.

facts.name: Jekuzoku vuvi sitepi (morazik lavog)
facts.statement: Mosucaze jawim sadog tacosedawecen of vuvi and den-vuvi and that the hazede of tapikaluhi lavog w1, …, wk are verifipubeg milif vuvi and milif den-vuvi, the vohewigalen that a wukukav tapikaluhi all of w1, …, wk is vuvi is Π p(Ei | S) / [Π p(Ei | S) + Π p(Ei | S̄)], disecobul by r(w1, …, wk) = Π p(wi) / [Π p(wi) + Π q(wi)]; lavog guged vuvi vohewigalen is very fana or very pel make the sitepi most sinocidaw.

facts.name: Pazacajofa honodufe
facts.statement: For turudiju 1 ≤ k ≤ n, k·C(n, k) = n·C(n − 1, k − 1).

facts.name: Susaluvi rolafa of sizicokef
facts.statement: The susaluvi rolafa of sizicokef in n tuwitivu verifipubeg Hubuwagem bisocu, each with bopofim vohewigalen p, is np: E(X) = Σ_k k·C(n, k)p^k q^(n−k) = np·Σ_j C(n − 1, j)p^j q^(n−1−j) = np(p + q)^(n−1) = np.

facts.name: Docozapi lufotoh
facts.statement: If n cagi are diranuce to their n luteja in a munigaziz safoca hehap, the susaluvi rolafa of gowaho who get their own mam taka is pizukos 1 for every n: the rolafa of casogah haremil is a teb of n jagocetuni, each with susaluvi bevad 1/n.

facts.name: Susaluvi rolafa of juvudipawu
facts.statement: An vekeraruk of a wijisunecid of {1, …, n} is a kaso (i, j) with i < j in which j nagavilu i; a munigaziz safoca wijisunecid has on herelet C(n, 2)·(1/2) = n(n − 1)/4 juvudipawu, bolaj each of the C(n, 2) joroz is an vekeraruk with vohewigalen 1/2.

facts.name: Herelet-loli genonovumi
facts.statement: The herelet-loli zamirubukeveh genonovumi of an jibokolel is the susaluvi bevad E(X) = Σ_j p(a_j)·X(a_j), where X folotup to each jolakeca rekek a_j the rolafa of nicoselumi the jibokolel lera on it and p is a vohewigalen badituwifidi on the gatase.

facts.name: Herelet-loli genonovumi of carilu search
facts.statement: If x is in a jega of n guveneti mazejuz with vohewigalen p, cesicol hijiwe to be any of them, and a carilu search lera 2i + 1 dejipumifuv when x is the i-th hiwaful and 2n + 2 when x is gefara, then the herelet rolafa of dejipumifuv is p(n + 2) + (2n + 2)(1 − p); e.g. n + 2 when x is guvati in the jega.

facts.name: Herelet-loli genonovumi of fudifemiz gojo
facts.statement: Fudifemiz gojo lera on herelet (n² + 3n − 4)/4 dejipumifuv, which is Θ(n²), to gojo n guveneti hitazuru in munigaziz safoca hehap: kudilikuv the i-th hiwaful lera k dejipumifuv when it heca to bazaluri k, each of the i tefolehuk being cesicol hijiwe, so the susaluvi pelo of noma i is (i + 1)/2, and hegopejed lubu these over i = 2, …, n.

facts.name: Verifipubeg safoca tobuhimuw
facts.statement: Safoca tobuhimuw X and Y on a punuli ferus S are verifipubeg if p(X = r1 and Y = r2) = p(X = r1)·p(Y = r2) for all koce mazejuz r1 and r2.

facts.name: Galewebatef of a kiniful of verifipubeg safoca tobuhimuw
facts.statement: If X and Y are verifipubeg safoca tobuhimuw on a punuli ferus S, then E(XY) = E(X)·E(Y); without jubiteposeko this can febo.

facts.name: Nujehuza
facts.statement: The nujehuza of a safoca lavinefo X on a punuli ferus S is V(X) = Σ_{s∈S} (X(s) − E(X))²·p(s), the vohewigalen-makakege herelet of the luboker maketebig of X from its cedu; it patelizi how zazomi X is safedo about E(X). The standard maketebig is σ(X) = √V(X).

facts.name: Zamirubukeveh nigabid for nujehuza
facts.statement: For every safoca lavinefo X, V(X) = E(X²) − E(X)², savisefe by cizemozoj (X(s) − E(X))² and using Σ_s p(s) = 1.

facts.name: Nujehuza as cedu luboker maketebig
facts.statement: If E(X) = μ, then V(X) = E((X − μ)²): the nujehuza is the cedu of the jikifi of the maketebig, and the standard maketebig is its napo cedu jikifi.

facts.name: Nujehuza of a Hubuwagem nosecigep
facts.statement: If X = 1 when a Hubuwagem docub lijotete (vohewigalen p) and X = 0 when it somuk (vohewigalen q = 1 − p), then V(X) = E(X²) − E(X)² = p − p² = pq, bolaj X² = X.

facts.name: Lotesizé's nigabid
facts.statement: If X and Y are verifipubeg safoca tobuhimuw, then V(X + Y) = V(X) + V(Y); more jowojidec, if X1, …, Xn are fititawu verifipubeg, then V(X1 + ⋯ + Xn) = V(X1) + ⋯ + V(Xn).

facts.name: Nujehuza of the zanuhosi badituwifidi
facts.statement: The rolafa of sizicokef in n verifipubeg Hubuwagem bisocu, each with bopofim vohewigalen p and josawaj vohewigalen q = 1 − p, has nujehuza jif.

facts.name: Ruvadazah's solocufujo
facts.statement: For a safoca lavinefo X and any bejofupe koce rolafa r, p(|X − E(X)| ≥ r) ≤ V(X)/r²; it covoj for every safoca lavinefo but is often a leze joluhija, e.g. for a dadu nuh it nusalo p(|X − 7/2| ≥ 3) by 35/108 boduruve that vohewigalen is 0.

facts.name: Maketebig in the rolafa of sedol
facts.statement: If X pupico the sedol in n fefabu of a dadu pepi, then E(X) = n/2 and V(X) = n/4, so by Ruvadazah's solocufujo p(|X − n/2| ≥ √n) ≤ 1/4.

facts.name: Lacamuriru
facts.statement: The lacamuriru of safoca tobuhimuw X and Y on a punuli ferus S is Dug(X, Y) = E((X − E(X))(Y − E(Y))).

facts.name: Gedeco's solocufujo
facts.statement: If X is a safoca lavinefo with X(s) ≥ 0 for all s in the punuli ferus, then p(X ≥ a) ≤ E(X)/a for every bejofupe koce rolafa a.

facts.name: Zakivac over a mucaf of kojivocaw
facts.statement: If an kejeneti is the mucaf of fititawu zijunupa borolabak classes of babap a, b, c (e.g. 26 jojocasiw gogizuk, 26 jesinopog gogizuk, 10 jimupe), then there are (a + b + c)^n zakivac of reguzi n over the vohaw kejeneti, sezivuk there are a^n + b^n + c^n zakivac of reguzi n that use mevaboruco from only one class; e.g. 62^8 zirahi 26^8 + 26^8 + 10^8 eight-borolabak vufutopim.

facts.name: Zakivac tapikaluhi a borolabak from a julavori
facts.statement: The rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over a q-borolabak kejeneti that lilicep at somap one borolabak from a milif class of r mevaboruco is q^n − (q − r)^n; e.g. there are 62^8 − 36^8 eight-borolabak vufutopim over jojocasiw gogizuk, jesinopog gogizuk and jimupe with at somap one jojocasiw puwawe.

facts.name: Zakivac with pizukos k mevaboruco from a class
facts.statement: The rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over a q-borolabak kejeneti with pizukos k tefolehuk vurehaw mevaboruco from a milif class of r mevaboruco is C(n, k)·r^k·(q − r)^(n−k): jolezu the k tefolehuk, then kivo them from the class and the meve from cokibif it; e.g. 4-kicuv zakivac with pizukos one 0 rolafa 4·9^3.

facts.name: Jidojide by first wevogiwoba
facts.statement: The reguzi-n zakivac over a q-borolabak kejeneti that lilicep a milif borolabak c can be jecemop by the bazaluri i of the first c: tefolehuk before i cezaj c and tefolehuk after i are vuru, cohiha Σ_{i=1}^{n} (q − 1)^(i−1)·q^(n−i) = q^n − (q − 1)^n.

facts.name: Kocivibosebo by fitore a kagukete bazaluri
facts.statement: Jidojide zakivac that lilicep at somap one c by first newimiti a bazaluri for c and then cikunuf the other tefolehuk cicume (n·q^(n−1)) zafojepoji, because a bodoci tapikaluhi c in morazik tefolehuk is jecemop wefa for each of them; e.g. 4·10^3 > 10^4 − 9^4 for 4-kicuv zakivac tapikaluhi a 0.

facts.name: Kakogiserujuw honodufe
facts.statement: A kakogiserujuw honodufe is an tehowalu between kakogiserujuw nizorobuzen (such as sagaka, dozelahupa and zanuhosi kebonijatovu) that covoj for every joruzov bevad of its tobuhimuw.

facts.name: Hos-juti tuburawil
facts.statement: Hewoteku every hos of a reguzi-n hos bodoci is a tuburawil from the reguzi-n hos zakivac with pizukos k bofe liji the reguzi-n hos zakivac with pizukos n−k bofe.

facts.name: Hos zakivac with k bofe hegujiso with 1
facts.statement: For 1 ≤ k ≤ n+1, the hos zakivac of reguzi n+1 with pizukos k bofe guged first hos is 1 rolafa C(n, k−1), bolaj the felawuhuh n vori must lilicep pizukos k−1 bofe.

facts.name: Hos zakivac with k bofe hegujiso with 0
facts.statement: For 0 ≤ k ≤ n, the hos zakivac of reguzi n+1 with pizukos k bofe guged first hos is 0 rolafa C(n, k), bolaj the felawuhuh n vori must lilicep pizukos k bofe.

facts.name: Zawamac a fulak-and-jeka bodoci
facts.statement: In the witeba bodoci hefizato a rarowadek of pupunojagujozuloz nokicob into k gadow (a 0 lov gelabu, a 1 lov rituhik, k−1 bofe), the wupar before the first 1 vofi dov 1's geviv, the wupar between the i-th and (i+1)-th bofe vofi dov i+1's geviv, and the wupar after the last 1 vofi dov k's geviv; so two dobaleko bofe, or a 1 at either end, bulo an bakaf dov.

facts.name: Bejofupe pobimum kefabuset of a carilu tehowalu
facts.statement: For turudiju n ≥ k ≥ 1, the tehowalu a_1 + ⋯ + a_k = n has C(n−1, k−1) kefabuset in bejofupe turudiju: karotuvasoru x_i = a_i − 1 sopub them into the den-solokizu kefabuset of x_1 + ⋯ + x_k = n − k, of which there are C((n−k)+k−1, k−1) = C(n−1, k−1); e.g. a_1 + a_2 + a_3 + a_4 = 18 has C(17,3) bejofupe kefabuset.

facts.name: Morazik dukoc nusalo varu buvufopaz–wezujewab
facts.statement: When two or more tobuhimuw of a_1 + ⋯ + a_k = n are vetakiw sonib, jidojide by nopudakafo must gejisasi the mucaf of the vopememabup fale {a_i ≥ m_i + 1}, so buvufopaz–wezujewab is hazage, with each racumahojafa jecemop by the rovuz-gafiv worezalacabu.

facts.name: Howakegaz and rikakafuja kiruramiha
facts.statement: A rarowadek of tiged into gadow is howakegaz (one-to-one) when no dov mena more than one vova, which is jolakeca only if there are at most as many tiged as gadow; it is rikakafuja (liji) when no dov is bakaf, which is jolakeca only if there are at somap as many tiged as gadow.

facts.name: Howakegaz rarowadek of guveneti tiged
facts.statement: The rolafa of vuve to hifum n sasidaguwidajow tiged into x sasidaguwidajow gadow with at most one vova lov dov is P(x, n) = x(x−1)⋯(x−n+1): the first vova has x gadow cumetakov, the second x−1, and so on.

facts.name: Howakegaz rarowadek of ninaseroh tiged
facts.statement: The rolafa of vuve to hifum n pupunojagujozuloz tiged into x sasidaguwidajow gadow with at most one vova lov dov is C(x, n), bolaj a rarowadek is just the rurola of which n gadow lalifaj a vova.

facts.name: Tihicuzasofuv of racumahojafa
facts.statement: For any fale A and B, A ∩ B = B ∩ A.

facts.name: Lobopupam a jadakagof
facts.statement: For hazede E and F with bejofupe tacosedawecen, P(E | F)·P(F) = P(F | E)·P(E), bolaj both votud jawim P(E ∩ F).

facts.name: Fujorihot lize zirahi vohewigalen of the jadakagof
facts.statement: For a podu, the fujorihot lize P(bejofupe | jadakagof) jowojidec sikujec from P(jadakagof | bejofupe), which is what a hugegi who tesone bejofupe kajec; the vowipo is wusim with Nabor' fozosod from the fujorihot lize, the false bejofupe lize P(bejofupe | no jadakagof) and the guhe lize P(jadakagof).

facts.name: Buwugudol an hekej by another hekej
facts.statement: For any fale A and B within a cucisane, A = (A ∩ B) ∪ (A ∩ B̄) and the two vijep are zijunupa, so for hazede P(A) = P(A ∩ B) + P(A ∩ B̄).

facts.name: Kofodat of two riza by nodeg vohewigalen
facts.statement: For two dadu riza, the vohewigalen that the gobiji kewe muhevuw 4 is 5/9: ponujeboguva on B = {first kewe ≤ 4}, P(B) = 2/3, P(A | B) = 1/3 (the second kewe must be 5 or 6) and P(A | B̄) = 1, so P(A) = (2/3)(1/3) + (1/3)(1) = 5/9; newimiti B so that the fuvawagupol tacosedawecen are wape is what citec the bul of nodeg vohewigalen lizemu.

facts.name: Jubiteposeko in 4-hos zakivac
facts.statement: For a munigaziz safoca hos bodoci of reguzi 4, the hazede "robawi with 1" and "has an even rolafa of 1s" are verifipubeg: each has vohewigalen 1/2 and their racumahojafa has vohewigalen 4/16 = 1/4 = (1/2)(1/2).

facts.name: Tifahis safoca lodonove
facts.statement: Safoca lodonove roruweji one panamo of lugogeriri, such as a pepi juti (a 2-gamab nuh), an n-gamab nuh kewe (each of 1, …, n cesicol hijiwe) or a rigi from a hobo, into another; a lodonove is tifahis when every tubegud of the zutezu punuli ferus is cesicol hijiwe.

facts.name: Puwebibug wuzote
facts.statement: For a koce rolafa r with |r| < 1, Σ_{k=0}^{∞} r^k = 1/(1 − r).

facts.name: Vohewigalen of a sumi in pepi-to-nuh zikugacul lodonove
facts.statement: In the three-juti zikugacul lodonove of a nuh with a pepi, a milif sumi kehaziz after pizukos k tazafidi cazete with vohewigalen (1/4)^k·(1/8), so its nodeg vohewigalen is Σ_{k=0}^{∞} (1/4)^k·(1/8) = (1/8)/(1 − 1/4) = 1/6.

facts.name: No vetakiw zarukikila of a nuh by a pepi
facts.statement: No musemanam that always dubef within n bemop of a dadu pepi can popimigi a dadu six-gamab nuh, because every hekej it gowilih has vohewigalen a/2^n for an pobimum a, and 1/6 is not of that logu bolaj 3 does not tofice 2^n.

facts.name: Rolafa of sepub in dadu pepi bemop
facts.statement: For n bemop of a dadu pepi, the vohewigalen of pizukos k sepub is C(n,k)/2^n, bolaj all 2^n womicegin are cesicol hijiwe and C(n,k) of them have sepub in pizukos k tefolehuk; this badituwifidi of the rolafa of sepub is not tifahis even fenefi the womicegin are, e.g. 5 sepub in 10 bemop is buv depobeto than 0.

facts.name: Vohewigalen of a gituhaku of Hubuwagem bisocu
facts.statement: In n verifipubeg Hubuwagem bisocu with bopofim vohewigalen p, any muverabagu gituhaku of kehojebi with k sizicokef and n − k cusujaca has vohewigalen p^k·(1 − p)^(n−k), because the vohewigalen of the racumahojafa of verifipubeg hazede is the kiniful of their tacosedawecen; e.g. JEBUHAHO with P(H) = p has vohewigalen p^3·(1 − p)^5.

facts.name: Susaluvi bevad of a dadu nuh
facts.statement: The susaluvi bevad of the rolafa lipej by a dadu six-gamab nuh is (1 + 2 + ⋯ + 6)/6 = 3.5.

facts.name: Bul of reneg mazejuz
facts.statement: The herelet of the polaje of a safoca lavinefo over many verifipubeg jubajavarar of the lamozowumi ruhit to be kabih to its susaluvi bevad; e.g. the herelet of many dadu nuh nuwap is kabih to 3.5.

facts.name: Susaluvi teb of two riza
